According to him, the seedlings were taken from the training of the North Kazakhstan region in order to quickly adapt to the climate of Astana. en.Попечительский совет возглавил Председат: The Board of Trustees was headed by the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric Yerkebulan Ilyasov, and one of the authors of the law on endowments, Timur Makenov, was appointed Director of the Fund. The council includes businessmen, scientists and experts in the field of finance, which guarantees transparency and professional management of funds. The Council consists of Sayasat Nurbek, Timur Turlov, Askar Zhumadildaev, Yerkebulan Ilyasov, Nurzhan Stvaev, Farhad Kuanganov, Alibek Madibekov, Arman Ashkyn, Nurmakhan Abdrakhmanov.
en.Создание фонда стало первым примером кор: The creation of the fund became the first example of a corporate endowment in Kazakhstan after the adoption of the relevant law in 2025.
en.«Мы, как казахстанская компания с глубок: “We, as a Kazakh company with deep technological production and localization, hope that this step will become a benchmark for other companies in the country. It shows that private investment can not only support science and education, but also stimulate the creation of technology, innovation and engineering capacity. For Kazakhstan, the creation of such endowment funds is an important example of strategic and socially responsible investment in human resources,” noted Erkebulan Ilyasov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric.

The Kazakhstan delegation was represented by 23 companies operating in the field of construction, food industry and mechanical engineering, including Alageum Electric JSC. en.Напомним, в этом году 7 сентября предста: Let us remind you that this year, on September 7, the representative office of Alageum electric JSC in Uzbekistan - ALAGEUM TRANS LLC, celebrated exactly 1 year since its opening. en.Холдинговая компания «Alageum Electric»: The holding company “Alageum Electric” held a working meeting with partners and consumers from the western region of Kazakhstan, as well as from the Russian Federation. It discussed the possibilities of the Ural Transformer Plant, issues of mutually beneficial cooperation and expansion of product markets.
en.Напомним, что лидер электромашиностроени: Let us recall that the leader in electrical engineering in Kazakhstan, the holding company Alageum Electric, launched a new project in December last year - the Ural Transformer Plant, the products of which are aimed mainly at the Russian market. The plant produces three-phase power, dry and oil transformers with a power of 25 - 2500 kVA, voltage class 6 - 10 kV. The design capacity is 14,000 distribution transformers per year. Once production is launched at full capacity, the plant will create 650 jobs. Today the company employs 150 people. Over the course of a year of operation, the plant has formed a portfolio of orders for 1,200 transformers with an export component of 92%, which makes it possible to implement the ideas of the Eurasian Economic Union. “Bringing the production of transformer products closer to the border with Russia is a wise decision for the management of the Alageum Electric holding,” said Bulat Alibekov, executive director of the Kazan Electrical Equipment Plant.
en.– Для нас это очень важно, ведь трансфор: – This is very important for us, because transformers are the heart of our products – transformer substations. We have been working in the Russian market for 12 years. The main geography of our supplies is the Volga region. Alageum Electric offers a fairly competitive price with high quality products. We have already entered into a supply agreement with UTZ, and next year we plan to enter into a dealer agreement in order to build up a warehouse stock. So we will cooperate on an ongoing basis. One of the first companies to place an order directly with the Ural Transformer Plant is Evrika MK Group of Companies LLC, which is the official dealer of the holding in Russia.
en.– Мы три года работаем с Кентауским тран: “We have been working with the Kentau Transformer Plant for three years,” says Deputy Director of the company Andrey Chechetkin. – We started with the purchase of products worth 10 million rubles per year, now the annual turnover under the contract is about 70 million rubles. We have been purchasing UTZ products for six months now. I am confident that we have everything to be leaders in the Russian market, gradually displacing competitors - decent quality, reasonable price, meeting delivery deadlines. Therefore, we boldly present these products on the Russian market. The meeting participants also discussed the issue of interaction with large oil and gas producing companies. According to the head of the association “Consortium of Mechanical Builders of the West Kazakhstan Region” Kosherbai Aigozha-uly, today local companies supply products to foreign investors. But, as a rule, these are products for which strict requirements are not imposed.
en.– Политика Казахстана на сегодня такова,: – The policy of Kazakhstan today is such that in connection with the accession to the WTO on December 1, the concept of “Kazakh content” will disappear, says Kosherbay Aigozha-uly. “But now we have achieved that foreign companies are obliged to involve local enterprises when concluding contracts with contractors. Therefore, today a lot of preparatory work is underway to train local personnel, modernize production, and introduce international standards. By the way, KPO b.v. helps us with this. According to the Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the holding S. Kozhabayev, the difficult economic situation has noticeably compressed the sales markets for transformer products both in Kazakhstan and in Russia. In response to these challenges, the holding introduces the most modern technologies, uses the latest equipment, without lowering the bar of production culture from the high level that is appreciated by its partners. Recently, the holding received an offer from the regional akimat to join the Consortium of Mechanical Engineers. The issue is still at the discussion stage.
en.– Для местных предприятий – это новые за: “For local enterprises, these are new orders,” says Kosherbay Aigozha-uly. – Here you can produce body parts. Thus, the holding will be able to reduce its logistics costs. The holding came to the region four years ago. During this time, modern production was created, production was established, and more than a dozen local residents were employed. The company does not forget about social responsibility. So, two years ago, Uralsk received an ambulance as a gift from the company, and today the West Kazakhstan Electricity Distribution Company was presented with a transformer.
en.Во время недавнего официального визита П: During the recent official visit of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev to Tajikistan, a Kazakh-Tajik business forum was held. 16 Kazakh companies, including Alageum Electric, presented their products to the Tajik market.
en.Обсуждая экспортные возможности отечеств: Discussing the export opportunities of the domestic electrical engineering industry, and the Alageum Electric company in particular, Deputy General Director of Alageum Electric Erkebulan Ilyasov noted that the prospects for Kazakhstani manufacturers are able to supply large volumes of equipment at competitive prices and European quality.
en.«Мы успешно работаем на рынке практическ: “We have been successfully operating in the market for almost a quarter of a century. During this time, the company has grown from one manufacturing plant into the largest electrical engineering group, capable of implementing turnkey projects of any complexity. The experience we have gained and the results of successfully implemented cases gives us the opportunity to implement the largest projects in the electrical industry. In this regard, we propose to consider the possibility of organizing an audit of the electrical networks of Tajikistan to identify the need for electrical equipment, construction of substations with a capacity of 6 to 500 kV in the city of Dushanbe and throughout Tajikistan,” said Erkebulan Ilyasov.
en.Также заместитель Генерального директора: Also, the Deputy General Director of Alageum Electric emphasized that the implementation of such projects is possible with the support of domestic financial institutions. For a more detailed discussion of the prospects for cooperation, meetings were organized for Kazakh entrepreneurs with representatives of government agencies and businesses of the Republic of Tajikistan.
en.Казахстанский промышленный холдинг «A la: The Kazakhstani industrial holding “A lageum El e ctric” was awarded an industry award in the category “For its contribution to the development of human capital.” This honorary award was presented in Astana by the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan Alikhan Smailov to the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Sales LLP Nurmakhan Abdrakhmanov within the framework of the VI Kazakhstan Round Table on Global Investments. The best investors were awarded in 10 categories in such sectors of the economy as healthcare, education, energy, agriculture, etc.
en.«Alageum Electric» в настоящее время явл: Alageum Electric is currently the only high-tech enterprise in Kazakhstan in the production of transformers and other electrical products providing a full range of services. The holding's products include power transformers from 6 kV to 500 kV, electrical substations, cabinet structures and more. The share of local content in Alageum Electric products varies from 70% to 80%. In the regions of presence, Alageum Electric is the largest taxpayer.
en.Вклад «Alageum Electric» в развитие чело: Alageum Electric's contribution to the development of human capital is not limited only to economic aspects, but also covers the social and educational spheres. Alageum Electric provides scholarships and internships with an emphasis on hands-on learning for engineering students. Thus, the Kazakh-German Polytechnic College, created by the company in 2012, annually graduates more than 100 sought-after specialists trained in a dual education system. In 2022, Alageum Electric Group of Companies built and launched a modern student dormitory for 500 people for college students.
en.«Alageum Electric» уделяет особое вниман: Alageum Electric pays special attention to increasing the prestige of technical professions among young people. In 2023, a Training Center was built and opened on the territory of the KTZ plant, where students undergo practical training on the latest equipment using a dual training system. Also, in 2023, on the basis of the Kentau Transformer Plant and the Asia Trafo plant, in partnership with KazNRTU named after K.I. Satpayev opened the departments of energy and mechanical engineering. This helps young professionals acquire the practical skills needed for a successful career in industry and creates strong links between the business sector and educational institutions. In addition, to support access to quality education in 2023, as part of the Republican “Road to School” campaign, Alageum Electric donated new school kits and clothes to 153 schoolchildren from needy families, as well as children with disabilities from all regions of the country.
en.Технологический прогресс невозможен без: Technological progress is impossible without science. The group of companies actively invests in research and development of new technologies. For example, the development and design bureau of the group's factories - the Kentau Transformer Plant and Asia Trafo - over the past 26 years have created over 1,000 technical solutions in various areas: from automation and digitalization, increasing energy efficiency, to the development and design of electrical machines. Over the past 5 years, Alageum Electric has invested 1.6 billion tenge in the development of Kazakh scientists. As part of cooperation with the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Kazakhstan, in September 2023, Alageum Electric, in partnership with Trenco R&D, sponsored the 1st Business & Science Event forum. The event is aimed at strengthening cooperation between business and scientists in the commercialization of science. These efforts contribute to the development of R&D in the electrical engineering industry of Kazakhstan and contribute to the creation of new jobs.
en.Учитывая высокую значимость сохранения и: Considering the high importance of preserving historical and cultural heritage, the holding supports the revival of national sports. In January 2023, Erkebulan Ilyasov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric, was elected President of the Federation of National Sports “Zhamby Atu”. During the year, in order to popularize jamba atu, a number of major sporting events were organized: republican tournaments were held in the cities of Kokshetau, Astana and Almaty, special awards “Taituyak” and “Tomiris” (for female archers) were established. In preparation for publication, a book about the history of jamba atu and comics for children.
en.«Поддержка историко-культурного наследия: “Supporting the historical and cultural heritage of our country corresponds to the patriotic values ​​of our holding, laid down since its founding. Zhamby atu is an important part of the history and traditions of the Kazakhs. Popularizing this sport helps preserve identity and emphasize the uniqueness of our rich culture,” said Erkebulan Ilyasov.
en.При поддержке «Alageum Electric», в 2023: With the support of Alageum Electric, in 2023, the national team of Kazakhstan in jamby atu achieved high results at international tournaments in Hungary, France and Mongolia, where Kazakhstani shooters won a total of 5 gold, 1 silver and 1 bronze medals. Uniforms and equipment for competitions have been purchased for horse archers. The Federation plans to create sports centers, organize and conduct competitions at the republican and international level, and participate in the World Nomad Games in 2024.
en.« Символично, что дата вручения премии о: “It is symbolic that the date of presentation of the award from the Prime Minister coincided with the Foundation Day of our Group of Companies. Throughout its 26 years of activity, A lageum El e ctric has paid great attention to investments in the social sphere. We provide stable work for more than 4,500 employees, more than 600 of them received housing thanks to the efforts of the holding. In Petropavlovsk, “A lageum Electric” this year completed the construction of another residential complex with 100 apartments,” noted Nurmakhan Abdrakhmanov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Sales LLP.
en.Казахстанская электротехническая компани: The Kazakh electrical engineering company Alageum Electric will become a platinum partner of one of the country’s key technological events - the Digital Qazaqstan forum, dedicated to the digital transformation of the economy, the development of innovation and the implementation of advanced technological solutions.
en.Статус платинового партнера подтверждает: The status of a platinum partner confirms the significant role of Alageum Electric in the development of the industrial and energy infrastructure of Kazakhstan. The company is involved in the implementation of projects that provide a reliable energy basis for the development of the digital economy, including the infrastructure of data processing centers (DPCs), industrial automation and digitalization of the energy sector.
en.Группа компаний Alageum Electric объедин: The Alageum Electric group of companies unites more than 30 large enterprises and factories and offers a full range of turnkey services in the field of electrical power, mechanical engineering and construction, including design, equipment production, service, commissioning and implementation of EPC contracts.
en.Компания также развивает современные тех: The company also develops modern technological solutions in the energy sector, introducing innovative developments into manufactured electrical equipment - energy-saving transformers, digital substations and transformer monitoring systems, which allow real-time monitoring of the condition of equipment and increasing the efficiency of its operation. The company's products meet international quality standards and are supplied both to the domestic market and for export to the CIS countries and abroad.
en.«Сегодня цифровая экономика, включая цен: “Today’s digital economy, including data centers, supercomputers and artificial intelligence technologies, directly depends on reliable power supplies and modern electrical equipment. As a domestic manufacturer of electrical products, Alageum Electric is participating in the formation of this technological base, creating and producing modern transformers, digital substations and other solutions necessary for the construction and operation of digital economy facilities,” said Erkebulan Ilyasov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric.
en.Напоминаем что, форум Digital Qazaqstan: We remind you that the Digital Qazaqstan forum will be held on March 27, 2026 in Shymkent and will bring together more than 2,000 participants, representatives of government agencies, business and the technology community. The event will become an important platform for discussing the strategic directions of digital transformation and the development of the innovative economy of Kazakhstan.
en.Акционерное общество «Alageum Electric»: Alageum Electric Joint Stock Company brings to the attention of its shareholders and all interested parties that the decision of the sole shareholder dated November 9, 2018 approved the conclusion of a major transaction between Alageum Electric JSC and Alfa-Bank SB JSC within the framework of credit agreements for a group of companies, the total amount of which is 8,650,000,000 (eight billion six hundred fifty million) tenge.
en.За дополнительной информацией обращаться: For additional information, please contact: Republic of Kazakhstan, Astana city, VIP town, lane 37, no. 8.
en.В Петропавловске продолжается строительс: Construction of a new 110/10 kV substation continues in Petropavlovsk. After commissioning, it will provide electricity to the multidisciplinary regional hospital under construction and the facilities of the Qyzyljar special economic zone.
en.Alageum выступает генеральным подрядчико: Alageum is the general contractor for the project. The main equipment has already been installed on the site, including two power transformers. Construction of the substation is planned to be completed by the end of 2026.
en.Новый энергообъект строится в рамках раз: A new power facility is being built as part of the development of the infrastructure of Petropavlovsk. en.Для запуска таких объектов необходимы до: To launch such facilities, additional energy capacity is required. The new substation will ensure stable power supply to the hospital and future production facilities of the SEZ.
en.На этой неделе ход строительства в рамка: This week, during a working trip, the progress of construction was assessed by the akim of the North Kazakhstan region, Gauez Nurmukhambetov.
en.Реализация проекта позволит создать необ: The implementation of the project will create the necessary energy reserve for the further development of this part of Petropavlovsk, connecting new social and industrial facilities.
en.«Алматинский электромеханический завод»: “Almaty Electromechanical Plant” is the winner of the regional competition “Best Product of Kazakhstan – 2014”. In 2015, he also took part in the “Altyn Sapa” competition in the category “Best Industrial Products”, the BNews.kz correspondent reports. “Almaty Electromechanical Plant” was founded in 1959 and is part of the holding company “Alageum Electric”. The plant produces high-voltage, low-voltage and non-standard electrical equipment. Since 2000, the supply of complete transformer substations of the type KTPN, KTP, with a capacity of 25-2500 kVA, input and distribution devices ASU, cabinets ShchO-70, ShchO-90 and others began. The production of structures occurs in several stages.
en.«Здесь происходят все подготовительные р: “All the preparatory work takes place here: starting from metal cutting, jig punching machines that knock out all kinds of holes, then there is metal bending, a press and then the welding section.
en.У нас есть два монтажных участка, где ид: We have two installation areas where ordinary small cells are being installed. The workpiece is sent through the welding section to the painting room. There are 2 painting areas: enamel coating and powder coating. After the large body is ready, small cells are welded and installed inside,” said technical director of AEMZ LLP Bulat Sarbasov.
en.Создание трансформаторных шкафов, блочно: The creation of transformer cabinets, block-modular buildings and substations begins with receiving an order. Within 2-3 days, the technical department develops design drawings and electrical diagrams. Another 2-3 days are spent on preparatory work. Afterwards there is welding work, which lasts 4-5 days. In total, about 160 people work to complete one order. Since 2013, a kaizen system was introduced into the plant’s operation, which helped achieve visible results.
en.«Алматинский электромеханический завод»: “Almaty Electromechanical Plant” in 2014 was awarded the title of winner in the category “Best Product of the Year” in Almaty. And this success includes the contribution of our entire wonderful team. Thanks to the efforts of the factory workers, persistent and impeccable work, the kaizen quality system was introduced at the enterprise, which significantly improved the aesthetics and culture of production, making it modern, meeting international standards, comfortable for work and safety. The basis of all these achievements of the working collective is labor. This year, AEMZ LLP took part in the Altyn Sapa competition in the category “Best Industrial Products”. 44 companies are represented in this nomination, including ours,” said Zhandilya Ilyasov, General Director of Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP.
en.С 6 по 11 января 2014 года на «Алматинск: From January 6 to January 11, 2014, a training seminar on the topic “5C - Kaizen “Lean Manufacturing” was held at the Almaty Electromechanical Plant (AEMZ). Since last year, AEMZ has been actively working on the implementation of the Japanese 5C system - Kai Zen.
en.По словам генерального директора АЭМЗ Ха: According to AEMZ General Director Khairulla Kozhabayev, like most Japanese approaches to management, lean manufacturing can be considered as a philosophy, as a system, and as a toolkit. “The principles of the Lean system imply constant long-term work to improve quality and reduce losses,” explains Khairulla Kozhabayev.
en.Кайдзен (kaizen) – подход к управлению о: Kaizen is an approach to managing an organization based on continuous quality improvement. In this approach, employees regularly and actively work to improve their performance. 5S is an improvement methodology that is part of the Kaizen approach. Allows you to reduce losses associated with poor organization of the workplace.
en.Проведение семинара стало возможным благ: The seminar was made possible thanks to the support of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD). The speaker was the General Director of Arsenal of Success LLC Anatoly Aleksandrovich Feskov (Ekaterinburg, Russian Federation), who shared his experience in implementing and using this approach.
en.«Мы с радостью приняли участие в данном: “We were happy to take part in this seminar, as it allowed us to learn more about the world-famous effective Japanese method. It has been proven that the use of a lean manufacturing approach can significantly improve the efficiency of an enterprise and reduce losses. AEMZ is working to improve efficiency. We hope that the Japanese lean production system will help us achieve this goal,” summarized the general director of AEMZ.
en.АО «Alageum Electric» презентовал свою н: Alageum Electric JSC presented its new products at the Power Kazakhstan 2013 exhibition, which was held in Almaty from October 29 to 31, 2013. The company's stand clearly demonstrated transformers produced using new technology - the TMG-100/10 power transformer with an oval winding.
en.«Стратегия «Alageum Electric» направлена: “The Alageum Electric strategy is aimed at developing resource-saving “green” energy and producing energy-saving transformers. For these purposes, the company is modernizing its equipment and production culture. And this direction will continue to strengthen, based on the fact that the global economy will be led by the one who will be the leader in environmentally friendly energy,” said Erkebulan Ilyasov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric JSC.
en.Общемировая тенденция удорожания энергор: The global trend towards rising prices for energy resources makes the problem of reducing electricity losses in distribution transformers urgent. “This mission is accomplished by the TMG series transformers, which have a low level of no-load losses (approximately 20% of existing GOST norms and standards) and short-circuit losses (8–10% in comparison with serial transformers) from the entire line of general-purpose power transformers produced by KTZ JSC,” said Mr. Ilyasov.
en.Особенно востребованы такие энергосберег: Such energy-saving and low-noise transformers are especially in demand by foreign companies. Their launch into mass production is due to attractive technical characteristics, favorable pricing policy for consumers, and a short payback period (overpayment costs for energy-saving transformers are recouped within 1–2.5 years).
en.Научно-технический потенциал компании по: The scientific and technical potential of the company allows us to rely on environmentally friendly innovative technologies. “A special place in our product line is occupied by dry-type transformers that satisfy consumer demands for environmental safety. For the first time, the plant produced dry-type transformers with cast insulation under its own brand of KTZ JSC in August 2008. We can say that this marked the beginning of a new era in the domestic transformer industry,” concluded Erkebulan Ilyasov.
en.28 ноября в Астане состоялся VI междунар: On November 28, the VI international forum “Vocational education and business: dialogue between partners” took place in Astana.
en.Вице-премьер РК Бердибек Сапарбаев и Мин: Deputy Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan Berdibek Saparbayev and Minister of Education Aslan Sarinzhipov presented awards to the best business structures for their contribution to the development of technical and vocational education. Among the awarded is Alageum Electric JSC. The chairman of the board of the joint-stock company, Nurmakhan Abdrakhmanov, received an honorary statuette at the ceremony.
en.Государство высоко отметило опыт холдинг: The state highly noted the holding company’s experience in introducing a dual training system. Presenting the awards, Berdibek Saparbayev noted the great contribution of employers to the training of technical personnel and career guidance work. During the summing up, the immediate tasks were identified to change a number of state TVET standards, optimize the choice of subjects within the specialty, and create independent assessment and qualification centers. It is expected that colleges will be transferred to the management of large companies in order to streamline the training of specialists in demand in a particular industry and to work out mechanisms for “fixing” graduates.
en.Кентауский политехнический колледж при А: Kentau Polytechnic College at KTZ JSC can serve as an example of cooperation with the base enterprise to solve organizational issues of personnel training according to the needs of the holding, from the introduction of a scholarship system to guaranteed employment of graduates.
en.АО «Электромонтаж» («ЭЛМО») выполняет эл: JSC Elektromontazh (ELMO) performs electrical installation work to ensure power supply to the new industrial zone of the city of Saran, Karaganda region.

en.АО «Кентауский трансформаторный завод» (: JSC "Kentau Transformer Plant" (hereinafter - JSC "KTZ") of the group of companies "Alageum Electric" was recognized as the winner of the "Paryz" award in the category "Best Collective Agreement".
