In addition to the rights and benefits guaranteed by law, the document provides for employee training, preferential vouchers to sanatoriums, payments for anniversaries and much more.
en.АО «КТЗ» уделяет особое внимание подгото: KTZ JSC pays special attention to the training of qualified personnel - 100% payment of the cost of expenses associated with training graduates of universities and colleges is provided. In 2012, Kentau Polytechnic College was opened at KTZ JSC. The educational institution actively uses dual education.
en.Группа компаний «Alageum Electric» работ: The Alageum Electric group of companies has been working in the field of electrical engineering for 25 years. During this period, the holding team achieved an incredible result for the industry, essentially restoring a bankrupt enterprise, building new factories and becoming a flagship in electrical engineering. The total number of employees of Alageum Electric is about 5,000 workers, the holding’s annual tax deductions reach 15 billion tenge per year, and 650 employees have been provided with apartments for 25 years.
en.Мы будем и дальше продвигать наши ценнос: We will continue to promote our values ​​and adhere to the principles of corporate social responsibility. Through investments in human capital, the development of knowledge-intensive production, and innovative development, we are ready to make our contribution to building a fair Kazakhstan.
en.Государственная инспекция труда ЮКО в ра: The State Labor Inspectorate of the South Kazakhstan region, within the framework of the “World Day of Safety and Health at Work,” held a review competition to determine the best organization, enterprise, labor protection service and safety engineer to create safe working conditions for workers.
en.АО «Кентауский трансформаторный завод» п: JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant” presented an exhibition about the work carried out at the plant on occupational health and safety, which was recognized as the best in South Kazakhstan. The commission noted the plant’s positive experience in preventing occupational injuries, improving occupational safety and health, and improving production standards. The company has organized training for employees, equipping them with all the necessary modern tools that reduce the likelihood of injury, and protective clothing.
en.Проводятся соревнования профессиональног: Professional skills competitions are held to practice personnel actions in the event of emergency situations. The security service constantly monitors compliance with the requirements of regulatory documents on labor protection and safe organization of the workplace.
en.17 января Уральский трансформаторный зав: On January 17, the Minister of Investment and Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan Aset Orentaevich Isekeshev visited the Ural Transformer Plant on a working visit.
en.Генеральный директор машиностроительных: General Director of machine-building enterprises of the holding company “Alageum Electric” S.N. Kuntuarov introduced A. Isekeshev to production plans for 2015. Currently, the plant is completing the setup of production and technological lines. Starting in March of this year, serial production of transformer equipment will begin, 90% of which will be focused on the Russian electrical market.
en.Асет Исекешев ознакомился с выполненным: Aset Isekeshev got acquainted with the completed volume of construction and installation work and the new technological complex. It was noted that the investment project “Construction of a transformer plant with a capacity of 6-10 kV” is included in the list of priority projects in the field of mechanical engineering of the country. Aset Isekeshev emphasized that the launch of this exemplary enterprise in the West Kazakhstan region with high-tech and knowledge-intensive production, high production standards became possible thanks to effective government support for domestic producers and the favorable investment climate created for them.
en.Как отметил министр, для индустриально-и: As the minister noted, the Ural Transformer Plant is of particular importance for the industrial and innovative development of the West Kazakhstan region, and expressed the hope that the transformer equipment it produces will be in demand in the electrical market of the neighboring state and will satisfy the needs of consumers in the border regions of the Russian Federation.
en.Напомним, что пуск первой очереди завода: Let us recall that the launch of the first stage of the plant took place on December 25, 2014 during the National teleconference “New industrialization of Kazakhstan - results of 2014 and the first five-year plan,” held with the participation of Head of State N.A. Nazarbayev.
en.Силовой масляный автострансформатор мощн: A power oil autotransformer with a capacity of 167 MVA, intended for electrical networks with a voltage of 500 kV, was manufactured by the plant in 10 months. The equipment was supplied to Central MES, namely to the Nura electrical substation.
en.«Asia Trafo» является единственным отече: Asia Trafo is the only domestic manufacturing plant of such equipment. It has no analogues in all of Central Asia.
en.Автотрансформаторы служат преобразовател: Autotransformers serve as electrical voltage converters in starting devices of powerful alternating current electric motors, in relay protection circuits for smooth voltage regulation. They allow the secondary voltage to remain constant when the primary voltage changes.
en.С гордостью делимся успехом нашего проек: We are proud to share the success of our project with the Zhezkazgan copper smelter, part of Kazakhmys Smelting LLP! The company is the largest copper producer in the world. According to the agreement, Asia Trafo supplied three high-performance furnace transformers, model EOTSN 35000/35-89U3, setting new standards for quality and reliability.
en.В декабре 2021 года специалисты Asia Tra: In December 2021, Asia Trafo specialists, in collaboration with the chief engineer, successfully assembled and installed two transformers on the RTP-2 ore thermal furnace in phases B and C. The third transformer was installed in 2022, complementing the system and ensuring full coverage of all phases.
en.Эти трансформаторы оснащены РПН с встрое: These transformers are equipped with on-load tap-changers with built-in vacuum chambers, eliminating the need to change transformer oil. This means maintenance is easier and cheaper, without sacrificing functionality.
en.Устойчивость к коротким замыканиям и агр: Resistance to short circuits and aggressive voltage surges guarantees stable operation of the furnaces even in the most difficult conditions. Our transformers withstand all the tests of time and operation.
en.За период с 2021 по 2024 годы ни одна жа: During the period from 2021 to 2024, not a single complaint regarding the operation of transformers was registered. This confirms that our products are not only powerful, but also reliable.
en.Asia Trafo — ваш надежный партнер в мире: Asia Trafo is your reliable partner in the world of electrical engineering. We guarantee quality you can trust!
en.Мемлекет басшысы 2017 жылғы­ мау­сымда «: "In June 2017, the Head of State signed the Decree ""Development and Implementation of the Rating on the Ease of Doing Business in the Regions of the Republic of Kazakhstan""." At the end of the year, the Governor's Office of the West Kazakhstan region took the 6th place in this rating.
en.Сауалнама нәтижесі Батыс Қазақстан облыс: The results of the survey show that the West Kazakhstan region ranks 1st in the country in terms of the share of timely provision of public services to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) without violating the law; the number of projects supported by state (grants, guarantees, loans, subsidies, infrastructure costs) per 1000 SMEs - 2nd place; 2nd place in terms of employment growth rate in SMEs; specialized platforms for business development (technoparks, business incubators, investor and entrepreneur service centers) – 2 places; It has been shown that the business side of the business is in the second place in terms of protection against infringement.
en.Батыс Қазақстан облысы өнер­кәсібі негіз: The industry of the West Kazakhstan region consists of two main sectors: the production and processing of raw materials. Indeed, the share of the mining industry is 88.8%. In 2017, industrial organizations in the region produced products worth 1.9 trillion tenge. This is an increase of 5.5% compared to 2016. At the end of 2017, the volume of exports of processing enterprises amounted to 182.2 million dollars. Compared to 2016, there is an increase of 20.8% in the manufacturing sector. As a result of state support, the number of people working in manufacturing enterprises for 9 months of 2017 amounted to 18.5 thousand, which is 22.7% more than in the same period of 2016.
en.Сараптап қарасақ, өңдеу өнер­кәсібінің н: According to the analysis, the basis of the manufacturing industry was food production (28.8%), mechanical engineering (21.0%) and oil refining (18.4%). Only the enterprises of the machine-building industry produced products worth 33.3 billion tenge last year. - And the growth in the oil refining sector was mainly ensured by the production of gasoline on the basis of JSC "Condensate", - said the head of the regional department of entrepreneurship and industrial and innovative development Arman Zhalmagambetov. In April 2017, a vacuum oil injection section was put into operation, which allows for the maximum amount of open oil products. In addition, the project work has been completed, which will increase the capacity of the refinery from 600 to 850 thousand tons per year. A hydro-treatment section of diesel fuel is currently under construction here. In total, the company will invest 51 billion tenge ($155 million) for the implementation of the above projects.
en.Металлургия саласында 14,7 млрд тең­гені: In the metallurgical sector, products worth 14.7 billion tenge were produced, which is 12.3% more than in 2016. "The growth was ensured by the increase in the production of pump-compressor pipes on the basis of ""KazTrubprom"" LLP and the increase in the volume of casting of cast iron on the basis of ""Ural Casting-Mechanical Plant""." Manufacturing enterprises in the region are taking all necessary measures to modernize production. "For example, in 2016, ""Ural Transformer Plant"", which is part of the group of companies ""Alageum Electric"", together with Turkish investors, created ""URAL ELECTRIC"" LLP." "Electrical and technical equipment based on the technology of the Swiss company ""ABV"" was installed here." In the first quarter of 2017, the plant produced electric shields worth 500 million tenge. "In the future, ""Zenitekhservice"" LLP will open a hot-dip galvanizing workshop, where galvanizing products with a length of more than 10 meters will be organized." "Research Institute ""Hydropribor"" JSC is considering the possibility of assembling research vessels for underwater measurements, designing underwater television complexes (for inspection of underwater pipes)."
en.Индустрияландыру картасы аясында II бесж: Within the framework of the Industrialization Map, 29 investment projects worth 84.4 billion tenge are being implemented in the West Kazakhstan region during the second five-year plan. A total of 1,340 permanent jobs have been created at these facilities. In 2015-2016, 12 investment projects worth 73.1 billion tenge were launched, 1,800 jobs were created. In 2017, 10 projects worth 8 billion tenge were launched, 782 people were employed. - In 2018, it is planned to implement 10 projects. To date, 6 projects worth 3.3 billion tenge have been included in the Industrialization Map. About 200 new jobs will be created, - said the head of the regional department of entrepreneurship and industrial and innovative development A. Zhalmagambetov. "In particular, ""Kubley"" LLP is building a workshop for processing livestock waste." "The construction of a plant for the production of sandwich panels by ""Agran"" LLP will also be opened this year." "The construction of the chemical production base carried out by ""Topan"" LLP, the construction of a brick factory of ""134"" LLP, the concrete mixing workshop of ""Global Procurement"" LLP, the renovated confectionery production facility of ""Hasanov"" will be launched in the coming days and will contribute to the development of the region's economy."
en.Өткен жылдың қорытын­дысында облыста 48: At the end of last year, more than 48,000 small and medium-sized businesses were registered in the region. "37,000 of them are currently working. About 111,000 people work in the field of small business. In 2017, enterprises of SMEs paid 52.3 billion tenge in taxes, Zhalmagambetov said." "The Head of State instructed that ""the share of enterprises in the field of small business in the GDP turnover should reach 50% by 2050." At the end of 2016, this figure reached 41.9% in the region. In other words, the West Caucasus region is at the forefront of the republic. There is a state program for the development and support of entrepreneurship in the country.
en.«Биз­нестің жол картасы-2020» бағ­дар­ла: Since the launch of the Business Road Map 2020 program, 831 projects worth 99.1 billion tenge have received state support in the region. 57 projects worth 2.7 billion tenge are provided with the missing infrastructure. This, in turn, made it possible to save 28.2 thousand jobs and create more than 5 thousand new jobs. - Over the past two years, the interest of rural entrepreneurs in the program has increased significantly. 328 projects worth 36 billion tenge were approved from rural areas. The state's support for entrepreneurs is increasing every year. In 2016, the participants of the program paid 6 tenge of taxes on 1 tenge of the subsidy, and in 2017 it was 3.6 tenge, A. Zhalmagambetov said. "Within the framework of the ""Business Road Map 2020"" program, ""Ural Trade and Industrial Company"" LLP purchased additional equipment for the production of plastic pipes with a protective layer." "Ural Cable LLP has acquired the necessary equipment for the production of electric cables." "And ""Steklo-Service"" LLP has started the second stage of expansion and modernization of the industrial complex for industrial processing of glass."
en.Осының бәрі мемлекет қолдауымен жасалып: All of this is being done with the support of the government. In 2015-2017, 45 entrepreneurs in the region received innovative grants totaling 76 million tenge. In 2017, 19 entrepreneurs received grants in the amount of 47 million tenge. Of these, 13 projects will be implemented in rural areas. Within the framework of the Program for the Development of Productive Employment and Mass Entrepreneurship for 2017-2021, 300.3 million tenge will be allocated to the Akzhayik region this year. Loans are issued at 6% from second-tier banks. - Our department is the authorized body that implements the State Program of Industrial and Innovative Development for 2015-2019, the Business Road Map 2020 program and the program for the development of productive employment and mass entrepreneurship for 2015-2019. Therefore, we are ready to provide state assistance to those who can do it, - he said
en.Eлбасымыз жастарға жұмысшы мамандықтарды: The head of the department told the young people about the development of working professions, hard work, and the ability to reach the peak of skills. There are a lot of young people from West Kazakhstan who prove their support for the Head of State's speech not only in words, but also in deeds, the NewTimes.kz correspondent reports. Among them is Sayat Konyrbayev, a native of the Chingyrlau region. Studying in the 1st year of the West Kazakhstan Industrial College, his passion for technology was formed from childhood.
en.«Мен екі жыл алты ай ішінде бір емес, үш: "In two years and six months, I will become the owner of not one, but three of the same professions, that is, an electrician, a transformer assembler and a technician. This will make me feel confident that I won't be able to get a job tomorrow when I graduate. We are taught by skilled professionals. For example, our curator Aidana Serikkyzy went to Malaysia and improved her education. That's why this man's medicine is interesting for us", he says.
en.400-ден астам жас он шақты кәсіп түрін м: With more than 400 young people learning about ten types of professions, this institution is the only college in the Ak Zhayyk region that teaches mechanical engineering. This is where a dual learning system is introduced, which combines theory with production. In fact, 60% of the education students receive is related to industrial training. This is beneficial for both the student and the college. "For example, in recent years, this educational institution has been working closely with ""Ural Transformer Plant"" LLP." In accordance with the agreement between the two parties, in the workshops here, production masters and students will prepare parts for transformers. Considering the fact that the Uralsk transformers are exported to far abroad, it can be assumed that the requirements for them are also strict. However, they are losing their faith. In the past year alone, nearly 2 million students have enrolled in the program. "At the expense of these funds, the best teachers and students of the college visited the exhibition ""EXPO-2017""." Equipment has also been modernized, and the necessary training and methodological tools have been obtained. It should be noted that about 20 graduates of the college are currently working at the Uralsk transformer plant.
en.Жыл сайын жұмысшы мамандықты игеріп жатқ: The students of this college, who annually win the regional stage of the competition "WorldSkills Kazakhstan", which is held among young people who are mastering the profession of a working profession, proudly defend the honor of the region in the republican championships.
en.«Жастар - еліміздің ертеңі. Олардың білі: "Youth is the future of our country. The state is taking measures to ensure that they receive education, become individuals, engage in creative work, and thus create their own bright future. The Concept of the State Youth Policy for 2020 also states that young people are actively continuing the formation of a new Kazakhstan, that is, a developed, competitive and respected country in the world. In this regard, we pay attention not only to technical education, but also to the patriotism of young people, the development of economic, social, innovative and creative potential, director of the West Kazakhstan Industrial College Ali Masalimov said."
en.В Кентауском политехническом колледже АО: At the Kentau Polytechnic College of KTZ JSC, a ceremony was held to present students of the ES-1-12 and TE-1-12 groups with certificates of advanced training at the Institute of Continuing Education at the MKTU.
en.Для повышения знаний студентов администр: To improve the knowledge of students, the college administration entered into an agreement with the Institute for graduates to undergo two-month training courses.
en.Вручая сертификаты, директор Института н: Presenting certificates, the director of the Institute of Continuing Education at the ICTU, Abulgazy Koptileuovich Kurbaniyazov, noted that the KPK students showed good knowledge and received the highest ranks. Cooperation between the two educational institutions will develop and strengthen, he noted.
en.Выражая руководству МКТУ благодарность з: Expressing gratitude to the leadership of the ICTU for assistance in training future electric power workers, the director of the KPK S. Aytureev noted that additional training in addition to basic classes gives students in-depth knowledge. The Japanese Kaizen system of continuous improvement is being implemented at the college. This allows them to successfully master not only skills in the field of electrical energy, but also modern production culture. Chess and debate tournaments and essay competitions are aimed at developing creative thinking.
en.Другое приятное событие – вручение денеж: Another pleasant event was the presentation of cash prizes and Certificates of Appreciation to KPK students who took prizes in the regional subject Olympiad among colleges, as well as the Spartakiad of the South Kazakhstan region among youth sports schools in athletics.
en.-Я рад, что мой сын сделал правильный вы: “I’m glad that my son made the right choice by entering the Kentau Polytechnic College,” said Oleg Ryabtsev, the father of student Ilya Ryabtsev, who took 2nd place in computer science among regional students, in his speech. – The educational process in college is aimed at results. The combination of theoretical knowledge with practical skills increases the effectiveness of learning. This opens up great opportunities for gaining solid and informed knowledge and developing individual abilities.
en.Сто одиннадцать трудовых династий трудит: One hundred and eleven labor dynasties work at the Kentau Transformer Plant (KTZ). If you multiply this figure by an average of 3-4 people, then the constancy and commitment to one enterprise of such a large group of people can only be envied. A Kazinform correspondent talks about personnel policy in production with the chairman of the supervisory board of the electrical holding company Alageum Electric, which includes KTZ, Saidulla Kozhabayev.
en.- Сайдулла Ильясович, если сложить трудо: - Saidulla Ilyasovich, if you add up the length of service of all the dynasties that work at the plant, it will be several hundred years. Rare production today can boast of such a mature team.
en.- Да, трудовые династии - один из главны: - Yes, labor dynasties are one of the main indicators of stability, success and maturity of an enterprise. These people are not only the bearers of his history, but also the mentors of the new generation of the team. After all, the development and modernization of production today is so rapid that every day the need for highly professional specialists becomes more acute. Youth is the main human resource and intellectual potential of the company. By creating motivation for the most active, we help them plan their careers and achieve professional and personal growth. And experience is an acquired taste.
en.Приведу такой пример: решением Совета пр: Let me give you this example: by decision of the Board of Management of a joint-stock company, a young man, who is not yet 30 years old, was recently appointed to the position of head of one of the holding’s key enterprises. Experienced production workers explained their decision by the fact that today it is necessary to boldly give way to young people who have special knowledge, languages, and a fresh look at market processes. This is not the only case, and I am not inclined to call it phenomenal. Why? Yes, because it is necessary to move away from the stereotype that a young specialist must go through all professional levels and received an appointment when the enthusiasm of his youth was exhausted, the fire in his eyes went out. We don’t have such time - today and now we need talented, promising, energetic young people to develop production. By entrusting them with the most critical areas of production, we open a career elevator for everyone who has healthy ambitions and a great desire to contribute to the prosperity of their country. Of course, making any decision in personnel matters is perhaps always the most difficult. When entrusting leadership to a young manager, it is necessary to support him so that the first difficulties do not break his character, determination and attitude to work with enthusiasm.
en.У нас есть правило - в наш холдинг не ус: We have a rule - people do not get hired into our holding company through patronage or by phone call. The main requirement is an engineering specialty, determination, and a desire to work effectively. We create certain preferential conditions for young specialists, train them, say: today everything is possible, go for it if you are confident in your abilities, offer initiatives, implement promising areas, prove yourself!
en.Конкурентоспособный сектор экономики, в: The competitive sector of the economy in which we operate requires a constant influx of competent and capable young managers. When 18 years ago we took control of the bankrupt Kentau Transformer Plant, we immediately encountered a shortage of engineering personnel. If modernization and other technical issues could be solved with investments and loans, then the personnel issue remains relevant to this day. The development of an enterprise is not so dangerous from crises and economic fluctuations as from the lack of professionals. This is especially felt in such a high-tech industry as transformer manufacturing, which works at the intersection of a number of natural sciences. What is needed here are skilled workers and engineers with technocratic thinking.
en.В канун 2015 года Президент страны во вр: On the eve of 2015, the President of the country, during a teleconference, launched a new enterprise - the Ural Transformer Plant, also part of our holding. Mostly young people will work on it - design engineers, power engineers, and technologists. In supporting the holding's young specialists, we rely on the state youth policy aimed at increasing the intellectual potential of the country. Based on this, we try to help graduates of engineering faculties of universities gain confidence in the right choice of profession. By promoting young people, we let them know that career heights await everyone who is ready to work tirelessly.
en.- Как стало известно из СМИ, Кентауский: - As it became known from the media, the Kentau Transformer Plant celebrated its 55th anniversary in 2014. Its geographical location probably also affects the shortage of personnel?
en.- В структуре компании завод занимает ос: - The plant occupies a special place in the structure of the company - it is a source of personnel for the entire holding. Everyone who undergoes labor training here receives a “springboard” to enter management positions in other departments. In addition to cooperation with the country's leading technical universities, we decided to once and for all “close” the problem of personnel training. In 2012, a polytechnic college was created at the plant, which today operates successfully, training mid-level personnel for production. Mostly local youth are selected. The college is considered the pioneer of dual education; students spend up to 70% of their time at work places, in workshops and factory buildings. In the summer, paid internships are organized for them, and upon completion of their studies, the company guarantees them 100% employment.
en.Я часто общаюсь с молодыми инженерами, и: I often communicate with young engineers, and I am especially pleased that the prestige of the technical and engineering professions and a positive attitude towards work are gradually returning, and young people are more emotionally involved in team work. In exchange, they are guaranteed a promotion. This is very important.
en.Человек труда является главной ценностью: The working person is the main value and capital of society. It is no coincidence that a new holiday was introduced in Kazakhstan by the Decree of the Head of State - Labor Day, which pays tribute to honor and respect to working citizens. We see that the national project “Intellectual Nation 2020” is also bringing good results - to educate young people through the formation of the correct value system, hard work, and the desire for constant self-improvement and learning.
en.Воспитание такой молодежи - дело не толь: Raising such youth is not just a matter for schools and educational institutions. The words of the President “Educating Kazakhstanis of a new formation, transforming Kazakhstan into a country with competitive human capital” are also addressed to us, employers. And we use our example to try to develop innovative education, to educate not soulless techies, but people who are consciously ready to contribute to the prosperity of their homeland.
en.11 апреля в Шымкенте Касым-Жомарт Токаев: On April 11, in Shymkent, Kassym-Jomart Tokayev visited the Asia Trafo transformer plant - the largest in the country and one of the leading in Central Asia.
en.Завод специализируется на производстве с: The plant specializes in the production of power oil transformers and high-voltage autotransformers (110, 220, 500 kV) with a power of up to 500 MVA, as well as shunt reactors for power lines.
en.Это первое предприятие в Казахстане, где: This is the first enterprise in Kazakhstan that produces such complex equipment, which was previously only imported.
en.Президент осмотрел производство, пообщал: The President toured the production and talked with engineers and young specialists. The founder of the Alageum Electric Group of Companies, Saidulla Kozhabayev, presented the company’s achievements to the head of state.
en.За последние пять лет вложено более 5 мл: Over the past five years, more than 5 billion tenge have been invested in scientific developments, of which 3 billion were our own funds.
en.В 2023 году на заводе собрали первый в с: In 2023, the plant assembled the country's first three-phase autotransformer with a capacity of 250,000 kVA (500 kV). It weighs almost 300 tons.
en.Asia Trafo входит в состав группы компан: Asia Trafo is part of the Alageum Electric group of companies, which unites transformer plants in four cities of Kazakhstan. Enterprises are focused on fully meeting domestic demand.
en.Группа также участвует в социальных прое: The group also participates in social projects - over the past three years, about 7 billion tenge has been allocated to charity, construction of schools and support for regions affected by floods.
en.Эти слова Сайдулла Кожабаев, председател: Saidulla Kozhabaev, chairman of the supervisory board of the holding company Alageum Electric, addressed these words to high school students of the city and students of the polytechnic college at Kentau Transformer Plant JSC. The school assembly hall was overcrowded. The audience listened to every word, wanting to learn as much as possible about the prospects of the company with which they decided to throw in their lot.
en.Полтора десятилетия назад на заводе взял: A decade and a half ago, the plant set a course for modernization and technical re-equipment. In fact, it was only thanks to this that the enterprise survived and today produces competitive transformers that are in demand not only in Kazakhstan, but also in neighboring countries. Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, Azerbaijan, Russia and Afghanistan - this is the geography of product supplies, a third of which is exported. There is demand, which means that young people, choosing a technical specialty, can be calm about their future.
en.У Сайдуллы Кожабаева, начинающего предпр: Saidulla Kozhabayev, an aspiring entrepreneur who took over management of the plant in the crisis year of 1997, did not have such confidence. Even with his leadership experience and business skills, he had to think hard before taking on such a burden. Hard work and leadership experience helped make the decision. After graduating from high school in Turkestan, he went to work as a turner in a depot. After serving in the army, he put on his overalls again and went to work at the Achpolimetal plant. He wanted and was able to work, readily agreeing to overtime hours, and unconditionally accepted the need to go to production on a day off.
en.Трудолюбию Сайдулла Кожабаев был приучен: Saidulla Kozhabayev was accustomed to hard work from childhood. The family of a school director and a housewife had ten children. There was no way to care for everyone. All seven sons performed household and household responsibilities without question. Saidulla was the leader among the brothers, initiating the improvement of the local area and other economic affairs that would always be found in the village. It is not surprising that his business acumen and organizational skills were noticed by his superiors, who soon appointed him as the head of the workshop.
en.– Директор комбината «Ачполиметалл» Сах: “The director of the Achpolimetal plant, Sakh Maulenkulov, was and remains an example of a leader for me,” recalls Saidulla Ilyasovich. – I was impressed by his style: balanced, serious, never raising his voice. The production, which was resounding with records of high-speed penetration by miners, matched it. I wanted to be like my idol, and I am grateful to fate for bringing me together with such a person.
en.Эти уроки он не единожды вспомнит, когда: He will remember these lessons more than once when he heads one of the workshops of the asbestos cement plant in Shymkent. During the collapse of the Union, its leaders were faced with the task of mastering market relations, finding consumers, and learning to make money. Saidulla Kozhabayev succeeded. Having quickly rebuilt production, they survived. Although not everyone was able to get their bearings back then, which led to the stagnation of many large plants and factories.
en.На грани банкротства оказался и Кентауск: The Kentau Transformer Plant, where Saidulla Kozhabayev came to buy transformers, was also on the verge of bankruptcy. In his hands was a heavy bag full of money - cash was in short supply at that time. On payday, workers were given water heaters and other goods received through barter. The wage debt reached 13 million tenge, overdue payments to the local and republican budgets were twice as high as this amount, and accounts payable alone accumulated 120 million tenge.
en.Конечно, содержимое баула предпринимател: Of course, the contents of the entrepreneur’s trunk were not able to cover all these debts, but they could partially solve the problems of the enterprise. That day, Saidulla Ilyasovich never got an appointment with the retired director: the head of the plant refused to accept him, citing being busy.
en.Просидев в приемной до конца рабочего дн: After sitting in the waiting room until the end of the working day, he went for a walk around the city, sadly noting the gloomy changes along the way. The city had become dilapidated, ugly outbuildings were visible, the cinema had turned into a restaurant. The small shoe store brought back poignant memories. How long ago it was, but my memory still preserves that story from childhood!
en.…В четвертом классе родители отдали сына: ...In the fourth grade, parents sent their son to a boarding school in Kentau. It was difficult to support children, but the state fed them, provided them with school supplies, and clothed them with shoes. At the boarding school, the boy became friends with a peer, whose mother came to visit him one spring. A friend asked her to take Saidulla with her to the city. The route of the walk ran through a shoe store. Mom was choosing shoes for his friend; the old ones were completely worn out. He was briskly running around the store, trying on one pair after another. Saidulla carefully examined his shoes, which were just as “asking for porridge.” “Apay, which ones should I try on?” – he asked naively, being sure that a new thing was waiting for him too. The woman asked him to wait outside, giving him a couple of candies. But he returned to the store again, looking trustingly into her eyes until she snapped: “You don’t have enough money.”
en.Детская обида занозой засела в памяти. О: Childhood resentment stuck in my memory like a thorn. Throughout his life, he often mentally returned to that situation, giving himself the attitude to work and work so as not to need anything. So this time, instructing young people, he said that only work can make a person successful and professionally wealthy.
en.Тогда, задержавшись у витрины обувного м: Then, lingering at the window of a shoe store, Saidulla Kozhabayev involuntarily thought about the children of the plant employees, who had not seen their salaries for months. And how do they live, how do they support their families?!
en.Через короткое время он уже принимал дел: After a short time, he was already taking over work at the plant. Saidulla Ilyasovich took up crisis management to get him off his knees. A new era has begun in the history of the plant. It was a difficult but interesting period of life. There have been fundamental changes in the organization of labor and marketing, and the development of in-demand electrical products made in Kazakhstan. We have established cooperation with national companies. With the advent of working capital, it became possible to introduce innovative technologies; old machines were replaced with new, highly productive ones. The technical update affected all production departments.
en.Впервые в истории Казахстана коллектив з: For the first time in the history of Kazakhstan, the plant’s staff mastered and established the production of electrical machines with a voltage of 35–110 kV, with a capacity of up to 63 thousand kVA. Their development was carried out by the design bureau on its own. The latest technological equipment - horizontal winding machines, machines for the production and processing of insulating parts and others - made it possible to master the production of copper wires and crimping windings. In the metalworking shop, about 90% of components and parts made of metal are already produced independently. This significantly reduced the cost of finished transformers - by almost 20%.
en.Завод имеет статус градообразующего и на: The plant has the status of a city-forming and tax-forming enterprise, which solves many social problems of the single-industry town. Thanks to the state program “Business Road Map 2020”, the enterprise is operating at full capacity, with 1,230 employees working in three shifts.
en.Последние 16 лет были очень продуктивным: The last 16 years have been very productive. Saidulla Kozhabayev breathed life into more than one plant. He founded a holding company, uniting previously disparate enterprises in the mechanical engineering industry under a single brand, Alageum Electric. Today it includes the PromEnergo design institute, factories for the production of electrical products, and electrical installation departments of JSC ELMO in all regional centers.
en.Конкурентные преимущества позволили холд: Competitive advantages allowed the holding to occupy its niche in the global Eurasian electricity market. Alageum Electric intends to expand exports to Europe and Asia. The prerequisites for this are real. In 2010–2012 alone, supply volumes to the Russian Federation increased 5.5 times!
en.– Мы гордимся, что нам удалось создать у: “We are proud that we managed to create a successful and sustainable national brand,” says Saidulla Kozhabayev. – Alageum Electric has become the innovative core of electrical engineering. In such a complex high-tech industry, this was not easy. By building the Ural Transformer Plant, we are bringing complex, high-tech production closer to Russia for the development of cross-border trade. We are implementing the same project in Shymkent. These measures will take the industry to a new level and strengthen the export potential of the state, its energy and economic security. And in the words of the President of the Republic, who noted with satisfaction that the country’s economy has grown and now Kazakhstan exports not only oil, but also engineering products, there is our modest contribution. Without the support of the Head of State N. Nazarbayev, this would have been impossible to achieve. Previously, this could only be a dream, and, frankly, we envied entrepreneurs in European countries and China, where government benefits, preferences, and borrowed funds with a low interest rate were provided. Our dreams have come true, and now we just need to work and advance engineering progress.
en.Сайдулла Ильясович гордится и тем, что и: Saidulla Ilyasovich is also proud that they managed to restore the prestige of the engineering profession, creating social space for young people, including those from the rural hinterland, inspiring them with the idea of ​​the value of engineering. Personnel are the main asset of the company and an object for investment. That is why the company took staff training seriously, sending them to training and providing social support.
en.Для молодых специалистов выдаются льготы: Housing benefits are provided for young professionals, career growth and the desire to improve their skills are stimulated. Alageum Electric, like other Kazakhstani manufacturers, is entering the global economy. There is fierce competition ahead with world-class companies within the WTO. We must prepare for the onslaught of strong competitors. Saidulla Ilyasovich believes that domestic entrepreneurs should effectively take advantage of this respite before the “big battle” for sales markets and increase the production of products with a high level of added value.
en.Сегодня ГП ФИИР дает производителям возм: Today, the FIID State Enterprise gives manufacturers the opportunity to modernize production, master the production of competitive products in order to successfully confront new economic challenges. Otherwise, a sharp increase in imports could hurt national production. After all, in a matter of years, the current protectionist instruments in the form of preferential subsidies, tariff, tax and customs preferences, and other anti-dumping and compensatory measures to protect national producers-exporters will become a thing of the past.
en.К чести компании, Alageum Electric серье: To the company’s credit, Alageum Electric is seriously preparing for the upcoming challenges, speeding up the release of innovative products and promoting them to foreign markets. The company is not entering the big economy empty-handed. The experience of such talented entrepreneurs as Saidulla Kozhabayev, whom I would compare to a worker bee carrying life-giving honey, is worthy of support and imitation, because this is economic patriotism, which involves the unification of entrepreneurs around the idea of ​​​​building real independence of the country through the revival of national production.
en.Кентауский политехнический колледж в это: This year, Kentau Polytechnic College plans to graduate the first 43 students, specialists in the field of electrical energy and economics, who will join the team of the Alageum Electric holding.
en.Основной контингент обучающихся - школьн: The main contingent of students are schoolchildren from the city of Kentau, Turkestan and other regions of the South Kazakhstan region and the Kyzylorda region. College staff and students are doing a lot of career guidance work today - after all, the time for a new admission of applicants will soon come. Therefore, according to plan, meetings of the CCP campaign group with students from city schools are taking place.
en.День открытых дверей прошел на днях для: An open day was held the other day for graduates of schools No. 16 and 22. During the excursion to KTZ, the children did not hide their admiration for the vastness of modern workshops they saw, introduced into the production of European equipment “STOLBERG” Germany, “LAE” Italy, “TUBOLY” Switzerland, “SOENEN” Belgium. They met the young workers of the plant, who easily manage these production lines and have technical knowledge.
en.- Я даже не знал, что такие современные: - I didn’t even know that such modern technologies were introduced at the plant in our city. This is just great! We are pleasantly surprised and happy! I think that many of today’s schoolchildren, after completing their studies at the KPK, will come to work at the plant.
en.В роли экскурсовода в Дне открытых двере: The head of OKiS Nurbol Tlemisov acted as a guide at the Open Day. He said that in terms of technical equipment, the Kentau Transformer Plant is in no way inferior to factories in Germany. The equipment at the enterprises is similar.
en.Директор колледжа Серик Айтуреев поздрав: College director Serik Aytureev congratulated the guys on the holiday, noting that the college is an important structural division of the Alageum Electric company, which pays great attention to the education and training of young specialists. If previously it was necessary to organize meetings with university graduates in electrical engineering and invite them to work, today the situation has changed. The company took the training of specialists into its own hands, giving students the opportunity to consolidate their theoretical knowledge directly in production - in the workshops of the Kentau Transformer Plant.
en.В торжественной обстановке 16 успешных с: In a solemn ceremony, 16 successful students were the first of the 185 first-year students of the KPK to receive student cards and grade books. The director of the college presented the newly elected President of the Student Council Abylai Tasbolatov and the Prime Minister of the college Sultan Yusupov with the corresponding certificates. The ES-1-12 group, which won the open mini-football tournament, was awarded the CPC Challenge Cup.
en.На праздничном концерте в честь Дня студ: At the festive concert in honor of Student’s Day, Abilov Alisher, Konarbaev Adilet, Polatov Meirzhan, Nurtai Beybarys delighted with their talents. And according to tradition, the celebration ended with a student disco.
en.Современное здание могут посещать более: The modern building can be visited by more than 3 thousand children daily. There are about 50 clubs here where children can develop their skills in hydroponics, astronautics, nanotechnology and aircraft modeling.
en.Для энергоснабжения нового дворца школьн: To supply power to the new schoolchildren’s palace, the Alageum Electric team installed a transformer substation in a block-modular building. The substation is equipped with two transformers with a power of 1000 kVA and a voltage of 10 kV. The equipment was manufactured by the Kentau Transformer Plant.
en.Два силовых масляных трансформатора типа: Two power oil transformers of the type TDTN-16000/110 U1 16,000 kVA went to Ukraine. The equipment was produced by the Kentau Transformer Plant. The delivery facility 110/10 kV substation is located in the Belotserkovsky district of the Kyiv region.
en.Трансформатор силовой масляный трехфазны: Three-phase, three-winding power oil transformer is designed to convert electrical energy of alternating current voltage class 110 kV into electrical energy of voltage class 35 kV of medium voltage and voltage class of 6 or 10 kV of low voltage.
en.Климатическое исполнение У-1 позволяет э: Climatic modification U-1 allows the equipment to be operated outdoors exposed to any atmospheric factors. The use of the TDN 16000 kVA transformer allows us to provide the consumer with reliable power supply throughout the entire service life.
en.- Марат Абдулазизович, какие планы у ХК: - Marat Abdulazizovich, what are the plans of HC Alageum for 2014? Have they undergone adjustments in the current conditions?
en.- На нынешний год у нас запланирована се: - We have a serious regional development program for the company planned for this year. These are investment projects under the auspices of the State Enterprise FIID, which have found support at the highest level. Their validity comes from in-depth analysis and knowledge of the market, taking into account our experience and capabilities. I will name the largest objects. First of all, this is the construction of a plant for the production of power transformers of 6 and 10 kV voltage class in Uralsk, the launch is planned in the third quarter of this year.
en.Следующий стратегический проект, начатый: The next strategic project we started is “Construction of a plant for the production of power transformers with a capacity of up to 250 MVA with a voltage class of 110 and 220 kV in Shymkent. Another project is related to the state program for the development of single-industry towns - 2020: on the basis of Kentau we plan to master and establish the production of vacuum and SF6 circuit breakers, current and voltage transformers, RGP disconnectors for voltages of 10, 35, 110 kV. Thanks to the development of these products, the production rate of Kazakhstan's own content of substation equipment for voltages of 10, 35, 110 kV will exceed 95%. This is a very serious breakthrough, which we can rightfully be proud of.
en.Особенность этих проектов в их долгосроч: The peculiarity of these projects is their long-term focus on the sustainable growth of the regional economy. New enterprises will create new jobs, large-scale production will give a multiplier effect to local small and medium-sized businesses in the formation of local industry, and, most importantly, in non-resource sectors of the economy.
en.При составлении проектно-сметной докумен: When drawing up design estimates for these objects, of course, no one could have predicted a change in the exchange rate, which, naturally, would affect the financial component of the projects. But we are determined to move on. Because these industries are vital for boosting the regional economy. We are ready for their implementation, and we assumed in advance that there would be difficulties with preferences and overcoming bureaucratic obstacles. Now we are working with domestic relevant ministries, sectoral coordinators, we feel a counter interested movement from the akimats of regions and cities, and most importantly - the support of the government. Joint mechanisms for overcoming a difficult situation are being developed, certain aspects are being adjusted, some things are being delayed, some things are being accelerated, in general, this is a normal work process. So the company is working as usual and moving towards its goal confidently.
en.- Производственные мощности предприятий: - The production capacities of the Holding’s enterprises allow us to continue to work effectively within the framework of the programs “Business Road Map”, “Development of Single-Industry Towns for 2012-2020”, in the “2nd Stage of the Regional Development Program for 2013-2020”, “Affordable Housing 2020”, “Modernization of Housing and Communal Services 2020”, “Ak Bulak 2020”.
en.То есть у нас есть много точек для прило: That is, we have many points for the application of strength, a wealth of experience, and potential opportunities. So this year will be a year of hard work.
en.- Хотелось бы узнать ваше мнение по пово: - I would like to know your opinion on an article published in one of the republican newspapers, predicting increased competition in the domestic electrical engineering market with the expected arrival of the SVEL company and, accordingly, a worsening in this regard of the position of Alageum Holding Company.
en.- Чем дальше мы будем входить в глобальн: - The further we enter the global electricity market, the fiercer the struggle for the sales market will be. I would call it the dramaturgy of business. I believe that this phenomenon should be treated philosophically. We are talking about competition, for which we are ready technologically, economically, and above all psychologically. Our enterprises have created the necessary margin of safety, which allows us to soberly assess our capabilities, analyze the situation, and adjust our business processes. And, of course, don’t relax. We have been working in these harsh conditions for many years, and everything that we have managed to achieve is due, among other things, to this driving force. We knew about the upcoming competition when joining the Customs Union, preparing to join an even more powerful club of global producers within the WTO. And we didn’t sit idly by all these years.
en.Что касается наших российских коллег, то: As for our Russian colleagues, we treat them with respect. All of us involved in such a complex business as electrical engineering, unfortunately, depend on many objective factors, the realities of a large economy. The world economy is a capricious lady, with a tough temper and changeable mood. There is no doubt about its possible surprises in light of recent events. So both Kazakh and Russian manufacturers experience the same difficulties, and in such dramatic moments they cannot do without the support of their states.
en.Палата предпринимателей Атырауской облас: The Chamber of Entrepreneurs of the Atyrau Region entered into an agreement with the ELMO enterprise on the employment of 30 college graduates with a degree in electrical installation.
en.Первые четыре молодых специалиста уже по: The first four young specialists have already gotten acquainted with the place of their future work and tried on their overalls.
en.По словам заместителя директора местной: According to the deputy director of the local Chamber of Entrepreneurs, Nurzhan Ganimuratuly, during the implementation of plans for the employment of graduates at the said enterprise, two main difficulties arose - in some cases, this is the discrepancy between the age (which must be at least 18 years old) and, oddly enough, the psychological unpreparedness of applicants for work. If 18 years is a legal requirement in the field of safety, then the second problem was that a graduate who got a job literally ran away from work within a few days! He justified himself by saying that it was hard for him to work like that, he was not used to it. One day, a parent took her son away with a scandal, saying that he would not be a worker, this was not for him. Despite the fact that employment was preceded by the conclusion of an agreement between the enterprise and the college administration, the young man was officially hired, with all the ensuing consequences.
en.Руководитель предприятия Арман Жарылгасо: The head of the enterprise, Arman Zharylgasov, notes that, as it turned out, some guys are absolutely not ready for a working profession, despite the fact that they are trained in this specialty. He is confident that high school students need psychological preparation for their future profession both at home and in college.
en.Также руководство данного предприятия по: Also, the management of this enterprise agreed to the proposal of the Chamber of Entrepreneurs to participate in the dual training system. There is an agreement that they will provide energy college students with practical classes on the 2+4 principle, where theory will be given 2 hours, practice - 4. According to Nurzhan Ganimuratula, this is the first positive response from a local enterprise.
en.- Для трудоустройства молодых специалист: - To employ young specialists, I meet with the heads of 3-4 enterprises every day, and, unfortunately, I mostly hear refusals for various reasons. This enterprise is ready to teach practical work skills to college graduates with a mandatory salary. In addition, each graduate will be provided with new overalls.
en.«ЭЛМО» готово трудоустроить 30 электромо: ELMO is ready to employ 30 electricians. Today we found ten 18-year-old young specialists from the city, the rest we decided to recruit from regional lyceums. We think that rural children, having received a job in their specialty, will appreciate this benefit and become conscientious specialists,” says Nurzhan.
en.По его словам, в городе работают 6 тысяч: According to him, 6 thousand business entities operate in the city, 300 of which are large businesses. They have real potential for teaching graduates practical skills in their specialty, but, unfortunately, their management adheres to the principle “my house is on the edge.” Since the beginning of his work in this direction, he has met with the heads of about a hundred large enterprises, but the result is sad. Out of 10 Kazakh companies, only 3 respond positively to organizing internships; of the same number of foreign companies, seven give consent. However, with the caveat that without wages and appropriate conditions as employees. For example, one employer even refused to feed trainees in a common canteen, despite the fact that the facility is located in an area remote from the city...
en.Развитие Smart City, искусственного инте: The development of Smart City, artificial intelligence, data centers and digital services directly depends on reliable energy infrastructure. Smart management systems for utilities, lighting and security can only operate with a stable and uninterrupted power supply, which ensures the functioning of cloud platforms, data centers and smart city services.
en.В Центральной Азии такую энергетическую: In Central Asia, such an energy basis is formed by the Alageum Electric group of companies, one of the largest manufacturers of electrical equipment in the region. The company's modern transformers and digital substations ensure the stability of energy networks and create the basis for the development of the digital economy. It is on these technologies that the infrastructure is built, which makes the full development of Smart City possible.
en.В этом контексте особое внимание уделяет: In this context, special attention is paid to modern solutions in the field of transformer equipment and smart grids. Energy-efficient transformers are becoming one of the key elements of the infrastructure of the digital economy. Engineers from the Kentau Transformer Plant, part of the Alageum Electric group of companies, are developing equipment that ensures the stable operation of smart cities and smart energy grids.
en.Одной из важнейших разработок предприяти: One of the most important developments of the enterprise was a line of innovative transformers of the TMGiN type with a power from 25 to 2500 kVA. The use of modern materials and technological solutions can significantly reduce no-load and short circuit losses. This increases the efficiency of electrical networks and ensures reliable energy supply to digital economy facilities.
en.Эффективность таких решений подтверждает: The effectiveness of such solutions is confirmed by comparison with standard transformers of the previous generation. For example, when comparing a standard transformer TMG-630 and an energy-efficient transformer TMGiN-630 with a voltage regulation system under load, a significant reduction in energy losses is observed.
en.Потери холостого хода снижаются с 1230 В: No-load losses are reduced from 1230 W to 486 W, a reduction of more than 60%. Short circuit losses are reduced from 9350 W to 4283 W, that is, by more than 54%.
en.Такое снижение потерь напрямую влияет на: This reduction in losses directly affects the economic efficiency of equipment operation. The lower the energy loss in the transformer, the lower the energy costs for consumers and energy companies. On a power system scale, this can significantly improve the energy efficiency of networks and reduce the overall level of energy consumption.
en.Следующий этап развития энергетики - пер: The next stage in the development of energy is the transition from traditional equipment to digital and intelligent substations, which make it possible to manage energy networks in real time.
en.Одним из таких решений стал трансформато: One of these solutions was the TMGiN transformer, equipped with a voltage regulation system under load, automatic regulation ECOTAP and digital monitoring. The equipment automatically maintains stable voltage when the load changes, and also provides remote monitoring and operational management of the network.
en.Развитие цифровых подстанций требует не: The development of digital substations requires not only intelligent equipment, but also systems for continuous monitoring of the technical condition of energy facilities.
en.Инженерами Alageum Electric и трансформа: Engineers from Alageum Electric and the Asia Trafo transformer plant, with the support of Science Fund JSC, implemented a project to develop and produce a digital system for continuous monitoring of substation equipment.
en.В результате этой работы в Казахстане ра: As a result of this work, a domestic centralized system for continuous monitoring of transformers was developed and implemented in Kazakhstan. The solution allows you to monitor the technical condition of equipment in real time directly during its normal operation without shutting down substations and stopping the power supply.
en.Система обеспечивает постоянный сбор и а: The system provides continuous collection and analysis of data on the operation of transformers. This allows you to promptly identify potential faults, prevent emergency situations and significantly increase the reliability of power supply. To date, there are no similar domestically produced solutions in Kazakhstan.
en.Проект успешно доведен до промышленного: The project was successfully brought to an industrial result. As part of the grant funding, a full cycle of work was implemented - from research development to production and commercialization of the product. The system is already in mass production and is used at substations of the 220–500 kV voltage class, including existing energy infrastructure facilities.
en.Экономический эффект проекта также являе: The economic effect of the project is also significant. The cost of domestic development is 30–40% lower than foreign analogues. The implementation of the system makes it possible to reduce the breakdown rate of equipment, reduce operating costs of energy companies and increase the technological independence of the energy industry. Production and servicing of the system is carried out on the territory of Kazakhstan, which further reduces the dependence of the energy sector on imported solutions.
en.Энергетическая цифровизация не ограничив: Energy digitalization is not limited to equipment modernization. An important area is the implementation of intelligent power system management systems.
en.В этом направлении работает ТОО « Уральс: Ural Transformer Plant LLP, also part of the Alageum Electric group of companies, is working in this direction. The company is implementing a project to predict solar electricity production using artificial intelligence technologies and has received grant funding from the Science Foundation JSC.
en.С ростом доли возобновляемых источников: With the growing share of renewable energy sources, accurate generation forecasting becomes critical. Solar energy depends on weather conditions, and intelligent data analysis systems allow more efficient planning of power plants and management of energy networks.
en.Проект реализуется на базе ТОО «Уральски: The project is being implemented on the basis of Ural Transformer Plant LLP, which acts as a grant recipient and executor. In the future, the developed solutions are planned to be implemented at energy facilities in Kazakhstan and other countries in the region.
en.Таким образом, развитие энергоэффективны: Thus, the development of energy-efficient transformers, digital substations, monitoring systems and intelligent technologies for managing energy networks forms the technological basis of the digital economy. This infrastructure becomes the foundation for smart cities, sustainable energy and high-tech services of the future.
en.В беспрецедентном проекте - строительств: In an unprecedented project - the construction of the first large wind power station in the Republic of Kazakhstan in the Akmola region, along with foreign companies, the Kazakh electrical holding Alageum Electric is also participating.
en.Объект строится по поручению Главы госуд: The facility is being built on behalf of the Head of State for the World Exhibition “EXPO-2017” and sets the task of turning the capital of Kazakhstan into a clean, energy-efficient “green” city through the use of alternative energy sources.
en.Рассказывает руководитель проекта, дирек: Askar Shalkharov, project manager, director of the Alageum Electric JSC branch in Astana, says:
en.- Промышленная электроэнергия, выработан: - Industrial electricity generated by the Ereymentau Wind Farm will provide power supply to Astana and the EXPO exhibition facilities. High wind loads in the Ereymentau area make it possible to use wind energy to produce electricity on an industrial scale. Using wind masts, additional research is being carried out on the area's wind park, measuring its direction and power - this will make it possible to connect new installations to expand the station's potential to 300 MW.
en.Первые 6-7 ветровых электроустановок гот: The first 6-7 wind power plants are ready to be launched by Astana’s birthday. By October, all the other 22 “mills” will spin their blades high in the sky in Ereymentau. Each one is one hundred meters high, the circumference of the blade in a turn is 40 meters. Such a powerful and spectacular complex will generate industrial electricity of 45 MW. The implementation of the project, included in the regional industrialization map, will provide electricity generation in the amount of 172.2 GWh per year.
en.Промышленная электроэнергия, полученная: Industrial electricity generated from the wind farm will be fed into the general system of the nationwide KEGOC power grid.
en.- Нам доверено строительство центральног: - We have been entrusted with the construction of a central power center - a 220/35 kV substation. This is the engineering brain of the entire complex, where the generated electricity will “flow,” says Askar Khamanovich. – The facility includes an operational control center building, a 35 kV closed switchgear, a 220 kV outdoor switchgear with a 63 MVA transformer, a 35 kV block-modular building, produced by the Kentau Transformer Plant. Kazakh content of all wind farm equipment will be about 35 percent. The products of domestic manufacturers in this large project compete on equal terms with global manufacturers such as SIEMENS, Alstom, ABB and others.
en.Ход работ на этом чрезвычайной важности: The progress of work on this extremely important facility from the Alageum Electric company is controlled by the technical director of the branch of Alageum Electric JSC in Astana, Kuat Soltanov. Here's what he says:
en.- Наше участие в строительстве ВЭС начал: - Our participation in the construction of wind farms began in April 2014. We carry out all construction and installation work on a turnkey basis, incl. work on all engineering networks, oil facilities, substation fire extinguishing system and other work. An international team is working on the construction of the wind farm complex. Working alongside us are Russian designers, German and Ukrainian installers, and suppliers of various equipment from foreign countries. The stage-by-stage progress of work at the site, where power engineers of the Astana branch of the Alageum Electric company work, is supervised by experts from the famous French company BETEN.
en.Мы гордимся, что нам доверен один из сам: We are proud that we have been entrusted with one of the most critical areas of the project, which carries a large engineering and intellectual load. en.«Для Alageum Electric поддержка казахско: “For Alageum Electric, supporting the Kazakh language is one of the important areas of social responsibility. That is why we provide this support on a systematic and ongoing basis. For 30 years, the company has been developing the domestic industry. However, success is measured not only by production indicators. Supporting education, developing human capital and contributing to the development of the Kazakh language are investments in the future of the country. Guided by these principles, we supported the initiative of the Head of State and provided support to the Qazaq Tili Endowment for the second time. We see that the fund operates openly and is already demonstrating concrete results. It is precisely this kind of systemic support that is necessary to improve the status of the Kazakh language and implement large-scale projects. Business must contribute not only to the development of the economy, but also to the development of society,” said Erkebulan Ilyasov, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Alageum Electric group of companies. .
en.«Повторная поддержка фонда Qazaq Tili En: "The re-support of the Qazaq Tili Endowment fund by the Alageum Electric group of companies is a great responsibility for us. This is evidence of confidence in the work of the Foundation and a common desire to develop the state language. Thanks to such a stable partnership, we are consistently implementing large-scale projects aimed at expanding the scope of the Kazakh language. en.Основной принцип работы фонда Qazaq Tili: The main operating principle of the Qazaq Tili Endowment is that funds received by the fund are not spent. All transferred funds are transferred in full to the investment management, and projects aimed at developing the Kazakh language are financed exclusively from investment income.
en.В 2024 году в эндаумент-фонд было привле: In 2024, 503,669,299 tenge were attracted to the endowment fund, and investment income amounted to 75,473,020 tenge. In 2025, the volume of investment income reached 80 million tenge. Thus, over the past two years, the total income from the fund’s investment activities exceeded 155,000,000 tenge. Currently, the volume of the endowment fund has reached 824,000,000 tenge.
en.За счет инвестиционного дохода в 2023–20: At the expense of investment income in 2023-2025, more than 60 projects and events of the regional, republican and international levels aimed at the development of the Kazakh language were implemented. en.Деятельность фонда находится под постоян: The activities of the fund are under the constant control of the Board of Founders, to which reports on financial results and work done are submitted on a regular basis. en.К примеру, с 2018 по 2023 годы «Alageum: For example, from 2018 to 2023, Alageum Electric financed the design developments of the TRENCO R&D center in the amount of over 1 billion tenge. en.АЛМАТЫ. КАЗИНФОРМ - Каждый управленец ра: ALMATY. KAZINFORM - Every manager sooner or later is faced with the need to increase the efficiency of the team and optimize business processes. You can get ahead in the economy and production, but if you don’t raise personnel to this level, then there will be no sense, says Khairulla Kozhabayev, General Director of Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP (AEMZ).
en.Ровно год назад, в июле 2013 года, его п: Exactly a year ago, in July 2013, his company began implementing the Kaizen system. The head of the company told a Kazinform correspondent about the results of this experiment.
en.- Почувствовав остроту этой проблемы, мы: - Feeling the urgency of this problem, we decided to take the path of training workers, using production meetings, trainings, and courses aimed at uniting the team according to the principle “We see together, we know together, we act together.” In this sense, we were attracted to the Kaizen system, the philosophy of the Japanese “small village”, where helping each other is elevated to a way of life. This is surprisingly projected onto large companies: Toyota helps Mazda, Mazda helps someone else. As one part of the Alageum Electric holding company, we, like everyone else, should feel like we are sailing on the same ship.
en.Система японского менеджмента «Кайдзен»: The Japanese Kaizen management system teaches us to subordinate the personal interests of employees to the interests of improving production processes, the climate in the team, and the desire to work for the benefit of the company. The employee’s thinking and approaches to corporate values ​​have changed: you are on our team, you cannot let the team down.
en.Определив цели и задачи, изучив теорию,: Having defined goals and objectives and studied the theory, we began with the process of mapping specific workshops and areas. Having divided the production area into zones, we created diagrams indicating workplaces and equipment locations. Along the way, it turned out that anti-kaizen reigned at every step. We started by introducing standards for step-by-step actions to maintain order. The workers got down to basic things - they sorted hardware into groups, sorted tools, and got rid of trash. We eliminated unproductive intermediate movements by making shelving and new stands for tools. It became easy to take, easy to use, easy to put back in place. Reasonable simplification freed up time, eliminated searches, and introduced convenience.
en.Но не все шло как по маслу. На этапе ада: But not everything went smoothly. At the adaptation stage, some staff resistance to change was felt. It was like this: two brigades - two completely different approaches. I had to fight inertia, teach people to live according to a standardized order: problem - responsible person - deadline. Thus, red boards with the catchy inscription “problem” appeared in the workshops to record emerging operational issues and resolve them as soon as possible. Color zoning of areas has been introduced. Countless wires disappeared from under my feet. The workers were delighted with the rational and simple solution of using wheeled carts to carry and lift heavy loads. I think - how did they not think of this before?
en.Изучив технологическую цепочку, перемест: Having studied the technological chain, we moved the machines, everything that was lying under our feet found its place on the racks. Production was built into a flow, a logical cycle.
en.Так, в кратчайшее время мы внедрили блиц: Thus, in the shortest possible time we introduced blitz-kaizen in production and in departments. At the entrance to each office there were diagrams with photos, names, positions of managers, and the place occupied. For the convenience of visitors, arrows pointing to key departments were painted on the floor in the corridor. Even such a small thing as an inclined dash line pasted on the spines of storage folders made the absence of one of them noticeable. So each folder now has its own place. These techniques of visual management with symbols organized the documentation and disciplined the attitude towards it.
en.Система кайдзен включает пять взаимосвяз: The Kaizen system includes five interrelated principles of workplace organization, visual control and lean manufacturing. Each has its own Japanese name starting with the letter "S". So, “Seiri” - to separate necessary items (tools, parts, materials, documents) from unnecessary ones, to get rid of the latter; “Seiton” - carefully arrange the rest, placing each item in its place; "Seiso" - maintain cleanliness; "Seiketsu" - to be careful, "Shitsuke" - to adhere to discipline...
en.Философия малозатратного, успешного, бер: The philosophy of low-cost, successful, lean production implies the implementation by each employee of these five simple rules that do not require the use of new management technologies. This increases labor productivity, enterprise profits and, accordingly, the income level of workers. The process followed a logical chain: adoption of the system, establishing order, delegation of responsibility, regularity of actions and control, consolidation of procedures, strengthening of requirements. The pinnacle of philosophy is constant improvement.
en.Что это дает на практике? На наших глаза: What does this mean in practice? Before our eyes, the team is becoming involved in the process of continuous improvement; through the introduction of template standards, time wastage is eliminated and work organization is improved. Both production culture and relationships between people became the object of improvement. For example, we raised the status of a technician to a cleaning manager. And this was received with gratitude.
en.Ни одно производство не обходится без пр: No production is without problems. The more complex the tasks, the greater the likelihood of problems occurring. Kaizen has changed our view of them as a chance for development. No wonder the Japanese say: “Welcome problems. Problems are a mountain of wealth”... No one is immune from mistakes; lessons must be learned from them. It is important to find out why the failure occurred? And not to look for the culprit, but to find the reason for his mistake. If you take it out on him, it will be the last time you get honest information about what's going on.
en.Пересмотрев график совещаний, мы отвели: Having reviewed the schedule of meetings, we allocated strictly defined time and clear topics for each meeting. At planning meetings there is no former clarification of relationships, where and which service has not worked properly - today these are meetings of a training nature. Boring reports were replaced by discussions of current issues through the eyes of the seller and buyer, making each employee feel like an equal partner of the company.
en.После работы все у нас заняты обучением: After work, we are all busy with training - starting with English (two groups according to level of knowledge) and by profile (laws of hydraulics, mechanics, pneumatics, etc.), ISO, standards of technological and work processes, labor safety. Many signed up for public speaking classes, expressing a desire to learn the ability to express their thoughts, persuade, and speak competent language.
en.Кайдзен хорошо лег на почву, подготовлен: Kaizen laid well on the ground prepared by the ISO-9001 quality management system. If ISO structures processes by creating functional instructions, then kaizen has created the prerequisites for employee involvement. This is the highest stage, when changes become irreversible and permanent. Now I am completely sure that the success of any enterprise depends on the unity of its team.
en.Мы, производственники, часто используем: We, production workers, often use military terms such as “headquarters”, “work front”, etc. After all, a business process is the same as military operations. Just like in war, within the team you encounter traitors and deserters. But most people’s eyes sparkle - for the sake of their desire to work, it is necessary to create a comfortable psychological climate. The director should be the locomotive behind which the cars are lined up. If the manager presses on the gas, then the result will be, if not, then there is no point in starting.
en.Думаю, у подобных систем, как кайдзен, б: I think that systems like kaizen have a great future. By joining the WTO club, we must learn and adopt experience in optimizing business processes and generally accepted standards. Improvement is progress, development. And by changing the algorithm of actions, we are working not with cutting costs, which can lead to a decrease in product quality, but with reducing losses.
en.Основатель Кайдзен-Института Масааки Има: The founder of the Kaizen Institute, Masaaki Imai, believes that most of the currently existing companies (up to 80%) will disappear in the coming decades if they do not change the production management system. It's never too late to implement the Kaizen system. And here I will again refer to the saying “No one can go back in time and change his start, but everyone can start now and change his finish.”

en.«На заводе применены новейшие системы уп: “The plant uses the latest production management systems, which provide continuous access to information about each transformer produced, from the stage of development of design documentation to shipment and service.
