en.В настоящее время в рамках строительных: Currently, as part of the construction work at the production site, installation of equipment has been completed. A radial drilling machine “R60” and “R100” from the German company KNUTH was installed. The line for longitudinal and transverse cutting of electrical steel Tuboly-Asronic from Switzerland has been prepared for installation and is awaiting the arrival of the chief engineer, and work is also underway on the installation of vacuum drying chambers MicaVac (Germany), designed for drying active parts of transformers in solvent vapors. Such chambers reduce the duration of the process by 1.5-2 times, remove moisture from the insulation as much as possible, and increase the average service life of transformers. The construction of an oil purification station and an oil pipeline to the assembly shop is also ongoing. Equipment for the testing laboratory manufactured by HIGVOLT, Germany is being installed.
en.В испытательной лаборатории, не имеющей: In the testing laboratory, which has no analogues in Central Asia, a complex of acceptance and type tests will be carried out, which guarantees quality compliance with international standards. In addition to the construction of production, construction is also underway on a five-story dormitory for plant employees. The plant is expected to be operational before the end of 2018.

en.Молодые специалисты Кентауского трансфор: Young specialists of the Kentau Transformer Plant, which is part of the holding company Alageum Electric, in a solemn ceremony received the keys to apartments in a new multi-storey building.
en.Новоселами стали сразу 48 семей предприя: 48 families of the enterprise immediately became new residents - crane operators, assembly engineers, workers. Most of those who received comfortable housing are young families. And this is not surprising, because 80% of all plant employees today are young professionals. Saidulla Kozhabaev, chairman of the supervisory board of the holding company Alageum Electric, made a bet on local personnel a long time ago, clearly realizing that no one would go to work at the plant far away, the personnel must be trained independently, working closely with graduates of Kentau schools. To prepare them, Kentau Polytechnic College was opened several years ago. And in order to retain specialists at the plant, it is necessary to create conditions, including providing them with housing.
en.За последние годы сотрудникам завода был: In recent years, 71 apartments have been issued to plant employees with deferred payment and no interest rates. Young families are provided with assistance in solving their housing problem, in particular, they pay allowances and provide loans for the purchase of housing. The next step in solving the housing problem of the plant’s employees was the purchase of an unfinished house at the beginning of the year. The company completed construction and installation work and finishing at its own expense, distributing apartments among factory workers. The courtyard of the high-rise building was equipped with a modern children's playground so that young mothers would have peace of mind when sending their children for a walk.
en.Сабит Ахимбаев, электрик-схемщик, призна: Sabit Akhimbaev, an electrician and circuit designer, admits that he had been waiting for this day for a long time. His factory experience is ten years. His wife Nurgul has also been working at the company as a winder for five years. The couple are literally glowing with happiness, because now they and 9-month-old Aigan will not have to move from apartment to apartment. 28-year-old Ermek Kudaibergenov, who linked his fate with the transformer plant eight years ago, is also happy. Today he holds the position of designer in the automation department. His wife Indira also works at the company. The Kudaibergenovs came to receive the keys to their apartment together with their one-and-a-half-year-old Adilet. But three-year-old Ayaulym will only be able to see her new home in the evening, when her parents pick her up from kindergarten. And choose a room for yourself, because the family now has three of them at its disposal.
en.Четыре года приходилось снимать жилье и: The family of Azamat Begaliev, whose wife also works at the plant, also had to rent housing for four years. Six years ago, when deciding where to go to work, he chose the Kentau Transformer Plant precisely because he had heard well about the social programs that the company offers its employees. Soon, Azamat’s wife will give birth to a second child, and getting an apartment couldn’t come at a better time. The new residents intend to use the time remaining before the birth to arrange an apartment in which both children and adults will feel comfortable and cozy. And here a one-time maternity benefit in the amount of 150 thousand tenge from the employer, which is paid to every woman who gives birth to a child, will be a good help. And solving everyday problems always allows you to work with full dedication in production.
en.– Можно купить технологии, оборудование,: “You can buy technology, equipment, but not specialists,” Saidulla Kozhabaev is convinced. “They need to be patiently nurtured, trained and prepared, which is what we do.” And if we strive for excellence, strive to stand on par with global transnational companies, then we must constantly improve, take care of our employees and be socially responsible. Our company is interesting not only for its network of unique production facilities and advanced technologies, but also for its team of highly professional specialists. Investments and finance are an important component, but the main factor of success is specialists, whose comprehensive support is our responsibility.
en.В компании поощряют тех, кто ведет здоро: The company encourages those who lead a healthy lifestyle and know foreign languages. Students are given the opportunity to undergo paid internships and are guaranteed employment. A good motivation for high school students when choosing a profession are physics olympiads, which were established by the company, rewarding the winners with a substantial prize. Engineers are given the opportunity to improve their skills, go on business trips abroad, and participate in exhibitions and trainings. To effectively train qualified personnel, a Young Professionals Club was created at the Kentau Transformer Plant in 2009, one of the tasks of which is to identify promising employees who are able to take initiative and take responsibility for decision-making.
en.В период летних каникул для дополнительн: During the summer holidays, paid internships are organized for students of the Kentau Polytechnic College at JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant” for additional industrial training.
en.В пределах компетенции студенты колледжа: Within the limits of their competence, college students work in regular positions, their work experience is calculated, and pension savings are deducted. The Regulations on industrial training of students pay special attention to the dual training system. According to the schedule approved by KTZ JSC, 148 students from 6 study groups were involved in practical classes at the plant this summer. Additional time spent amounted to 3204 hours, which is 57.3% more than provided by the traditional form of training.
en.Ребят радует, что расширились географиче: The guys are glad that the geographical opportunities for deepening their knowledge have expanded. This summer, college students completed on-site internships in all key divisions of Alageum Electric Holding Company. Six of the best students of the electrical engineering specialty went to practice at AEMZ LLP in Almaty. Students studying accounting and analysis completed it on the basis of Alageum Electric in Astana. All conditions were created for students at Nur-Stroy LLP in Turkestan, ShZM LLP, Shymkent branch of Alageum Electric, Yuzhsnab LLP.
en.Отзывы руководителей организаций и предп: Feedback from heads of organizations and enterprises about students’ internships is positive. This is our first experience, we plan to develop it further. We express our gratitude for the opportunity and all possible assistance to all heads of enterprises and organizations of the company who were directly involved in organizing and conducting practical classes for students in production.
en.Особая благодарность генеральному директ: Special thanks to the General Director of AEMZ LLP Almaty Kh.B. Kozhabayev, General Director of Nur-Stroy LLP Turkestan A.S. Aiten, General Director of Yuzhsnab LLP R.I. Kozhabayeva, Director of ShZM LLP Shymkent G.B. Pazilov, General Director of JSC "KTZ" S.N. Kuntuarov and the financial director of JSC "KTZ" O.P. Dotsenko for personal contribution and interested participation in the industrial training of students.
en.На ежегодном совещании Правления Группы: At the annual meeting of the Board of the Alageum Electric Group of Companies, those who daily make our company stronger - representatives of blue-collar professions were honored. Among the awarded were 14 specialists who deserved recognition for their work, professionalism and dedication.
en.Мы гордимся каждым вашим достижением, до: We are proud of your every achievement, dear colleagues, and thank you for your contribution to the development of the company. May this year be a year of new achievements for all our employees
en.II Форум машиностроителей Казахстана, пр: The II Forum of Mechanical Engineers of Kazakhstan, held on October 9-10, 2014 in Astana, discussed issues of effective regulation of the mechanical engineering industry.
en.Организаторы - Министерство индустрии и: The organizers - the Ministry of Industry and New Technologies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Union of Mechanical Engineers of Kazakhstan - determined the main theme of the Forum to be “Mechanical Engineering of Kazakhstan in the Industrialization Program 2015-2019”.
en.Председатель правления АО «Alageum Elect: Chairman of the Board of Alageum Electric JSC Erkebulan Ilyasov spoke at the sectional round table of the Forum with reports “Production and service of electrical appliances in the Republic of Kazakhstan” and “Alageum Electric’s contribution to the development of mechanical engineering in the Republic of Kazakhstan.”
en.- Флагманом холдинга Alageum Electric и: - The flagship of the Alageum Electric holding and the electrical engineering industry of the Republic of Kazakhstan as a whole is the “Kentau Transformer Plant,” noted Erkebulan Saidullaevich. - Over the past 17 years, the plant has increased its total annual income 114 times (up to 100 million dollars), output per person has increased 72 times (up to 77.5 thousand dollars at the current exchange rate). The product line for voltages of 6, 10, 20, 35, 110 kV has increased 17 times and reached more than 350 items. A complete technical re-equipment and modernization of production has been carried out, the scientific potential of the plant is constantly developing, new high-tech products are being mastered, and advanced technologies are being adapted.
en.Е. Ильясов подчеркнул, что в основе успе: E. Ilyasov emphasized that the success of the plant and the enterprise’s ambitious plans for the future are based on a favorable investment climate and intensive government support measures. They provide unique conditions in the form of low interest rates, tax benefits and customs preferences, grants for technology transfer and personnel training.
en.- Понимая исключительную важность ближай: - Understanding the exceptional importance of the next 5-6 years for accelerated modernization and expansion of production capacity on the eve of joining the WTO, where fierce competition with world giants awaits us, we are actively and maximally taking advantage of all available government support measures presented within the framework of the “Business Road Map 2020”, “Productivity 2020”, “Export 2020” programs - emphasized Erkebulan Saidullaevich.
en.Участники Форума обсудили актуальные тем: Forum participants discussed current industry topics in the light of accession to the WTO, EEC, CU, which will affect the competitiveness of the Kazakh mechanical engineering industry, as well as issues of government procurement of engineering products and staffing of mechanical engineering enterprises.
en.Депутаты Мажилиса, члены фракции партии: Mazhilis deputies, members of the Nur Otan party faction Kainar Abasov and Syrym Ertaev noted the importance of state support provided to enterprises, including to overcome the economic consequences of the pandemic. They also discussed legislative norms to support domestic producers.
en.По словам председателя правления Хайрулл: According to the chairman of the board, Khairulla Kozhabayev, receiving preferential loans from the state for the purchase of new equipment under the single-industry towns development program at 1 percent would allow increasing production capacity.
en.В ходе встречи депутаты уделили отдельно: During the meeting, the deputies paid special attention to solving the social needs of the enterprise’s employees. In particular, workers made proposals to reduce the retirement age in general for women working in production.
en.Студенческий Совет Кентауского политехни: The Student Council of Kentau Polytechnic College organized a charity event “Help your neighbor” on the eve of the New Year.
en.Идеи благотворительности председатель ст: The chairman of the student community, Abylai Tasbolatov, gleaned ideas for charity while participating in a three-day seminar in Almaty at the invitation of the Bobek Foundation. Thus was born the desire to organize the Meirim charity foundation. Volunteers began collecting clothes, dishes, furniture, and toys to distribute to low-income families. The college administration supported the initiative of the Student Council - things were distributed to low-income residents of the city living in the outskirts of Shanghai. Thanks to the campaign, many residents purchased clothes and shoes for their families. Young families with many children were especially happy with the useful gifts, choosing clothes, shoes and toys for the children.
en.Студенты колледжа во главе с директором: College students led by the director of the KPK S.A. Aytureev congratulated on New Year’s Eve the labor veterans of the Kentau Transformer Plant, who made their personal contribution to the formation and development of the enterprise. Having received gifts in the form of a set of products, plant veterans Alexandra Stepanovna Dobrenko and Galina Konstantinovna Zagoruiko expressed great gratitude for such touching care and wished the students good studies.
en.На Кентауском трансформаторном заводе со: A rally was held at the Kentau Transformer Plant in support of the candidacy of the current President of the Republic of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev in the upcoming presidential elections.
en.Управляющий директор АО «КТЗ» Хайрулла К: Managing Director of KTZ JSC Khairulla Kozhabayev, opening the meeting, noted that over the years of independence, many production facilities have opened in Kazakhstan. The Kentau Transformer Plant has also received new development, which has grown into a modern high-tech enterprise that produces competitive products and meets high international standards in its technical parameters. The highest point of the team's production achievements was the production of a 63 thousand kV electric megamachine.
en.На сегодняшний день завод является лидер: Today, the plant is a leader in the engineering industry not only in Kazakhstan, but also in Central Asia. The company is developing dynamically: if in 2013, products worth 13 billion 160 million tenge were produced, then in 2014 this figure increased to 16 billion. As part of the program to support single-industry towns, the plant recently opened MonoEleTech LLP to produce corrugated walls for metal structures of oil transformers, which made it possible to create new jobs.
en.Все эти большие дела – результат целенап: All these great things are the result of the targeted policy of the Head of State N.A. Nazarbayev, aimed at fully supporting entrepreneurship and strengthening public-private partnerships.
en.Проведение внеочередных президентских вы: Holding early presidential elections is in the interests of the further forward movement of our state and has a number of objective reasons. The Assembly of the People of Kazakhstan, having taken the initiative, justified the need for them, indicating, among other things, the economic prerequisites that were caused by external factors. Under the leadership of the Head of State, we will have to implement the Nurly Zhol program in the next five years,” noted Khairulla Baydildaevich.
en.В поддержку предстоящих выборов высказал: Production director of KTZ JSC Rashid Shamshiev, deputy director of the Kentau Polytechnic College Talgat Andabay, and young specialist and design engineer Adilbek Tazhibaev also spoke out in support of the upcoming elections.
en.Председатель Клуба молодых лидеров Дарха: Chairman of the Club of Young Leaders Darkhan Duysebekov read an Appeal in which the rally participants, workers and engineers of KTZ JSC, appealed to all labor collectives to support the candidacy of the current President of the Republic of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev in the upcoming extraordinary presidential elections of the Republic of Kazakhstan and to take an active part in the voting.

en.Завод \"Asia Trafo\" подписал меморандум: The Asia Trafo plant signed a memorandum with the social and entrepreneurial corporation “Shymkent” in order to ensure employment of young specialists. The purpose of the meeting was negotiations on attracting technical specialists in the field of “Youth Practice” to paid and social jobs at the expense of the state. Youth practice gives graduates the opportunity to gain first work experience, gain experience and find permanent employment. The practice was organized within the framework of the State Program for Productive Employment and Mass Entrepreneurship for 2017-2021 “Enbek”.
en.Для прохождения практики соискателю необ: To complete the internship, the applicant must contact the employment center of the city of Shymkent and leave an application.
en.В Канун 60 летия города Кентау с целью с: On the eve of the 60th anniversary of the city of Kentau, in order to stimulate students to scientific research, self-education, as well as assess the significance of the events that will take place during EXPO 2017 in the city of Astana, Kentau Polytechnic College, together with the city youth center, organized and held a competition for the “Best presentation on the topic: “EXPO 2017 - future energy”.
en.В соответствии с разработанным положение: In accordance with the developed regulations, 39 students from city and town schools aged 14 to 19 years took part in the competition. The jury members were represented by Zhusipov Omirbek, an honored pensioner, an excellent student of education, Asankulov Bakhyt, a teacher of the KPK, Isamov Farkhat, a marketer at KTZ JSC. Participants' presentations were assessed using a 5-point system.
en.По условиям конкурса участнику предостав: According to the terms of the competition, the participant was given 7 minutes of time during which he had to reveal his topic. The participants came prepared. It was not easy for the jury members to determine the winners. However, the speech of Sadykov Almaz, an 11th grade student of secondary school No. 16, was especially striking and memorable, who proposed using wind energy in Kazakhstan using pole-shaped installations developed in Spain, which, according to experts, are highly efficient. Based on the results of the points scored, he was awarded 1st place. In addition, all participants in the competition were awarded certificates and letters of gratitude.
en.Подводя итоги конкурса, председатель жюр: Summing up the results of the competition, the chairman of the jury, Zhusipov Omirbek, noted that the administration of the Kentau Polytechnic College is constantly working to improve the level of education and upbringing of young people, as exemplified by the ongoing debates, chess tournaments, and togyzkumalak competitions among pupils and students of the city of Kentau and Turkestan.
en.Результаты волеизъявления народа показыв: The results of the expression of the will of the people show boundless confidence in the President’s policies. Sergazy Kuntuarov, General Director of the machine-building plants of Alageum Electric Holding Company, stated this to Kazinform.
en.Результаты выборов являются свидетельств: The election results are evidence of the people’s love and respect for the Leader of the nation. Among the active voters was the Alageum Electric team of thousands.
en.«Для нас это был поистине судьбоносный д: “It was truly a fateful day for us. We went to the polls to choose our future. And they made their free, conscious and responsible choice. Our veterans and youth cast their votes for the Leader of the nation, who made his invaluable and disproportionate contribution to the formation, development and prosperity of our Motherland. The Kazakhstan we live in and love is the result of the President’s efforts. These are the good fruits of the labor of an authoritative, strong politician, responsible to the country, with state thinking and creative will,” says S. Kuntuarov.
en.Он подчеркнул, что благодаря усилиям Н.Н: He emphasized that thanks to the efforts of N. Nazarbayev, the word “stability” in Kazakhstan is filled with deep meaning in all spheres, be it the economy, social sphere, interethnic relations, civil harmony. Everyone understands its value against the backdrop of alarming events taking place in the world around us.
en.«Стабильность - это не дар судьбы. Это п: “Stability is not a gift of fate. This is the path along which the President leads our country confidently, carefully and wisely. And we have unlimited faith in the correctness of this path,” said the head of the holding.
en.«За годы независимости РК мы достигли вы: “During the years of independence of the Republic of Kazakhstan, we have reached heights that could only be dreamed of. It is gratifying that the course of reforms and further economic strategy will be continued. By presenting the President of the country with a mandate of trust for a new term, we know that the future of our families, our relatives, our children is in good hands,” noted S. Kuntuarov.
en.АО «Электромонтаж» - АО «ЭЛМО» участвует: Elektromontazh JSC - ELMO JSC is participating in a global project - the construction of power supply facilities for the engineering and communications infrastructure of the Gate City satellite city, which is being built in the Almaty region.
en.Завершив строительство подстанции «Кокпа: Having completed the construction of the Kokpa substation and the reconstruction of the Koyankus substation, the company is currently working on a power supply facility with a peak water heating boiler house with a capacity of 200 Gcal/hour. peak water heating boiler house with a capacity of 200 Gcal/hour. forGate City.
en.Полный комплекс строительно-монтажных ра: The full range of construction and installation works is designed for 18 months. Three of them were spent on the preparatory stage. Excavation work and concreting of foundations for the frame of buildings and equipment were completed. The installation of the building's frame has begun, and then concreting of the floor slabs, installation of window fillings and technological equipment are to be carried out. Construction and installation work will be completed with the installation of instrumentation and commissioning activities.
en.- Мы приступили к работе на этом объекте: - We started work on this site in January 2014. Young people work in the brigade alongside experienced electricians, learning from their older comrades the experience and knowledge of installation methods and the ability to cope with difficult situations. There is not a moment of peace for project manager Mikhail Viktorovich Furman. On his shoulders is all responsibility and control over the quality and overall performance of the work.
en.При монтаже котельной используется обору: When installing a boiler room, equipment from the Almaty Electromechanical Plant “AEMZ” is used, as well as auxiliary equipment from global manufacturers Grundfos, Alfa Laval, etc. The peculiarity is that boilers from the Russian company “Entroros” are installed at this facility for the first time in Kazakhstan.
en.Данный объект относится к категории высш: This object belongs to the category of the highest complexity. The entire volume of metal structures exceeds 6000 tons. The construction time is tight, so the installation of the frame of the main building is provided in blocks, which requires special experience of the installers and precision in the assembly of enlarged blocks.
en.В работе задействованы многие службы пре: Many services of the enterprise are involved in the work - the production department and the production preparation department control the correct conduct of work, the availability of tools in accordance with instructions and technological maps, and current regulatory documentation. The equipment of ELMO JSC with modern multimedia technologies allows us to quickly resolve production issues and organize video conference calls without visiting the site.
en.Доверие, которое оказывается электромонт: The trust that electricians have in the construction of such facilities of national importance is evidence that ELMO JSC is seen as a reliable partner who guarantees the quality of the work delivered.
The sea begins with a river, and the river with a drop. But these days, the people of Kazakhstan have shown that they are an ocean - an ocean of caring citizens who responded to the misfortune of their compatriots.
en.Напомним, с 23 марта в Карагандинской об: Let us recall that since March 23, 35 settlements have been flooded in the Karaganda region as a result of floods. A total of 9,961 people were evacuated. 1,760 houses were under water, 1,268 houses remain flooded. The death of 340 heads of livestock was registered. HC "Alageum Electric" could not stand aside and brought a cargo of food, personal hygiene products, etc. to the humanitarian aid collection site.
en.Желающих помочь просят приносить теплую: Those wishing to help are asked to bring warm clothes, canned, dried, freeze-dried foods, salt, sugar, baby food, hygiene products, disposable tableware, napkins, diapers, dry fuel, underwear, shoes, blankets, medicines. And remember, together we are strong!
en.Жить в доме мечты с продвинутой инфрастр: Living in a dream house with advanced infrastructure is the key to a happy life. Its façade is made in light colors, and each apartment has wide windows that offer beautiful views of the lake and a large, cozy courtyard with an original landscape design.

This transformer substation is manufactured according to modern standards. Our employees are highly qualified specialists and masters of their craft.

en.АЛМАТЫ. КАЗИНФОРМ - Пусть небольшую, но: ALMATY. KAZINFORM - Let a small, but the best part of the team of our enterprise be women - workers in work scarves. General Director of Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP (AEMZ) Zhandilya Ilyasov told Kazinform about this.
en.«Несмотря на непростые условия труда, он: “Despite difficult working conditions, they work in the most critical areas of production. And, looking at how they work, it is impossible to call our employees, as is customary, the weak half of humanity. On their, as they say, fragile shoulders, the stable operation of the plant rests. These are electrical installers Sholpanay Akhanova, Asiya Tlesova, and marking equipment operator Sanzhan Kulikova. A veteran of our production, Lyubov Litvinova, devoted her entire career to painting, worked in a man-made, very complex foundry, devoting more than 20 years of her life to it, and was a foreman of painters and molders,” noted the head of AEMZ.
en.Алматинский электромеханический завод в: In 2014, the Almaty Electromechanical Plant was awarded the title of winner in the category “Best Product of the Year” in Almaty. “And this success includes the contribution of many of our wonderful workers. Thanks to their efforts, persistent and impeccable work, the company introduced the Kaizen quality system, which significantly improved the aesthetics and culture of production, making it modern, meeting international standards, comfortable for work and safety. The basis of all these achievements of the working collective is the work of women. And today, in difficult conditions, they are showing great patience and determination to achieve an increase in economic growth. Despite the difficulties, the dedication of women, their kindness and love warms and makes this world a better, nobler place,” said the head of the plant.
en.На новых станциях метро Алматы установле: LED illuminators without bulbs have been installed at new Almaty metro stations, Dauren Sultankhanov, head of the installation department of JSC Elektromontazh, told a Tengrinews.kz correspondent about this. According to him, they consume 500 kilowatt-hours, and in monetary terms this is approximately 8,500 tenge per hour. Per day - 193 thousand tenge. The Elektromontazh company won the tender and is the main contractor for electrical installation work.
en.\"Мы проводили всю электромонтажную рабо: “We carried out all the electrical installation work in the Almaty metro. If in the first stage, that is, at the Zhibek Zholy, Almaly, Baikonur, and Auezov Theater stations, we installed energy-saving light bulbs, then at the Moscow and Sayran stations we installed 1062 LED lamps. We ordered them from Ukraine. The LED lamps I’m talking about already said, they consume a total of 500 kilowatt-hours of electricity,” says Sultankhanov. “We ordered the cable from Turkey; there is no such cable in Kazakhstan. It does not light up even if you touch a match or if there is a short circuit underground. This cable has a high degree of protection; we pulled it for kilometers from station to station manually, since there was no other way.”
en.Спикер добавил, что на электромонтажные: The speaker added that two billion tenge were allocated for electrical installation work in the Almaty metro. Almost the entire amount, says Sultankhanov, has already been spent. In particular, in 2009, funds in the amount of 272 million tenge were disbursed, in 2010 - 606 million tenge, in 2011 - 34 million tenge, in 2012 - 19 million. In 2013, 89 million tenge were disbursed, in 2014 - 556 million, and in 2015 - 144 million tenge.
en.Напомним, новые станции метро Алматы был: Let us recall that new Almaty metro stations were launched on April 18 in the presence of the President of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev. It is expected that the extension of the Almaty subway route will double passenger traffic, which was about 20 thousand people per day. The Sayran station is located along Abai Avenue between Brusilovsky and Tlendiev. And the Moscow station is on Abai Avenue between Otegen Batyr and Altynsarina.
en.Дети директора представительства компани: The children of the director of the Alageum Electric representative office in the Ural Federal District, Ruslana Ruskaeva - Maryana (6 years old) and Makar Flameng (5 years old), built a model of the Asia Trafo plant and proudly presented our company at a competition in Chelyabinsk, taking second place in the “Interaction with the Enterprise” category.
en.На макете представлены несколько цехов,: The model shows several workshops, each of which demonstrates the importance and significance of transformer equipment. We believe that the future begins with such young engineers and look forward to new achievements! We sincerely congratulate Maryana and Makar!
en.На завод ТОО “Asia Trafo” прибыли предст: Representatives of Mangystauenergomunai LLP arrived at the Asia Trafo LLP plant to conduct acceptance tests on two TDN-16000/110 kV transformers.
en.На трансформаторах был произведен компле: A set of tests was carried out on the transformers: measurements of basic electrical parameters, high-voltage tests, short-circuit and short-circuit tests, oil analyses.
en.Результаты выполненных работ соответству: The results of the work performed comply with the requirements of technical specifications and regulatory documents.
en.Трансформаторы ожидают транспортировку н: Transformers are awaiting transportation to the site and will be shipped to the Karakiyansky district of the Mangystau region. The transformers will serve a strategically important facility - a desalination plant, which will provide drinking water to the city of Zhanaozen.
en.Гости также ознакомились со спецификой р: The guests also got acquainted with the specifics of the work of the Kentau Transformer Plant, where they had the opportunity to see our production facilities and discuss further cooperation.
en.Разработав политику в области качества,: Having developed a quality policy, from the end of 2013 Kaztransformator LLP began implementing a project to implement the quality management system QMS ISO 9001-2009.
en.Стремление к улучшению деятельности поня: The desire to improve performance is understandable, because the determining factor in a company's competitiveness is effectiveness and efficiency, increasing market share, more effective risk management and increasing customer satisfaction. One of the tools for achieving the desired results is the quality management system, which allows you to structure a mechanism for monitoring the improvement of performance, increasing the motivation of personnel to improve production processes and the degree of customer satisfaction.
en.Разработав документацию системы менеджме: Having developed the documentation of the quality management system for compliance with the requirements of the ST RK ISO 9001-2009 standard, Kaztransformator LLP maintains it in working order, ensuring high quality of services provided to consumers.
en.О том, как идет работа по внедрению СМК: Commercial Director of Kaztransformator LLP Bakhyt Mazhitovna Sharipova talks about how the work on implementing the QMS is going:
en.- Первым этапом стало проведение с 22 по: - The first stage was an audit from April 22 to April 23, 2014 to confirm the quality management system for compliance with the requirements of the standard ST RK ISO 9001-2009. The audit was carried out by QS Azia Sertik. During the certification, Kaztransformator LLP successfully passed the exam for compliance with all the requirements of the standard, receiving a confirming certificate of conformity in accordance with ISO 9001-2008.
en.На втором этапе сертификации аудитом зан: At the second stage of certification, the audit was carried out by the International company “DQS Certification KZ”, the only representative of the German certification body DQS-UL Group in Kazakhstan. It is one of the world's leading certification bodies, auditing more than 100 standards and specifications. It has the advantage of being one of the leading international certification bodies for management systems and the only body accredited in the field of energy management (ISO 50001). With over 66 offices in 47 countries, this company has issued more than 45,000 certificates in one hundred countries around the world.
en.В июле 2014 г. немецкие представители ко: In July 2014, German representatives of the DQS-UL Group company conducted an external audit to confirm the QMS for compliance with the requirements of the MS ISO 9001-2009 standard. Based on the results of the audit, it was recognized that the documentation of Kaztransformator LLP according to ISO 9001-2009 meets all the requirements of the standard.
en.На данный момент идет подготовка к следу: At the moment, preparations are underway for the next, final stage - the process of obtaining the international certificate ISO 9001-2009.
en.10 ноября на Кентауском трансформаторном: On November 10, an international conference was held at the Kentau Transformer Plant on the topic “Prospects for the development of electrical equipment production within the framework of SPIID 2015-2019.”
en.С приветственным словом к участникам кон: Director of the Chamber of Entrepreneurs of the South Kazakhstan Region Zhenisbek Dulatov, shareholder, member of the Board Nurzhamal Tashchanova, Deputy Chairman of the Committee for Industrial Development and Industrial Safety of the Ministry of Investment and Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan Timur Nurashev, Chairman of the Board of KTZ JSC Sergazy Kuntuarov addressed the conference participants with a welcoming speech.
en.В рамках международного форума состоялся: Within the framework of the international forum, a round table was held “Prospects for the development of electrical equipment production within the framework of SPIID 2015-2019”. The report was made by the deputy of the Mazhilis of the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the head of the faction of the Democratic Party of Kazakhstan “Ak Zhol” Azat Peruashev.
en.О мерах государственной поддержки в рамк: On measures of state support within the framework of the SPIID 2015-2019. and the prospects for the development of the electrical equipment production sector were told by the speakers: Deputy Chairman of the Board of Kazakhstan Institute of Industrial Development JSC Marat Idrisov, Director of the regional branch of JSC FRP DAMU in South Kazakhstan Samat Akhilbekov.
en.Один из ключевых вопросов круглого стола: One of the key issues of the round table is the training of technical personnel. Deputy Director of the Human Resource Development Department of NCE RK Maksat Kasymbekov and Deputy Chairman of the Board of NJSC Kasipkor Holding Sagat Appaev shared their opinions on this matter.
en.В своем выступлении управляющий директор: In his speech, Managing Director of Samruk-Kazyna Contract LLP Aidar Tokpanov raised another relevant topic - local content and measures to support domestic producers.
en.Все прозвучавшие на круглом столе мнения: All opinions and proposals voiced at the round table were related to the problem of supporting domestic producers on the eve of Kazakhstan’s accession to the WTO. Domestic producers place great hopes on the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan’s search for new methods of support. This incentive will give a new impetus to Kazakh businesses, in particular those operating in the non-resource sector of the economy.
en.К этой категории с полным правом можно о: The Kentau Transformer Plant can rightfully be included in this category. It is no coincidence that an international conference is held on its premises - this year the company celebrates its 55th anniversary.
en.Поздравить трансформаторостроителей с эт: Numerous partners from different countries came to congratulate transformer manufacturers on this wonderful date. They were given a tour of the plant. Participants of the international conference visited the new buildings and workshops of the plant, got acquainted with the latest equipment and technological lines of European manufacturers.
en.Председатель наблюдательного совета холд: Saidulla Kozhabayev, Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Alageum Electric holding company, proudly showed the production sites where the new generation electric megamachine is being born. For its anniversary, the plant presented a worthy gift - for the first time in the history of domestic industry, mass production of electric machines with a power of up to 63 thousand kVA and a voltage of 110 kV, weighing up to 110 tons, was launched.
en.Гости с большим интересом ознакомились с: The guests got acquainted with the progress of modernization with great interest - the installed and still being installed equipment and technological lines from world manufacturers will allow the production of electric machines of enormous power that meet international standards in terms of quality, technical characteristics, and environmental friendliness.
en.- Завод по праву является лидером электр: “The plant is rightfully the leader in electrical engineering not only in Kazakhstan, but also in Central Asia,” said Azat Peruashev, a member of the Mazhilis of the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan, in an interview with journalists. – This was achieved through effective management, the implementation of large-scale rearmament work, through the use of internal reserves, and the judicious use of state support funds.
en.Действительно, за истекшие годы было соз: Indeed, over the past years, an almost new world-class enterprise has been created. The plant increased its total annual income by 114 times (up to $100 million), output per person. has grown 72 times, the product line for voltages 6, 10, 20, 35, 110 kV has increased 17 times and amounts to more than 350 items, which are successfully sold both in the country and abroad.
en.Отметив юбилей, завод уверенно входит в: Having celebrated its anniversary, the plant confidently enters the new five-year program of industrial and innovative development of the country.
en.Коллегией Комитета по инвестициям МИНТ Р: The Board of the Investment Committee of the MINT of the Republic of Kazakhstan approved an application for the provision of investment preferences for the implementation of the investment project “Alageum Electrtic” - “Production of power transformers of voltage class 6 – 10 kV”, the purpose of which is the acquisition of modern high-tech equipment to launch a new production of power transformers of voltage class 6 – 10 kV in the city of Uralsk.
en.«Уральский трансформаторный завод» (УТЗ): When the Ural Transformer Plant (UTZ) reaches its designed capacity, it will create 500 new jobs and produce 12,000 transformers per year. The plant is planned to be launched in the second half of 2014. The project is included in the regional industrialization map and is a strategically important task for the development of the non-resource sector of the economy of the Republic of Kazakhstan, as it is almost entirely export-oriented. UTZ has a significant economic and social effect for the economy of the region and the state, since it will have a generally beneficial impact on the growth of Kazakhstan’s GDP.
en.«Alageum Electric» – динамично развивающ: Alageum Electric is a dynamically developing holding company providing a full range of turnkey services. The holding's activities are carried out in five main areas: design; production of electrical products; supply of industrial equipment and service; construction and production of building materials; electrical installation and commissioning services.
en.В состав холдинга входят: АО «Проектный: The holding includes: JSC “Design Institute “Promenergo”, JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant”, LLP “Nur-Stroy LTD”, JSC “Electromontazh” (JSC “ELMO”), etc. The holding is the holder of the titles “Best business partner of technical and vocational education” from the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan, “Best Exporter” from the MINT RK and “Best Supplier” from the JSC "Exploration Production "KazMunayGas". In 2012, the company's products were awarded the Altyn Sapa Prize from the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 2013, the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric JSC, Erkebulan Ilyasov, became a finalist in the international competition “Entrepreneur of the Year” in Kazakhstan, held by Ernst & Young.
en.Холдинговая компания Alageum, единственн: The holding company Alageum, the only transformer manufacturer in Kazakhstan, represents an interesting example of growth - both in a crisis and against the backdrop of a declining manufacturing industry. Nurzhan Stvaev, General Director of Alageum Group LLP, told kursiv.kz about why the company demonstrates such results and how it plans to maintain its position.
en.- В последние годы компания довольно хор: - In recent years, the company has been growing quite well, and for the current year there were forecasts for maintaining revenue growth rates of 30%. Does the dynamics of the first half of the year confirm them?
en.- Безусловно. В 2012 году прирост выручк: - Of course. In 2012, revenue growth compared to 2011 was 35%, and in monetary terms - $300 million. In the first half of 2013, growth dynamics compared to last year were at 18%, I think this is a good dynamics.
en.- Alageum – одно из самых быстрорастущих: - Alageum is one of the fastest growing enterprises in the manufacturing industry. Is it a matter of monopoly?
en.- Этот рост дается нам непросто. На наше: - This growth is not easy for us. There are many companies on our market that distribute products from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Europe and China, so our competition is quite fierce.
en.В связи с этим, в прошлом году мы разраб: In this regard, last year we developed a strategy to protect the market from imports. In the process of its implementation, representative offices were opened in all border regions, and the branch network was expanded throughout all regions of Kazakhstan. In addition, we continue to launch new projects, in particular, this year we began construction of the Ural Transformer Plant for the production of 6-10 kV transformers, which will be almost 80-90% focused on export to Russia.
en.- Мы сейчас находимся в процессе перегов: - We are currently in the process of negotiations. The participants in this project are Alageum, Russian and German companies. Memorandums have already been signed, but for now we are still negotiating the shares of the participants. German partners provide design and technological documentation and equipment selection. Muscovites will be responsible for sales, and we will take upon ourselves the organization of production and, accordingly, personnel.
en.- Поскольку мы пока не достигли соглашен: - Since we have not yet reached an agreement on the investment part, and time is running out, Alageum has begun implementing its part of the obligations to build the plant. In particular, we worked on the issue of including the project in the “Business Road Map 2020”, received subsidies and preferential financing in the amount of 2.6 billion tenge.
en.Сейчас уже проведена предоплата по всему: Now we have already made an advance payment for all the equipment and we have carried out part of the construction work in the amount of $7 million. Equipment deliveries will be carried out from December to March, and in June 2014 we plan to release the first products. In general, since 2008, we have increased the share of exports from 10% to 30%, and given that Russia is the main destination for the company, this figure will grow.
en.- Вы рассказали о развитии российского н: - You talked about the development of the Russian direction, but what about exports to Central Asia?
en.- У нас очень широкая география экспорта: - We have a very wide export geography: Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan, and since last year - Afghanistan. We work very closely with the National Agency for Export and Investment Kaznex Invest, which in 2012 helped us find partners and conclude a number of agreements with American companies in Afghanistan for the supply of high-voltage equipment. To date, supplies worth $5 million have been made.
en.- Если говорить об Афганистане, то мы ос: - If we talk about Afghanistan, we only carry out deliveries, without construction and installation work, so there are almost no risks. Of course, we work with JSC Export Credit Insurance Corporation KazExportGarant. In particular, they are very helpful in working with Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan.
en.Как известно, наши экспортеры сталкивают: As you know, our exporters are faced with the problem of lack of advance payment and restrictions on currency conversion. Also, we recently entered into an agreement with the National Electric Grid Company of Kyrgyzstan. There are still problems with Turkmenistan – it is a visa-free country. The constructed railway from Aktau to Turkmenistan should solve many logistics problems.
en.- С чем связано такое форсированное разв: - What is the reason for this accelerated development, with launching competitors or plans for Kazakhstan’s accession to the WTO?
en.- Безусловно, нас беспокоит вступление в: - Of course, we are concerned about joining the WTO. Small players may disappear from the market as mergers and acquisitions are inevitable. Therefore, we strengthened the structure - a number of disparate assets were transformed into a holding. We are expanding and strengthening our export direction.
en.В целом стратегия развития компании утве: In general, the company’s development strategy has been approved in five areas: design, production, construction, electrical installation, commissioning and sales. Production of electrical products and provision of services in the voltage range 0.4 - 220 kV, as well as strengthening its contribution to the development of energy-saving “green”, environmentally friendly energy as the future of the global economy. High quality and reliability of products are achieved thanks to production equipped with modern, high-tech equipment from leading Western European companies.
en.По нашим прогнозам, после вступления в В: According to our forecasts, after joining the WTO, large transnational companies with extensive experience, high quality of service, management, i.e. with great opportunities, will come to our market. Yes, we know very well what awaits us ahead, this is the call of the time, and we must prepare. During the 6-7 year transition period, I think we will have time to prepare qualified personnel and be prepared for all stressful situations.
en.- В свое время компания скупила активы п: - At one time, the company bought assets for the production of transformers in Kazakhstan. Do you have plans to develop the holding by acquiring local market participants?
en.- Нет. Сейчас компания полностью укомпле: - No. Now the company is fully staffed, in addition, I have already mentioned the ongoing projects that will significantly increase our sales volumes of goods and services.
en.История «Alageum Electric» начинается с: The history of Alageum Electric begins in 1997: the acquisition of a controlling stake in Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, which was on the verge of bankruptcy. Over the past decades, we have gotten rid of equipment that has been loose since Soviet times, and instead purchased high-tech equipment made in Europe.
en.В 2009 году, впервые в истории Казахстан: In 2009, for the first time in the history of Kazakhstan, we mastered and launched the production of power electrical machines with voltages of 35 and 110 kW. We built new business areas on the basis of a number of enterprises specializing in the design, production and installation of electrical products, united under the single brand “Alageum”. Over the years, the company has grown into a vertically integrated structure, which, with the formation of the management company Alageum Group, acquired a complete form.
en.АО «Проектный институт «Промэнерго», АО: JSC Design Institute “Promenergo”, JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant”, LLP “Nur-Stroy LTD” and JSC “Elektromontazh” (“ELMO”). The company has 30 offices in all regional centers of the Republic of Kazakhstan with its head office in Astana. The holding's production assets include 12 operating factories (Kentau, Shymkent, Almaty, Turkestan, Kyzylorda, Uralsk, Aktau, Astana). The JSC also has 2 design and scientific-engineering centers (Astana and Almaty). Representative offices of the company were opened in Moscow, Shanghai, Tashkent, Bishkek, Ashgabat, Dushanbe. The range of electrical products, goods and equipment manufactured by KTZ JSC today exceeds 300 items.
en.В 2002 году закончил Ташкентский Областн: In 2002 he graduated from the Tashkent Regional State Pedagogical Institute, philology - English
en.В 2006 году получил степень магистра в А: In 2006, he received a master’s degree from the Almaty Academy of Economics and Statistics, faculty - Finance and Credit.
en.В 2012 году закончил курс «Бизнес-процес: In 2012, he completed the course “Business Processes for Managers as a Tool for Improving Management Effectiveness” (InterProfi).
en.В октябре 2008 занимал должность Project: In October 2008, he held the position of Project manager in the architectural design company - Artetra LLP in Almaty.
en.В ноябре 2009 года начал свою карьеру в: In November 2009, he began his career as an economist at JSC Kentau Transformer Plant, a subsidiary of the diversified holding Alageum Electric.
en.В рамках реализации Национального проект: As part of the implementation of the National Project “Modernization of the Energy and Utilities Sectors,” a republican conference was held in Shymkent with the participation of representatives of government agencies, industry companies and domestic manufacturers. The organizer of the conference is the Association of Electrical Mechanical Engineers of Kazakhstan. The purpose of the event is to solve pressing issues of deterioration of energy infrastructure and create conditions for sustainable development in the future.
en.Местом проведения мероприятия выбран зав: The Asia Trafo plant, the largest manufacturer of transformers and shunt reactors in Central Asia, part of the Kazakhstan group of companies Alageum Electric, was chosen as the venue for the event. The group of companies is a striking example demonstrating the potential for increasing the country's energy security through the production of domestic electrical equipment. For 27 years, the management and engineers of the Kazakh holding have been actively restoring bankrupt industrial enterprises, building new factories and introducing the latest technologies into their production.
en.«Потенциал казахстанских предприятий оче: “The potential of Kazakh enterprises is very large. As practice shows, domestic equipment has a greater margin of safety to the climatic conditions of Kazakhstan and the quality of the infrastructure. Another important aspect in favor of OTP equipment is the warranty and technical support of the equipment. No importer today carries out such obligations in Kazakhstan. In turn, domestic enterprises provide such a service. In addition, there is an important social aspect here - the creation of new jobs, tax payments to the country’s budget, investment attractiveness,” emphasized Galym Bulatov, managing director of the Association of Electrical Mechanical Engineers of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
en.По словам местных производителей, отечес: According to local manufacturers, domestic companies are already taking on the responsibility of repairing imported equipment, which often breaks down at the very beginning of operation. This once again emphasizes the need to support our own enterprises.
en.«Мы призываем рассматривать возможность: “We encourage you to consider purchasing energy efficient transformers. Now the global trend is energy efficiency, and Kazakhstan should not lag behind,” said technical director of the Asia Trafo plant Dauirbek Ateev.
en.Представитель Министерства промышленност: Representative of the Ministry of Industry and Construction of the Republic of Kazakhstan Aidyn Rakhymzhan confirmed that the government is actively working to load domestic production and create new enterprises.
en.«Это не просто вопрос экономики - это во: “This is not just a question of economics - it is a question of the country’s energy security. Reliable infrastructure provides heat and light in the homes of Kazakhstanis,” the ministry commented.
en.На сессии, посвящённой механизмам реализ: At the session dedicated to the mechanisms for implementing the project, Makka Shingazieva, Deputy Chairman of the Board of JSC “Kazakhstan Center for Modernization and Development of Housing and Public Utilities”, emphasized that the National Project is designed for the long term:
en.«Мы сразу обозначаем: это будет поэтапны: “We immediately indicate: this will be a phased project. Now we are talking about the first five years, then implementation will develop depending on the results and requests of the regions.”
en.Управляющий директор АО «НУХ «Байтерек»: Managing Director of Baiterek NMH JSC Aliya Murzagalieva reported on the main mechanisms for financing the National Project, which will be carried out at the expense of SEM’s own funds, attracting budget loans and/or making a contribution from LEBs or SPCs to the authorized capital of SEM, attracting loans from microfinance organizations and financial institutions of the Republic of Kazakhstan, issuing bonds from LEBs purchased by the Financial Operator in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. As Aliya Murzagalieva noted, the effect of modernization will affect the economic and investment attractiveness of the country.
en.Тем не менее, отечественные производител: However, domestic manufacturers have expressed concern that a number of decisions are still being made in a hurry, and the implementation of projects is completely left to EPC contractors. The representative of the domestic company Karlskrona LC AB, Talgat Alpysbaev, compared with the experience of participating in foreign projects:
en.«Мы обсуждаем проекты, которые будут реа: “We are discussing projects that will be implemented in 30-40 years. Design alone takes 3 years. Planning at a distance determines the quality of execution. But when everything happens at the last moment, there are big risks in terms of quality.”
en.Участие в мероприятии приняли отечествен: Domestic enterprises Alageum Electric, Ust-Kamenogorsk Capacitor Plant, Nero Group, Karlskrona LC AB took part in the event. According to the Ministry, large-scale modernization will last until 2029. As a result, wear and tear on key infrastructure should be significantly reduced. The conference in Shymkent became not only a platform for discussing challenges, but also an important step towards rethinking the role of domestic industry in ensuring the energy independence of Kazakhstan.
en.Уважаемые коллеги! Мы с вами встречаем н: Dear colleagues! We are celebrating our most favorite holiday, the holiday of revival and renewal - Nauryz Meiramy.
en.Каждый из нас помнит его с детства. Когд: Each of us remembers him from childhood. When elegant yurts were spread out in the expansive steppe, a kazan-oshak was installed, and in the early morning the polished samovars began to smoke in unison. And how my mother, together with her friends and neighbors, rolled out the dough, fried baursaks, and served the generous dastarkhan with jokes, songs, and friendly laughter. We, the children, rode on a swing - altybakan, the older guys played tug of war - audaryspak. At that time, our fathers enthusiastically supported horse racing and the hot tournament of winged pacers on the kokpar...
en.Традиции неизменны. Этот Наурыз мы тоже: Traditions are unchanged. We will also celebrate this Nauryz with the generosity and scope characteristic of our people, expecting that the Day of the Vernal Equinox will bring abundance, happiness and success to every home for the whole year. After all, in spring nature comes to life, and each of us meets it with hopes, good plans, high spirits, filling our hearts with warm feelings. This is the deep philosophical meaning of the Nauryz holiday.
en.Я верю, что эту весну мы наполним хороши: I believe that we will fill this spring with good deeds, that new seedlings will appear near each of our enterprises, the alleys will turn green, and flowers will be planted. We also inherited this beautiful tradition of landscaping, and we will always honor it.
en.Поздравляя Вас с весенним праздником Нау: Congratulating you on the spring holiday of Nauryz, I wish you all peace and prosperity, happiness and good luck, more good deeds, may all your endeavors bring success and joy!
en.Об освоение новой продукции заводов гово: The development of new products from the plants was discussed on November 8 in Aktobe during the regional presentation of the Alageum Electric Group of Companies. The event was attended by over 40 people, among whom were representatives of government agencies, REC, KEGOC, design institutes, as well as representatives of large construction companies of the Aktobe region. The presentation was organized by the Aktobe branch of Alageum Electric JSC with the support of NPP Atameken.
en.Директор филиала Кыдырбаев Алмат рассказ: Branch director Almat Kydyrbaev told the guests about the activities of Alageum Electric Group of Companies and the construction of a workshop for the production of panel radiators, the production of which will begin in 2020 by Ural Transformer Plant LLP. Representatives of the Kentau Transformer Plant Nurzhan Sarsenov and Galymzhan Shegebaev spoke about the production of new types of products, such as: vacuum circuit breakers under the “BB-AE” brand, microprocessor protection DRP, as well as high-voltage cells KSO2-20kV, switchgear and KERNEU. Representatives of the plant also touched upon the topic of production of concrete substations produced by Aktau Transformer Plant LLP.
en.Главный конструктор Адилбек Тажибаев пре: Chief designer Adilbek Tazhibaev presented the Azia Trafo plant as the largest transformer production plant in Central Asia. The company produces power transformers with a voltage class of 110,220,500 kV with a power of up to 500 MVA and shunt reactors.
en.Также в ходе региональной презентации за: Also during the regional presentation, Deputy Director of the NCE “Atameken” of the Aktobe region, Zhanaaim Kelbatyrova, explained in detail to businessmen the Resolution of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 358 of July 26, 2019 “On establishing an exemption from the national regime” and its application in public procurement. In order to protect the country's domestic market and economic development, when carrying out government procurement, goods originating from foreign countries are excluded from the national regime. At the same time, goods produced by a legal entity of the Republic of Kazakhstan that has a certificate of origin of goods in the form “CT-KZ” are allowed to participate in government procurement.
en.Гости мероприятия задавали интересующие: Guests of the event asked questions and showed active interest in purchasing equipment from Alageum Electric Group of Companies factories. We hope for further fruitful cooperation with each company.
en.Крупнейший завод «Alageum Electric» - пр: The largest plant "Alageum Electric" - the enterprise "Asia Trafo" - presented a joint project of specialists from the enterprise and scientists from AUPET named after. G. Daukeeva at Digital Almaty.
en.Международный форум, который объединил п: The international forum, which brought together representatives of business, international experts, the IT community, government agencies and the media, was held on February 2-3, 2023. The main topic of the discussion was the current global challenges to the development of the innovative technology industry.
en.Ученые АУЭС им. Г.Даукеева и инженеры пр: Scientists at AUES named after. G. Daukeeva and engineers presented the results of the project “Development and implementation of a customer-oriented integrated automated system for the calculation and manufacture of transformers,” implemented at the production base of the largest Kazakhstan transformer production plant, Asia Trafo LLP.
en.Проект реализован в рамках грантовой пр: The project was implemented within the framework of the grant program of the ICRIAP Project “Stimulating Productive Innovations”.
en.Вопросы автоматизации и цифровизации про: Issues of automation and digitalization of production, as well as increasing energy efficiency, are among the priorities for the Alageum Electric Group of Companies. The Group is constantly modernizing its production facilities and investing in research and development (R&D).
en.Духовная столица Казахстана стремительно: The spiritual capital of Kazakhstan has rapidly transformed. Our team is glad to be involved in the revival of Turkestan - the new center of the entire Turkic world, because a number of iconic objects of the regional center are equipped with equipment from the Alageum Electric company. One of them is “Hazret Sultan International Airport”.
en.Международный аэропорт был открыт для ре: The international airport opened to regular domestic traffic in December last year. This is the first large airport built from scratch in Kazakhstan since independence. Located 16 km from the city center, in the village of Chaga. The estimated capacity of the new airport will be about three million passengers per year.

en.Нуржан Адасбайевич, сектор машиностроени: Nurzhan Adasbaevich, the mechanical engineering sector has become, perhaps, the main sector of the economy affected by recent economic shocks. What consequences did all these events have for your company?
en.Ровно год назад, после того как российск: Exactly a year ago, after the Russian ruble weakened against the American currency, and our tenge remained at the same level, all Kazakh producers turned out to be uncompetitive. Including our sector. In addition to uncompetitive prices, in the first half of 2015 we were faced with a lack of orders in both Kazakhstan and Russia due to the suspension of financing in many areas. This resulted in a 50% drop in production. The situation stabilized in the second half of the year, after the transition to a freely floating exchange rate. Our export sales have increased sharply, and the Kazakh market has revived.
en.Естественно, что экономическая турбулент: Naturally, economic turbulence affected our profitability and production volumes. Overall, at the end of 2015, we expect growth to decline by 15% compared to last year.
en.Тем не менее, вам удалось удержать объем: Nevertheless, you managed to keep production volume at a fairly high level. What helped your business stay afloat?
en.Помогли нашему предприятию лояльные клие: Our company was helped by loyal customers and dealer partners from Russia, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan, who, despite the instability, placed their orders and, so to speak, gave work to our workforce. And, of course, the constantly tangible support from the head of state and government of Kazakhstan through initiatives such as “Made in Kazakhstan”, and the “National Champions” program was very helpful.
en.Расскажите о структуре вашего производст: Tell us about the structure of your production. What is the share of the import component in it? To what extent has the structure and line of products you produce undergone changes due to the economic situation?
en.Мы выпускаем более 300 различных наимено: We produce more than 300 different types of products. Therefore, there were no special shocks other than a drop in overall demand. en.Какие основные сложности испытывает ваше: What are the main difficulties your company is experiencing today? en.В связи с тем, что все страны переживают: Due to the fact that all countries are experiencing an economic crisis and lack of funds, we have to ship for export without payment with a delay of up to 1 year. You and I have launched a huge flywheel that is spinning and gaining momentum. The higher, the more difficult, the tougher the competition. If previously the Alageum Electric company may not have been recognized seriously, now they not only take us into account, but also see us as serious competitors. This is worthy of your own pride.
en.Я глубоко благодарен своему коллективу,: I am deeply grateful to my team, to each of you, and I want to say "Birlik bar zherde – tirlik bar". We cannot afford to relax, because very soon we will join the WTO, and there hard work alone will not be enough. We are waiting for a powerful rivalry of technologies, global competition at the intellectual level, which requires high flexibility of all business processes, high-tech production capable of quickly responding to market realities, continuous product renewal, its high level and quality, taking into account the growing demands of consumers.
en.Это многотрудная задача, для решения кот: This is a difficult task, to solve which we must tighten up all our reserves, competitive advantages, rearrange priorities, subordinating production, personnel, investment and economic strategy to them. en.Комплектная двухтрансформаторная подстан: A complete two-transformer substation in block-modular design with a capacity of 2500 kVA was produced by the Almaty Electromechanical Plant in a month and a half. Protection of the electrical network from overvoltage on the HV side of 20 kV and 0.4 kV on the LV side, with a frequency of 50 Hz, is also provided, which allows uninterrupted supply of energy to urban housing and communal services, public and industrial facilities.
en.Нормальный режим работы подстанции обесп: Normal operation of the substation is ensured at ambient temperatures from - 40°C to + 40°C, as well as with occasional temperature drops to - 45°C, as well as an average daily relative humidity of up to 80% at + 15°C.
en.В связи с распространением заведомо ложн: In connection with the dissemination of deliberately false information in the media, the Alageum Eleectric Group of Companies considers it necessary to comment:
en.В период с 01.01.2021 г. по 07.04.2021 г: In the period from 01/01/2021 to 04/07/2021, the number of employees of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC (hereinafter referred to as KTZ JSC) who were dismissed at their own request is 8 people. Employment and termination of employment contracts are carried out in accordance with the Labor Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan. It follows that the information voiced in the above source about the mass dismissal of one hundred employees is deliberately false and does not reflect reality.
en.Необходимо отметить, что Кентауский тран: It should be noted that the Kentau Transformer Plant is a large city-forming enterprise in the city of Kentau. In total, 917 employees are employed at KTZ JSC today. As of April 14, 2021, there are no wage arrears among employees of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC. The plant is operating normally.
en.АО «КТЗ» является одним из ведущих произ: KTZ JSC is one of the leading manufacturers of transformer equipment in the country. When choosing a supplier, priority is given to domestic enterprises with local content. At the moment, the share of Kazakhstani content in the plant’s products reaches 80%. However, some of the strategic raw materials and components are not produced in Kazakhstan; accordingly, the company is forced to import the missing products from abroad. Among the main foreign suppliers are such countries as the Russian Federation, Hungary, Türkiye, Germany, China, Ukraine and Italy. The information indicated in the video about the contractual relations of KTZ JSC with the Shanghai Kerneu Trade Company Limited concerns the supply of components from China.
en.Образовательное учреждение «Казахско-нем: The educational institution “Kazakh-German Polytechnic College” was founded in 2012. The dual training system involves the organization of an educational process, 60% of which consists of practical classes organized directly at the Kentau Transformer Plant. By decision of the college’s pedagogical council dated March 31, 2021, 11 students were expelled, 6 of whom were expelled for systematic absences from classes, 4 at their own request, and 1 student was granted academic leave in connection with conscription into the armed forces of the Republic of Kazakhstan. en.О том, какова программа совещания и как: The director of the Kentau Polytechnic College at KTZ JSC, Serik Abulkhasymovich Aytureev, talks about the program of the meeting and how preparations for it are going.

en.Совещание обсудит перспективы и возможно: The meeting will discuss the prospects and possibilities for introducing a dual training system throughout Kazakhstan, taking the experience of the Kentau Transformer Plant as a basis. Two sections are planned: the first will consider the topic “Social partnership - mutually beneficial cooperation”, the second - “Dual education within the framework of a continuous education system - school, college, university”.
en.Ожидается подписание Меморандума о сотру: It is expected that a Memorandum of Cooperation in the field of lifelong education (schools, college, university, enterprise) will be signed between schools in Kentau, Kentau Polytechnic College, International Kazakh-Turkish University and Alageum Electric Holding Company.
en.Особенность совещания в том, что оно буд: The peculiarity of the meeting is that it will be held on the basis of KTZ JSC. An introduction to the plant's products and tours of the workshops are planned.
en.- Почему для столь представительного сов: - Why was Kentau Polytechnic College at KTZ JSC chosen for such a representative meeting?
en.- С первых дней своего существования кол: - From the first days of its existence, the college took as its basis the idea of dual education. It was close to the economic and social policies of the company, which lacks young engineering specialists. The plant guarantees the future employment of students - this is the main point of this model. The problem of lack of practice is also solved here. The theoretical knowledge gained is supported by practice in the workplace, in real production conditions. What a student hears in the classroom today, he will apply at the enterprise tomorrow. This allows you to successfully master the curriculum, gain good practical skills, and, most importantly, establish contacts in the workforce.
en.Образовательная программа колледжа отвеч: The college’s educational program meets the employer’s expectations and production needs. This is an important point. In terms of equipment and methods of training programs, the college is ahead of similar educational organizations. By taking this unprecedented move, the plant radically changed the system of secondary specialized education.
en.Для внедрения немецкого опыта дуального: To introduce the German experience of dual education, I visited Germany, which, according to the International Institute for Monitoring the Quality of the Labor Force (Switzerland), is a leader in the level of personnel qualifications and the implementation of a dual education system. The Head of our state, Nursultan Nazarbayev, also refers to its experience, having given the task to study and adopt it on a republican scale.
en.- Эта модель позволяет преодолеть разрыв: - This model allows us to bridge the gap between theory and practice - the main problem of vocational education. Parallel theoretical and practical training gives them the necessary experience and the opportunity to find a job immediately after studying, gain independence early and quickly adapt to adult life. The student is highly motivated to obtain good knowledge, which creates his competitiveness and relevance.
en.Предприятию тоже выгодно – ему гарантиро: It is also beneficial for the enterprise - it is guaranteed a constant supply of qualified personnel, this saves costs on searching and selecting workers, their retraining and adaptation. A high percentage of graduates’ employment and an effective solution to the problem of training qualified personnel for the economy also meets the interests of the state.
en.Друзья, с гордостью сообщаем об еще одно: Friends, we are proud to announce another honorary award for the Alageum Electric team of professionals.

en.Кроме того, за активное содействие в орг: In addition, for active assistance in organizing at a high level the Eurasian Intergovernmental Council (EMCC) and the international digital forum Digital Qazaqstan 2026, Erkebulan Ilyasov was awarded a Letter of Gratitude from the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
en.Напомним, Alageum Electric выступил плат: Let us remind you that Alageum Electric acted as a platinum partner of one of the key technological events in the country - the Digital Qazaqstan forum, dedicated to the digital transformation of the economy, the development of innovation and the implementation of advanced technological solutions.
en.В рамках форума Digital Qazaqstan предсе: As part of the Digital Qazaqstan forum, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Alageum Electric group of companies, Erkebulan Ilyasov, presented to the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan Olzhas Bektenov and the heads of government of the EAEU countries a line of digital solutions based on artificial intelligence aimed at preventing accidents and increasing the stability of the energy system.
en.Ключевой акцент разработок — защита объе: The key focus of developments is the protection of first category facilities: schools, hospitals, life support systems and other critical infrastructure, where any interruptions in energy supply directly affect the safety of people and the stability of social processes.
en.В условиях роста нагрузки на энергосисте: In the context of growing load on the energy system and the complication of its architecture, it is precisely such objects that become the most vulnerable. Today, technical incidents in the electric power industry act as a factor of systemic risks that can negatively affect the functioning of entire regions.
en.Центральным презентованным решением стал: The central solution presented was the intelligent transformer monitoring system SAFE-T.KZ, integrated with elements of artificial intelligence.
en.Система в режиме реального времени анали: The system analyzes key equipment parameters in real time: load, temperature, oil condition, degree of wear of components and detects deviations at an early stage. This allows the industry to completely move from a reactive model to a proactive model, which is critical for the stable operation of Category 1 infrastructure.
en.Данный цифровой комплекс уже внедрен на: This digital complex has already been implemented at the facilities of the national operator KEGOC and is being considered for further scaling, including the strategic project for the construction of a 1000 MW CCGT plant in the Turkestan region.
en.Отдельным вектором представлен алгоритм: A separate vector presents an algorithm for using artificial intelligence to predict generation at renewable energy facilities. This solution is aimed at reducing imbalances in the energy system, which have a direct impact on the reliability of energy supply to socially significant facilities.
en.Пилотный проект успешно реализуется на б: The pilot project is being successfully implemented at the Kentau Transformer Plant. According to the company's estimates, the use of innovative technologies increases forecasting accuracy by up to 95%, reduces power imbalances by 30–50% and increases the efficiency of renewable energy sources by 15–25%.
en.В Alageum Electric подчеркивают, что мас: Alageum Electric emphasizes that scaling such solutions can significantly reduce the likelihood of technological disruptions and minimize the risks of emergency situations at the level of the entire energy system.
en.«Сегодня надежность энергосистемы — это: “Today, the reliability of the energy system is an absolute question of the safety of people and the stability of the state. We deliberately focus on sites where the cost of failure is greatest - schools, hospitals and life support systems. Our solutions allow you to fix the problem, see the risk in advance and prevent accidents before they occur. We are making a transition to a new, proactive model of intelligent and sustainable energy,” noted Erkebulan Ilyasov
