The strategic choice is determined by the desire to actively develop the electrical market of the neighboring state. The expansion of the presence of UTZ products on the Russian market will be carried out by the dealer network created by the holding company Alageum Electric. When the plant reaches full design capacity in 2016-17. the production volume will reach $100 million. The implementation of the project meets the industry programs of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Export 2020 Development and Promotion Program as part of state support for export-oriented enterprises in the non-resource sector of the economy.
en.Базовой продукцией завода станут распред: The basic products of the plant will be distribution oil and dry transformers with a voltage class of 6–10 kV and traction transformers with a production volume of 12,000 units per year. The cost of the project is 5 billion tenge. 700 new jobs will be created. The production area of ​​the plant is 32,969.9 sq.m.
en.Предприятие оснащено современным оборудо: The enterprise is equipped with modern equipment and automated lines from European countries and is an example of high production culture. en.Электропечные трансформаторы служат для: Electric furnace transformers are used to power various industrial electrothermal installations, used mainly in ferrous and non-ferrous metallurgy. Such installations include: electric arc steel-smelting furnaces, which melt steel using an alternating current electric arc; induction melting furnaces that melt metal using induction heating; electroslag remelting furnaces, ore-thermal furnaces and some others. The parameters and operating modes of such electric furnaces have characteristic features that differ sharply from other current collectors. Accordingly, electric furnace transformers in their parameters and design differ significantly from general-purpose power transformers.
en.На сегодняшний день завершены монтажные: To date, installation work has been completed on 3 transformers of the EOTSN-35000/35 kV type at the Zhezkazgan copper smelter of Kazakhmys Smelting LLP.
en.Благодаря высокой квалификации и слаженн: Thanks to high qualifications and well-coordinated work and the desire to achieve new heights, the Asia Trafo LLP team has mastered the production technology of furnace transformers and contributed to the expansion of the range of products and the development of the Alageum Electric Group of Companies.
en.Сейчас наша команда профессионалов проек: Now our team of professionals designs, produces and repairs transformers of any type with voltage class 10-500 kV and is always open to new solutions. Transform the future with Alageum Electric.
en.В рамках проекта Правительства Республик: Within the framework of the project of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the UN development program - GEF “Standards, certification and labeling of energy efficiency of electrical household appliances and equipment in Kazakhstan”, two new laboratories on electric motors and transformers (with eight training stands) were opened at the Kazakh-German Polytechnic College of the Kentau Transformer Plant.
en.На торжественном открытии присутствовали: The opening ceremony was attended by representatives of the Ministry of Industry and Infrastructure Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan, regional and city akimats, MKTU named after K.A. Yassavi, Alageum Electric Group of Companies and Kentau Transformer Plant. Equipping the college with modern training stands will allow students to undergo practical training as part of courses in electrical engineering, electromechanics and power engineering, and learn how to measure the efficiency of transformers and asynchronous electric motors. An excursion was held for guests and media journalists, in which students explained ways to increase the efficiency of electrical machines, transformers, relay protection and automation. The goal of the project is to transform the Kazakhstan market towards energy-efficient devices and equipment in order to reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions.
en.\"Эффективность обучения увеличивается п: “The effectiveness of learning increases by combining theory with practice. Without practice, there will be no deep systemic knowledge. Students must have the opportunity to see and work with technology. For example, it is impossible to imagine studying a science such as robotics without working equipment, without the ability to disassemble the tool, study it in cross-section,” noted Baurzhan Khudaybergenov, Director of the technical department of Alageum Electric, at the official opening.
en.– Хайрулла Байдильдаевич, расскажите, по: – Khairulla Baidildaevich, please tell us about the history of the creation of the company. What does it do, what range of products does it produce?
en.– ТОО «Алматинский электромеханический з: – Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP (AEMZ LLP) is part of Alageum Electric JSC, which provides integrated turnkey solutions from a single source in the electric power industry market: design, production of electrical products, supply of industrial equipment and its maintenance, construction and production of building materials, electrical installation and commissioning services. I would like to especially note that the holding is one of the three leading exporters of the non-resource sector in Kazakhstan.
en.АЭМЗ был образован в 1959 году. В 1999 г: AEMZ was founded in 1959. In 1999, the enterprise received the status of Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP and became part of the Alageum Electric holding company. Today the enterprise is one of the leading producers of electrical equipment in the republic. The plant produces a wide range of high-voltage, low-voltage and non-standard electrical equipment. Our products are developed using new technologies and manufactured on equipment with digital software.
en.Мы изготавливаем комплектные трансформат: We manufacture complete transformer substations, complete switchgears, serial single-sided chambers, ShchO-70, ShchO-90 panels of various types and designs, power distribution cabinets, boxes, lighting panels and other electrical products. We also carry out installation and commissioning of the supplied equipment with subsequent service and warranty service. This year also began the development of ORU-35, 110.
en.Вся выпускаемая заводом продукция сертиф: All products manufactured by the plant are certified by the State Standard of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The ISO 9001:2000 quality management system was introduced in 2004 and certified by the international certification body KEMA (Holland). Our plant is included in the Register of Domestic Manufacturers. The main types of products have certificates of origin of goods in the form “ST-KZ”.
en.С прошлого года мы внедряем на производс: Since last year, we have been introducing ERP automation systems in production, which will allow us to reduce production time and improve the quality of customer service. We are constantly working to ensure that the “Made in Kazakhstan” brand is associated with high quality products.
en.Мы завершили строительство объектов элек: We have completed the construction of power supply facilities for satellite cities (construction of the Kokpa substation, two 110 kW cable lines from the Koyankus substation to the Kokpa substation, reconstruction of the Koyankus substation). Currently, commissioning work is underway.
en.В августе текущего года АЭМЗ разработал: In August of this year, AEMZ developed and launched a new project - a 27.5 kV closed switchgear as an operating substation of TP-110/27.5/10 kV in Kostanay TP "Sortirovochnaya (North)". This is the first substation of this type in Kazakhstan. Our plant is the only enterprise in the republic that has completed such a project to date. In addition to AEMZ in the CIS, such substations can only be manufactured by NIIEFA named after D.V. Efremov in St. Petersburg. The customer of the substation is the national company “Kazakhstan Temir Zholy”. Russian colleagues were very surprised that a Kazakh company was able to master such complex production.
en.– Мы постоянно наращиваем мощность произ: – We are constantly increasing production capacity at the enterprise. Thus, the plant’s production volume in 2012 increased by 11% compared to 2011. And compared to 2010, this figure increased by 19%.
en.– Наша продукция используется практическ: – Our products are used in almost all sectors of the economy. After all, electricity is used everywhere. Our products are used to transmit, transform and distribute electricity.
en.Приведу примеры использования нашей прод: I will give examples of the use of our products. Especially for the 2011 Asian Games in the Soldatskoe Gorge, Almaty region, for the biathlon ski complex at AEMZ, transformer substations and complete switchgears of the K-8M series, as well as complete switchgears of the K-7M series, combined with the control unit for powering the substation PS-110/10 kV “Novaya” in Almaty, were manufactured and supplied. Or, for example, the construction of the substation PS-110/10-10 kV “Alatau”, which is one of the main energy facilities in the southern capital and serves to power the rolling stock of the Almaty metro.
en.– В настоящее время на заводе работает 2: – Currently the plant employs 200 people. Over the past two years, the number of employees has grown by 15%. This was largely due to the expansion of production. We employ many young specialists, and we are pleased with this.
en.– Да, сегодня продукция АЭМЗ не только и: – Yes, today AEMZ products not only go to the regions of Kazakhstan, but are also exported to Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Afghanistan. In general, export supplies of our products in 2012 compared to 2011 increased by 78%. Thus, in 2012, we significantly expanded our export direction by supplying KRUN (complete outdoor switchgear) to Kyrgyzstan. Our immediate plans include further development of new markets.
en.В состав Alageum Electric входят: АО «Пр: Alageum Electric includes: Promenergo Design Institute JSC, Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, Nur-Stroy LTD LLP and Elektromontazh JSC (ELMO). The company's products meet Kazakh and international quality standards and are exported to Russia, Central Asian countries, Afghanistan and Azerbaijan. The company has a wide service network of branches in all regions of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The holding is the holder of the titles “Best business partner of technical and vocational education” from the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan, “Best Exporter” from the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan and “Best Supplier” from JSC Exploration Production KazMunayGas. And in 2012, the company’s products were awarded the Altyn Sapa Prize of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan
en.– Особого усиления конкуренции со сторон: – We do not see any particular increase in competition from the CU members – Russia and Belarus. The share of exports in Alageum Electric's total sales is 30%. At the same time, the lion's share falls on the Russian market (32.5%), which the company began to develop back in 2001. The creation of a Common Economic Space with Russia and Belarus may soon affect the activities of Alageum. In particular, the rules in the public procurement system are changing in Kazakhstan. Now Russian and Belarusian companies will be able to take part in government tenders and competitions on an equal basis with Kazakh ones.
en.– Жесткая конкуренция в рамках ВТО, дума: – Fierce competition within the WTO, I think, is possible only after 2020. Because within the framework of SPFIID, the state provides a number of benefits and preferences, borrowed funds with a low interest rate. According to our forecasts, mergers and acquisitions will begin after 2020. Large transnational companies with extensive experience, high quality of service, management, that is, with great opportunities, will come to our market. During the 6-7 year transition period, I think we will have time to optimize our costs, reduce the cost of our products and be prepared for all stressful situations. Currently, labor productivity in the company is $75–80 thousand per year per employee. This is already a very good indicator, but we have room to grow.
en.– Одна из основных причин, позволивших н: – One of the main reasons that allowed us to avoid the fate of many machine-building enterprises and not go bankrupt, in addition to the timely modernization of production, was personnel training. Today, in fact, the main problem of enterprises in all sectors of the economy is personnel. It is clear that money allows you to attract and buy any technology, equipment, build factories, but the question is who will implement the project?
We are solving this problem together with universities. For example, Almaty University of Energy and Communications, Kazakh National Technical University named after K. I. Satpayev, Kazakh Academy of Transport and Communications named after M. Tynyshpayev are our partners in training. We also cooperate with the Almaty State College of Energy and Electronic Technologies, vocational lyceum No. 9. On average, 5–10 people from these universities undergo internship at our plant every year. From secondary specialized educational institutions – 15–25 people. Many of the trainees come to us as employees after receiving their diploma.
en.Вообще, к вопросу подготовки кадрового с: In general, Alageum Electric took the issue of personnel training more than seriously - the company opened in 2012 and fully funds the Kentau Polytechnic College for 300 people. Currently, 268 students are studying there under the dual education program, where they have the opportunity to gain theoretical and practical skills. Every year we carry out propaganda work among applicants from Kentau and Turkestan, attracting young people to study engineering specialties, and also invite students to paid practical training. It is noteworthy that Kentau Polytechnic College has become the third specialized educational institution in Kazakhstan after the colleges of Balkhash and Temirtau, but projects there are financed by such industrial giants as Kazakhmys and ArcelorMittal.
en.– Мы заключаем с вузами меморандумы на д: – We conclude memorandums with universities on a long-term basis. Both sides are interested in this. After all, this is how we solve the issue of personnel, and universities solve the issue of employing future graduates. Within the framework of these memorandums, we carry out joint training of qualified specialists in the field of electric power industry. During industrial practice, students acquire professional skills in the profile of engineering and energy specialties, study the issues of organizing the work of production teams of teams, shifts, sections, and workshops. In general, after studying at a university, all young specialists have the same starting conditions, working in the workshop for the first three months. And only then, based on the results of special testing, do they receive appointments. We send the most talented of them to the technical and design department, where there is a good opportunity to prove themselves.
en.– Востребованы ли сегодня молодые специа: – Are young specialists in demand in manufacturing today? And how, in your opinion, can we solve the problem of youth unemployment?
en.– Разумеется, востребованы. Ни для кого: – Of course, they are in demand. It's no secret that the shortage of qualified personnel is an acute problem facing manufacturing enterprises in all sectors of the economy of our country. Today, not all enterprises have the opportunity to educate and train personnel on their own. They try to solve these problems through recruitment agencies, luring specialists from each other. Thus, these specialists artificially inflate their value each time, and this negatively affects the labor market.
en.За последние годы в РК были запущены сот: In recent years, hundreds of enterprises have been launched in the Republic of Kazakhstan that require engineering workers. As you remember, the issue of developing the engineering education system is identified as a priority in the current Address of the Head of State. As an energy engineer, I would especially like to emphasize that we need qualified personnel for our industry. Unfortunately, the country does not yet have a scientific and industrial institute or a scientific and engineering center in the field of electrical engineering, where our employees could improve their skills. I think such a center could significantly influence the resolution of the personnel issue. Moreover, in his Address to the people of Kazakhstan, President of the Republic of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev especially emphasizes the importance of creating a system of specialized educational institutions for research and applied education in the republic.
en.– На нашем заводе к молодым специалистам: – At our plant, young specialists are treated very responsibly and with warmth. A new person comes to our plant - a mentor is assigned to him and helps him. Under the guidance of an experienced employee, young staff learn quickly.
en.Да, работа на производстве непростая, но: Yes, work in production is not easy, but it is much more interesting than office work. I can confirm from my own experience that the career here is much better than that of office workers, and the work is well paid. In addition, working in complex high-tech production is also prestigious. But the most pleasant thing is that you are engaged in the production of products necessary for any sphere and industry, because they are in demand in all sectors of the economy.
en.Кроме того, стабильная работа, хороший з: In addition, stable work and good earnings give confidence in the future. I would like to advise young people who have not yet decided on their choice of profession: do not be afraid to go into production and master technical specialties. Manufacturing work will always be valuable.
en.– Успешное развитие МСБ всегда требует п: – Successful development of SMEs always requires government support. Without it, it is difficult for small and medium-sized businesses to develop and strengthen their position in the market. State support provides a good opportunity for lending and a quick search for “long-term” money. So we, in order to develop our production and increase the competitiveness of our products, became participants in state programs. Today, AEMZ takes part in a number of government programs, one of which is “Damu-Ondiris”. State support measures provided through this program allow our plant to minimize the cost of repaying the loan. As part of this program, we have been successfully cooperating with second-tier banks for several years, financed by the Stressed Assets Fund.
en.Наш завод также участвует в программе «Д: Our plant also participates in the Business Road Map 2020 program. Here we are working in the second direction of the program - “Improving the business sector.” Thanks to participation in DKB-2020, we have significantly reduced overhead costs. This is very important, especially against the backdrop of the aggressive expansion of similar Russian products into the Kazakh market. We must think about the prospects for the industrial development of our country and energy security in order to transform Kazakhstan from a supplier of raw materials into a country of the highest technologies. This is the only way we will be able to represent the electrical engineering industry of Kazakhstan at the global level.
en.– В рамках участия в данных госпрограмма: – As part of participation in these state programs, new technologies have been introduced into production at the plant, and the production of a number of new types of products has been mastered. For example, our plant, together with specialists from SIEMENS, has begun the development of complete 35 kV switchgears with SF6 circuit breakers of the 35 kV GIS series. The distinctive features of this equipment will be simplicity, reliability, safety and, most importantly, small size. Together with the Italian concern VEI Power Distribution, the plant has mastered the production of small-sized cells of the UNIFLORC and FLUSARK type, as well as complete switchgear units KRU-6 (10) kV of various modifications. In addition, we modernize switchgear with oil circuit breakers, replacing them with vacuum circuit breakers. Work continues on the development and introduction into production of new import-substituting electrical equipment. Thus, today our plant is experiencing a sharp increase in production volume, and its scientific and technical potential has also increased significantly. The main impetus for this was given by the plant’s participation in state programs within the framework of the SPFIID.
en.– Сегодня завод располагает производстве: – Today the plant has the production capacity and all the technical capabilities to fulfill any volume of orders for the country’s energy industry. This is achieved thanks to the enterprise being fully equipped with modern technological equipment from leading European manufacturers. The introduction of innovative technologies has increased the reliability of products, having a positive impact on price characteristics. Naturally, we intend to continue to prove our leadership and confidently keep up with the times.
en.Почти год назад Алматинский электромехан: Almost a year ago, the Almaty Electromechanical Plant began implementing the kaizen system. “Most of the currently existing companies (about 80%) will disappear in the coming decades if they do not change their production management system” - Masaaki Imai, founder of the Kaizen Institute.
en.Каждый управленец рано или поздно сталки: Every manager sooner or later is faced with the need to improve team performance and optimize business processes. You can get ahead in the economy and production, but if you don’t raise personnel to this level, there will be no point. Feeling the severity of this problem, we decided to take the path of training employees, using production meetings and trainings aimed at uniting the team according to the principle “We see together, we know together, we act together.” In this sense, we were attracted to the kaizen system, the philosophy of the Japanese “small village”, where helping each other is elevated to a way of life. And this is surprisingly projected onto large companies: Toyota helps Mazda, Mazda helps someone else.
en.Являясь одним из звеньев холдинговой ком: As part of the Alageum Electric holding company, we, like everyone else, must feel like we are sailing on the same ship...
en.Система японского менеджмента кайдзен уч: The Japanese Kaizen management system teaches to subordinate the personal interests of employees to the interests of improving production processes, the climate in the team, and the desire to work for the benefit of the company. The employee’s thinking and approaches to corporate values ​​have changed: you are on our team, you cannot let the team down.
en.Определив цели и задачи, изучив теорию,: Having defined goals and objectives and studied the theory, we began with the process of mapping specific workshops and areas. Having divided the production area into zones, we created diagrams indicating workplaces and equipment locations. A fresh look at our surroundings convinced us that anti-kaizen reigned at every step. We started by introducing standards for step-by-step actions to maintain order. The workers got down to basic things - they sorted hardware into groups, sorted tools so that drills, for example, did not come into contact with staples, and got rid of junk and “unidentified objects.” We eliminated unproductive intermediate movements by making shelving and new stands for tools. In order not to lose sight and everything is within walking distance - easy to take, easy to use, easy to return to its place. Reasonable simplification freed up time, eliminated searches, and introduced convenience.
en.Не все шло как по маслу. На этапе адапта: Not everything went according to plan. At the adaptation stage, some staff resistance to change was felt. It was like this: two brigades - two completely different approaches. I had to fight inertia, teach me to live according to a standardized order: problem - responsible person - deadline. Thus, red boards with the catchy inscription “problem” appeared in the workshops to record emerging operational issues and resolve them as soon as possible. Color zoning of areas has been introduced. Countless wires disappeared from under my feet. The workers were delighted with the rational and simple solution of using wheeled carts to carry and lift heavy loads. I think - how did they not think of this before?
en.Система кайдзен включает пять взаимосвяз: The Kaizen system includes five interrelated principles of workplace organization, visual control and lean manufacturing. Each has its own Japanese name starting with the letter "S". If you're interested, I can name them. “Seiri” - separate necessary items (tools, parts, materials, documents) from unnecessary ones, get rid of the latter; “seiton” - carefully arrange the rest, placing each item in its place; “seiso” – to maintain cleanliness; "seiketsu" - to be careful, "shitsuke" - to adhere to discipline...
en.Философия малозатратного, успешного, бер: The philosophy of low-cost, successful, lean production implies that each employee of the enterprise follows these five simple rules that do not require the use of new management technologies. This increases labor productivity, enterprise profits and, accordingly, the income level of workers. The process followed a logical chain: adoption of the system, establishing order, delegation of responsibility, regularity of actions and control, consolidation of procedures, strengthening of requirements. The pinnacle of philosophy is constant improvement.
en.Что это дает на практике? На наших глаза: What does this give in practice? Before our eyes, the team is becoming involved in the process of continuous improvement; through the introduction of template standards, time wastage is eliminated and work organization is improved. Both production culture and relationships between people became the object of improvement. For example, we raised the status of a technician to a cleaning manager. And this was received with gratitude.
en.Ни одно производство не обходится без пр: No production is without problems. The more complex the tasks, the greater the likelihood of problems arising. Kaizen has changed our view of them as a chance for development. No wonder the Japanese say: “Welcome problems. Problems are a mountain of wealth”... No one is immune from mistakes; lessons must be learned from them. It is important to find out why the failure occurred? Moreover, do not look for the culprit, but find the reason for his mistake. If you take it out on him, it will be the last time you get honest information about what's going on.
en.Пересмотрев график совещаний, мы отвели: Having revised the schedule of meetings, we allocated strictly defined time and clear topics for each. At planning meetings, there is no former clarification of relationships, where and which service has not worked properly - today these are meetings of a training nature. Boring reports were replaced by discussions of current issues through the eyes of the seller and buyer, making each employee feel like an equal partner of the company.
en.Кайдзен хорошо лег на почву, подготовлен: Kaizen laid well on the ground prepared by the ISO 9001 quality management system. If ISO structures processes by creating functional instructions, then Kaizen created the prerequisites for employee involvement. This is the highest stage, when changes become irreversible and permanent.
en.Мы, производственники, часто используем: We, production workers, often use military terms such as “headquarters”, “front” of work, for example. And this is understandable, because a business process is the same as military operations. Just like in war, within the team you encounter traitors and deserters. But most people’s eyes sparkle – for the sake of their desire to work, it is necessary to create a comfortable psychological climate. The director should be the locomotive behind which the cars are lined up. If the manager presses on the gas, then the result will be, if not, then there is no point in starting.
en.Думаю, у подобных систем, как кайдзен, б: I think that systems like kaizen have a great future. By joining the WTO club, we must learn and adopt experience in optimizing business processes and generally accepted standards. Improvement is progress, development. And by changing the algorithm of actions, we are working not with cutting costs, which can lead to a decrease in product quality, but with reducing losses.
en.Внедрить кайдзен никогда не поздно. И зд: It’s never too late to implement kaizen. And here I will again refer to the saying “No one can go back in time and change their start, but everyone can start now and change their finish”...
en.Cпешим поделиться новостью: Asia Trafo и: We hasten to share the news: Asia Trafo has manufactured the first transformer in the history of the plant for the Republic of Moldova!

en.В историю Холдинговой компании «Alageum: The year 2014 will go down in the history of the Alageum Electric Holding Company as a year. 55th anniversary of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC - the leader of the domestic power engineering industry.
en.20 лет назад завод сделал уверенный рыво: 20 years ago the plant made a confident leap into its future. So phenomenally short was his difficult path from the crisis of the “dashing” 90s to a modern innovative enterprise, a leader in the domestic electrical engineering industry. Serious success became possible thanks to the enormous hard work of the factory workers, selfless dedication and creative energy of each team member. Thanks to this, such high results were achieved. And this is worthy of the highest appreciation, respect and admiration.
en.Сегодня АО «КТЗ» - одно из самых динамич: Today KTZ JSC is one of the most dynamic segments of the holding. Along with increasing production rates, it is developing new types of products, implementing social programs, and improving the living standards of employees. Modern technologies and technical solutions are used, the latest equipment and tools are used. Behind all this lies the enormous creative potential of energy engineers, designers, technologists, and workers. This allows the plant to take leaps and bounds into the future.
en.В канун замечательной даты коллектив ТОО: On the eve of this remarkable date, the team of AEMZ LLP cordially congratulates all employees of KTZ JSC and Alageum Electric Holding Company as a whole on the anniversary of the Kentau Transformer Plant.
en.Желаем Вам, уважаемые коллеги, крепкого: We wish you, dear colleagues, good health, high achievements in your work, prosperity and great personal happiness. We have no doubt that KTZ JSC, founded under the sign of Leo, will remain true to its strength and will become a strong player in the global market in the future.
en.Дорогие друзья, сегодня в нашей компании: Dear friends, today is a significant day in our company. Kentau Transformer Plant is 65 years old.
en.На протяжении всех этих лет наш завод бы: Throughout all these years, our plant has been and remains the heart and pride of the electrical engineering sector in Kazakhstan.
en.По случаю этого знаменательного события: On the occasion of this significant event, we have prepared a special photo carousel that will tell you about the main stages of the development of our plant. Find out more about our achievements, projects and people who made this journey possible.
en.Перелистайте фотографии и прочитайте ист: Flip through the photos and read the story behind each frame. We are confident that you will be inspired by these moments, just as they have inspired us over the years.
en.Спасибо всем нашим сотрудникам, партнера: Thank you to all our employees, partners and customers for your loyalty and support. Together we are moving forward to new achievements and successes!
en.От всего сердца поздравляем мужчин с Дне: We sincerely congratulate men on Defender of the Fatherland Day! This day is designed to praise your courage, perseverance, and loyalty to the Motherland. We would like to thank you for your protection, support and confidence in the future! Let prosperity and mutual understanding reign in your families, and success at work!
en.В Астане в рамках II Съезда партии «Әділ: Saidolla Kozhabayev, the founder of the Alageum Electric group of companies, spoke at the II Congress of the Adilet party in Astana. In his speech, he emphasized the importance of consolidating the efforts of the state, business and society around the values ​​of justice, creative work and responsibility for the future of the country.
en.Партия «Әділет», основанная на принципах: The Adilet party, based on the principles of justice, patriotism, legality, honest work, responsibility and equal opportunities, today unites citizens around the idea of ​​building a Just Kazakhstan. These values ​​are also supported by the business community, which is interested in sustainable economic development, strengthening social stability and creating favorable conditions for doing business.
en.Выступая перед участниками съезда, Сайдо: Speaking to the participants of the congress, Saidolla Kozhabayev noted that the reforms carried out by the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan are aimed at creating a fair and competitive state, where labor is the basis of public well-being, and every citizen has the opportunity to realize their potential.
en.«Справедливое общество – это общество, г: “A just society is a society where work is valued, equal conditions for business are created, the rights of citizens are protected and there is confidence in the future. It is around these principles that it is important to unite the efforts of the state, business and society,” said Saidolla Kozhabayev.
en.Он отметил, что группа компаний Alageum: He noted that the Alageum Electric group of companies has for many years adhered to the principles of social responsibility and is actively involved in the implementation of initiatives aimed at developing human capital, supporting science, education and domestic industry.
en.В ходе выступления были представлены про: During the speech, the company's projects focused on the long-term development of the country were presented. In particular, the endowment fund "Gylym zhane bilim" was created with an initial capital of 2 billion tenge, whose activities are aimed at supporting scientific research, educational programs and training highly qualified specialists for the economy of the future.
en.Особое внимание было уделено перспективн: Particular attention was paid to promising investment projects in the city of Alatau. According to Saidolla Kozhabayev, the company is considering the possibility of implementing large-scale initiatives with a total investment of over 100 billion tenge. These projects will contribute to the development of the industrial potential of the region, the creation of new jobs, the introduction of modern technologies and increasing the competitiveness of the domestic economy.
en.Отдельно была отмечена роль бизнеса в до: The role of business in achieving the country’s strategic goals was separately noted. According to Saidolla Kozhabayev, entrepreneurs should not only create jobs and ensure economic growth, but also take an active part in solving social problems, supporting education, science and youth.
en.Подводя итоги выступления, он призвал пр: Summing up the results of the speech, he called on representatives of the business community to unite around common values - justice, patriotism, creativity, honest work and responsibility for the future of Kazakhstan.
en.Основатель группы компаний «Alageum Elec: The founder of the Alageum Electric group of companies, shareholder and chairman of the supervisory board, Saidulla Kozhabayev, was recognized as “Businessman of the Year” according to Forbes Kazakhstan magazine.
en.В 2022 году группа показала рост на 40%,: In 2022, the group showed growth of 40%, bringing its annual turnover to $407 million, and became the largest manufacturer of transformer equipment in the post-Soviet space. The company also entered the European market, starting supplies of electrical equipment to Hungary.
en.Поддержка казахстанских производителей о: Supporting Kazakh producers remains the most important task of the state, and this support is especially relevant during times of crisis. Affordable conditions and low interest rates allow domestic businesses not only to overcome periods of instability, but also to open up new growth opportunities. The day before, one of the flagships of modern Kazakh electrical engineering - the Kentau Transformer Plant - announced that it had received a loan from Kazkommertsbank. The production workers themselves say that the support is timely and necessary.
en.В сентябре этого года президент Казахста: In September of this year, President of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev, at a meeting with the akims of Aktobe, Atyrau, West Kazakhstan and Mangistau regions, noted that today the whole world is experiencing the impact of the crisis, just like the republic. He said that poorly performing and uncompetitive enterprises have no prospects. “I have repeatedly told our entrepreneurs when joining the EAEU and the WTO about the need to increase their competitiveness. Now we need to reduce costs and increase labor productivity,” the head of state emphasized then. However, today there are examples of how domestic companies can become not only market leaders, but also compete with “neighboring” products in the future.
en.Вопрос импортозамещения достаточно остро: The issue of import substitution has become quite acute in recent years in Kazakhstan, since the policy of diversifying the economy is just beginning to bear fruit. In this regard, government support remains very relevant. At the end of last week, the Kentau Transformer Plant, part of the Alageum Electric group, announced the disbursement of loan funds in the amount of 1 billion tenge received from Kazkommertsbank for the purchase of equipment. This, according to plant representatives, made it possible to support import-substituting production.
en.Средства были выделены в этом году на пя: The funds were allocated this year for a five-year period at a nominal rate of 6% per annum as part of the state program of the Development Bank of Kazakhstan (3rd tranche). All borrowed funds have already been fully disbursed and were used to purchase raw materials for the production of cabinet structures, transformers and substations of various types and types, as well as to replenish working capital.
en.«Электромашиностроение – это сложная и р: “Electrical mechanical engineering is a complex and resource-intensive sector of the economy, and without the support of the state and the bank it would be difficult for us to independently develop this area. Thanks to the timely response of Kazkom, we received a loan and disbursed all loan proceeds in the amount of 1 billion tenge for the purchase of raw materials,” said Khairulla Kozhabaev, managing director of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC.
en.Напомним, что компания производит все ви: Let us recall that the company produces all types of transformer equipment that are in demand in the markets of Kazakhstan and abroad. Previously, new workshops were opened here, and now they produce what previously had to be purchased in Russia - from the smallest parts to completely new finished products. The plant also, for example, began producing wires with enamel insulation for the first time.
en.Трансформаторное оборудование, выпускаем: Transformer equipment produced by the enterprise is used in metallurgy, mechanical engineering, transport, the oil and gas complex and the housing and communal services sector. Among the regular buyers of transformers are such corporations as KazMunaigas, Kazakhstan Temir Zholy, KazTransOil, KEGOC, BI-Group, Orda Invest, Kazzinc, as well as a number of largest enterprises in Russia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan and Afghanistan.
en.Со своей стороны в Казкоммерцбанке отмеч: For its part, Kazkommertsbank notes that financing companies during periods of instability is a necessary measure. “We decided to support the leading manufacturer of transformer equipment in this difficult time for business, given its importance not only for the local but also the foreign market. In addition, it is very important for the development of the idea of ​​import substitution, which the head of state has repeatedly voiced, since the share of Kazakh content in the plant’s products exceeds 80%; few Kazakh industrial enterprises achieve such indicators. We are glad that thanks to our participation, a plant with more than half a century of history will more easily endure temporary economic difficulties,” noted Aigul Dzhaylaubekova, Managing Director of Kazkommertsbank.
en.Очередная партия трансформаторов «Asia T: The next batch of Asia Trafo transformers went to the CIS markets. The equipment will serve the Gorodskaya substation of the Borisoglebsk city power grid, the city of Borisoglebsk, Russian Federation. The 16,000 kVA device is designed to transform voltage from 35 kV to 10 kV in the electrical networks of a power plant. For efficient operation, the two-winding, three-phase transformer is cooled with forced air circulation, with adjustable load switch positions (OLTC). The use of this type of transformer allows us to provide the consumer with a reliable power supply throughout the entire service life - 30 years. The customer noted the high quality of the equipment, the excellent work done on packaging parts and components for transport, and the timely delivery of documentation.
en.Следует отметить, что «Азия Трафо» — кру: It should be noted that Asia Trafo is the largest plant in Central Asia, part of the Alageum Electric group of companies. The main products of the plant are autotransformers of 110, 220, 500 kV and powerful oil transformers with a capacity of up to 500 MVA, as well as reactors. The design capacity of the station is more than 12,000 MVA per year.
en.В Кентауском политехническом колледже об: Students from schools in the city of Kentau, Turkestan, regional centers of the South Kazakhstan region and the Kyzylorda region study at the Kentau Polytechnic College.
en.Стабильно высокие знания в учебе показыв: Children from schools No. 4, 16, 22, 23 in Kentau show consistently high academic knowledge. This was confirmed by the spring Olympiad among colleges of the South Kazakhstan region: four college students, graduates of these schools, took prizes and brought the KPK to 4th place.
en.В целях дальнейшего сотрудничества с луч: In order to further cooperate with the best schools and career guidance work among students, on New Year’s Eve, the director of the KPK S. Aytureev met with high school students of schools No. 16 and 22. The guys received comprehensive information about the college.
en.-Согласно учебным планам до 70-80 % врем: “According to the curriculum, students spend up to 70-80% of their time in production, the rest is spent in classroom work,” noted Serik Abulkhasimovich. - For training and industrial practice, training and work places have been created in 5 workshops of JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant”. The guys master their skills using modern equipment from well-known Western European companies: STOLBERG Germany, LAE Italy, TUBOLY Switzerland, SOENEN Belgium.
en.С. Айтуреев подарил каждому классу насте: S. Aytureev presented each class with a wall clock with the Alageum Electric brand, CCP emblems with the inscription “Time to join the CPC.” KPK students Diaz Amankeldiev and Snow Maiden Milana Magomadova, acting as Father Frost and Snow Maiden, handed each student notebooks, pens and information material with the symbols of the Alageum Electric company.
en.Юноши и девушки долго не отпускали госте: The boys and girls did not let the guests go for a long time - they asked questions, took autographs and did a photo session as a souvenir. The school management expressed great gratitude for such an unexpected and pleasant congratulation, noting that no educational institution has shown such creativity in carrying out career guidance work as the KPK.
en.На базе Костанайского политехнического к: A republican seminar on dual education was held at the Kostanay Polytechnic College.
en.В его работе принял участие директор Кен: The director of the Kentau Polytechnic College at JSC Kentau Transformer Plant S.A. Aytureev took part in its work.
en.Серик Абулкасымович является вице-презид: Serik Abulkasymovich is the vice-president of the Association of Colleges of the Republic of Kazakhstan, a deputy of the Kentau city maslikhat.
en.- Программа семинара была ориентирована: - The seminar program was focused on discussing the tasks of modernizing the system of technical and vocational education. This educational institution has a rich history - in 1971, the Kostanay Polytechnic College was awarded the status of a basic college under the Ministry of Agriculture of the Kazakh SSR for training personnel in the grain industry. Over the years, it has grown into a modern multidisciplinary state educational institution operating in an innovative mode. Since 2012, the Higher Technical School has been working under an experimental program, using the “e-learning” educational process informatization system.
en.Учащиеся колледжа подготовили выставку,: College students prepared an exhibition at which, in addition to specialized food products, an electrical mini-substation and much more were presented. Open classes were held for us in various specialties and areas. They were discussed at the round table, current reports were heard from the Deputy Director for Research and Development O.V. Sinko “Methodological Content of the Institutional Development Plan Project”, Deputy Director for the Institutional Development Plan “Features of the Dual Education System in Germany” A.M. Abikenov and the Head of the Department “Modular Programs Based on a Competency-Based Approach: Experience of Belarus” G.L. Taikov.
en.Команда профессионалов технического обра: A team of technical education professionals, headed by the director of the college, candidate of economic sciences Alma Irgibaevna Doshchanova, chose the words “The Path to Success” as the slogan, defining the trajectory of this unique educational institution. Our young college has a lot to learn from Kostanay Polytechnic College, and we hope for close cooperation,” noted Serik Abulkasimovich.
en.Деятельность Ассоциации направлена на ор: The Association’s activities are aimed at organizing interaction between educational institutions, exchange of information, methodological developments, participation in the international Worldskill movement, which helps to increase the prestige of blue-collar professions, harmonization of best practices and professional standards.
en.Распространение информации о техническом: The dissemination of information about technical espionage is the work of competitors. This was stated by the Chairman of the Board of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC Sergazy Kuntuarov, reports a correspondent of the business information center Kapital.kz.
en.Ранее российские СМИ сообщали, что в Ека: Earlier, Russian media reported that on August 20, a trial began in Yekaterinburg in a case of industrial espionage in the interests of the Kazakh enterprise Kentau Transformer Plant. As TASS reports, the prosecutor's office accuses two residents of Yekaterinburg of industrial espionage. One of the accused is the designer of the MKT Engineering Center company Denis Savokhin, the second is the technical director of the Elton company (the company clarified that he is not their employee - TASS) Alexander Agafonov. The injured party is the Elmash-UETM enterprise, the largest Russian manufacturer of power electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, distribution and consumption of energy. According to investigators, in 2014, Agafonov offered Savokhin, a former employee of the Elmash-UETM enterprise, to obtain a copy of the design documentation with information about the production of high-voltage equipment. As a reward, Agafonov promised an amount of 200 thousand rubles. Savokhin agreed with the current employee of the enterprise, Vladislav Tishchenko, to transfer the documents of interest for 100 thousand rubles.
en.«В августе 2014 года Савохин получил от: “In August 2014, Savokhin received 179 electronic files with design documentation from Tishchenko and transferred them to Agafonov,” the indictment says.
en.«Руководство КТЗ, изучив представленный: “The management of KTZ, having studied the array of information presented in the media, especially notes that not a single publication provided evidence of any interest of KTZ in acquiring the specified drawings. Such attacks against KTZ are not uncommon, given its leading position in the market. Any such attempts by competitors turn out to be in vain, as the history of our long-term success has shown,” says the message written on behalf of the Chairman of the Board of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC (KTZ) Sergazy Kuntuarov.
en.Он добавил, что подобного рода информаци: He added that this kind of information is deliberately disseminated by ill-wishers in order to discredit KTZ. “However, any accusation, especially such a serious one, must be supported by specific facts and evidence, which, we repeat, was not provided in this case. We ask our clients, partners and media representatives not to succumb to provocation,” he said.
en.Сергазы Кунтуарова напомнил, что Кентаус: Sergazy Kuntuarova recalled that the Kentau Transformer Plant has been operating for 56 years. The developments of the company’s specialists “have been in demand on the market for many years, as they are aimed at the requirements of the target audience.” “Therefore, there can be no talk of any technical espionage,” says the head of the company. At the same time, he emphasized that, being leaders in electrical engineering in their industry, they are ready for competition.
en.«Однако хотим отметить, что в нашем пони: “However, we would like to note that in our understanding, healthy competition means a quality product, high professionalism and trust in the plant. Therefore, we are not chasing a momentary effect, we will not copy provocative methods and succumb to the trend of black PR. For us, honor, conscience and engineering progress, which drives KTZ and the production potential of the Republic of Kazakhstan, are above all,” he concluded.
en.Казахстанская электроэнергетическая ассо: Based on the results of 2013, the Kazakhstan Electric Power Association (KEA) awarded honorary titles to the best employees of Kazakhstan for their services and contributions to the development of the electric power industry. Three KEA titles “Honored Energy Engineer” were awarded to the leaders of the leading electrical engineering company of Kazakhstan “Alageum Electric”: Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Alageum Holding Saidulla Kozhabayev, General Director of Alageum Electric JSC Nurmakhan Abdrakhmanov, General Director of ELMO JSC Abutalip Kudaibergen.
en.Еще три звания «Почетный энергетик» КЭА: KEA awarded three more titles of “Honorary Energy Engineer” to the following top managers of the holding - director of the technical department of Alageum Group Omar Asanov, chairman of the board of directors of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC Erkebulan Ilyasov and general director of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC Sergazy Kuntuarov.
en.КЭА - учреждена 7 января 1999 года как н: KEA - established on January 7, 1999 as a non-governmental, non-profit organization. The main task of the Association is to coordinate activities and create conditions for fair functioning, as well as represent and protect the common interests of the subjects of the electric power industry of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
en.На сегодняшний день в ассоциации предста: Today, the association represents: regional power grid companies, generating companies, a system operator, a centralized trading operator, the main industry research and design institutes, manufacturers of energy equipment, the US Energy Association, etc. To encourage industry workers, the association has established the titles - Honored Energy Engineer of KEA, Honorary Energy Engineer of KEA, Veteran Energy Engineer of KEA and Certificate of Merit of KEA.
en.Шпионские страсти разыгрываются вокруг К: Espionage passions are playing out around the Kentau Transformer Plant (KTZ). In the Russian city of Yekaterinburg, a trial began against two local citizens who were suspected of trying to sell KTZ some secret information constituting a trade secret of the Elmash-UETM plant, the largest Russian manufacturer of power electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, distribution and consumption of energy.
en.В конце августа в Орджоникидзевском суде: At the end of August, the Ordzhonikidze court in Yekaterinburg began the trial of two Russians suspected of industrial espionage in favor of Kazakhstan. There were two people in the dock - the chief designer of the MKT Engineering Center company Denis Savokhin and the technical director of the Elton company Alexander Agafonov. Both are suspected of committing a crime under the article “Illegal receipt and disclosure of information constituting a commercial secret.”
en.По данным следствия в 2014 году Александ: According to the investigation, in 2014, Alexander Agafonov contacted Denis Savokhin, a former employee of the Elmash-UETM enterprise, and offered him for 200 thousand rubles to provide a copy of the design documentation, which described the production technology of high-voltage equipment, which was a trade secret of the plant. D. Savokhin, in turn, turned to Vladislav Tishchenko, who was then working at the enterprise, and offered him to hand over the necessary documents for 100 thousand rubles.
en.По материалам следствия в августе 2014 г: According to the investigation, in August 2014, V. Tishchenko handed over to D. Savokhin 179 electronic files with the necessary information, which was subsequently transferred to A. Agafonov.
en.В конце 2014 года Агафонов обратился нап: At the end of 2014, Agafonov turned directly to Tishchenko with a request to copy the second part of the design documentation for a fee of 200 thousand rubles. According to the investigation, Tishchenko handed over 31 files with design documentation and an equipment operating manual to Agafonov.
en.Ущерб от указанных действий , по материа: The damage from these actions, according to the case materials, amounted to a total of 14.6 million rubles. Of this amount, D. Savokhin’s share was 6.4 million rubles, and Agafonov’s share was 8.2 million rubles. During the trial, Alexander Agofonov fully admitted his guilt in the crimes charged against him. At the same time, Denis Savokhin did not admit guilt, noting that he was only indirectly involved in the story and only “handed over the flash drive.”
en.А. Агафонов находится под арестом до окт: A. Agafonov is under arrest until October 2015, D. Savokhin is under recognizance not to leave. The next court hearing is scheduled to take place on September 7.
en.Kursiv.kz обратился к руководству Кентау: Kursiv.kz asked the management of the Kentau Transformer Plant to comment on the ongoing trial in Yekaterinburg of Russian citizens who are suspected of spying for KTZ. It is worth noting that irrefutable evidence has not yet been presented at the trial that the stolen information was intended for KTZ.
en.В эксклюзивном комментарии kursiv.kz пре: In an exclusive comment to kursiv.kz, the Chairman of the Board of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, Sergazy Kuntuarov, noted that the management of KTZ, having studied the array of information available in the media, came to the conclusion that not a single publication provided evidence of KTZ’s interest in acquiring the specified drawings. Such attacks against KTZ are not uncommon, given its leading position in the market, noted S. Kuntuarov.
en.«Любые подобные попытки конкурентов оказ: “Any similar attempts by competitors are futile, as history has shown. We believe that this kind of information is deliberately disseminated by ill-wishers in order to discredit KTZ. However, any accusations, especially such serious ones, must be supported by specific facts and evidence, which, we repeat, was not provided in this case. We ask our clients, partners and media representatives not to succumb to provocation. Over 56 years of operation in the market of the Republic of Kazakhstan and abroad, the Kentau Transformer Plant has become the flagship of electrical engineering. Thanks to dual training at the Kentau Transformer Plant, today we ourselves are raising our own professionals. The developments of specialists are in demand on the market, as they are aimed at the requirements of the target audience. Therefore, there can be no talk of any technical espionage. Competition is one of the main features of a market economy. As leaders in electrical engineering in our industry, we are ready for it. However, we would like to note that in our understanding, healthy competition means a quality product, high professionalism and trust in the plant. Therefore, we are not chasing a momentary effect, we will not copy provocative methods and succumb to the trend of black PR,” he noted.
en.Завод «Asia Trafo» изготовил трехфазный: The Asia Trafo plant manufactured a three-phase power oil transformer TDTNZH with a power of 40,000 kVA and a voltage of 110 kV for the ECh-15 Kostanay substation. The object is located at the Tobol railway station. The transformer is designed to power electrified railways using alternating current. It should be noted that the production of such transformers has no analogues in Kazakhstan and equipment of this type is produced only by the Asia Trafo plant.
en.Шеф монтаж и пусконаладочные работы были: Supervised installation and commissioning work was carried out by Alageum Electric engineers. The plant provides a 3-year warranty for equipment from the moment of its commissioning.
en.В Международный день Матери-земли сотруд: On International Mother Earth Day, employees of Alageum Electric Holding Company as a friendly team went out to plant landscaping and clean up the plant territory. Particular attention was paid to improving the aesthetic appearance of the territory. Work was carried out on whitewashing trees, painting fences, turnstiles, supports, benches and trash cans.
en.\"Субботник это старая традиция нашей ко: “Cleanup work is an old tradition of our company - to put our land in order every spring. In our opinion, it echoes the words of the President about a society of universal labor. As a company that works in the direction of “green” energy, we are always on guard of nature!”, noted Nurzhan Stvayev, Deputy General Director of Alageum Group LLP
en.Ребята почтили минутой молчания память о: The guys observed a minute of silence in memory of the fallen fellow countrymen and internationalist soldiers. Maksat Imanbaev died on January 31, 1987 in a battle near the city of Herat. Awarded the Order “Kyzyl Tu”. Paratrooper Abdikahar Sadanov was killed during the battle on April 11, 1980. Galymbay Kazangapov died after being seriously wounded on July 4, 1980 at the Shaukray pass. Awarded the Order "Kyzyl Tu"...
en.Начальник отделения мобилизации отдела о: The head of the mobilization department of the defense department, Madiyar Tagaev, noted that more than a hundred Afghan veterans are registered with the military registration and enlistment office, who carry out great educational work with young people, setting an example of patriotism and courage.
en.Председатель совета ветеранов-афганцев М: Chairman of the Council of Afghan Veterans Murat Ernazarov shared his memories of those stormy days. His airborne company was the first to enter Kabul in December 1979. After their fighting, regular troops were brought in. These were difficult days. They had to spend the night in the open air and eat dry rations for about 3 months.
en.Студенты интересовались, не страшно ли б: Students wondered if it was scary during the war when they jumped from a parachute? After all, each of them was approximately their age...
en.- Любой нормальный человек испытывает ст: - Any normal person experiences fear, but when there is fighting, you forget about it and try to survive. You just need to be extremely careful and fight wisely. We were taught parachute jumping at airborne training courses,” said Murat Ernazarov.
en.Ветеран-афганец Алимжан Мусаев тоже воев: Afghan veteran Alimzhan Musaev also fought in the airborne battalion, Zharasbek Tursynbekov - in the border troops, they were tasked with not letting the Mujahideen through and supplies of ammunition from other states.
en.Заместитель директора колледжа К.Бакберг: Deputy director of the college K. Backbergen, on behalf of the students, thanked the Afghan soldiers for the interesting episodes of their combat youth.
en.Студенты посмотрели документальный фильм: Students watched a documentary about the Afghan war, Kentau soldiers who died in the Afghan war.
en.Председатель Мажилиса парламента РК Нурл: Chairman of the Mazhilis of the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan Nurlan Nigmatulin met with the workforce of the Kentau Transformer Plant.
en.Мероприятие прошло в рамках визита спике: The event was held as part of the visit of the Speaker of Parliament to the South Kazakhstan region to explain the main provisions of the Address of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan “Kazakhstan Way-2050: common goal, common interests, common future.”
en.Открывая встречу, Нурлан Нигматулин отме: Opening the meeting, Nurlan Nigmatulin noted that today the people of Kazakhstan are faced with an important task - to take direct part in the implementation of the strategic provisions of the Address.
en.Кентауский трансформаторный завод работа: Kentau Transformer Plant operates in one of the basic, knowledge-intensive sectors of the country's economy - electrical engineering. Therefore, issues of innovative industrialization are of enduring importance for him. These important aspects of the fundamental point of the program document, and in general, the strategic course of the President of the country are not new for the enterprise. Nurlan Nigmatulin noted that the high industrial potential of the Kentau Transformer Plant is well known, its focus on modernizing production, using high resource-saving technologies, and the desire to increase the production of new generation products.
en.Говоря в целом о социально-экономическом: Speaking in general about the socio-economic development of the region, the Speaker of the Mazhilis of Parliament noted that the directions of the Presidential Strategy for the introduction of innovation, infrastructure development, and improving the quality of education and healthcare are especially relevant for the South Kazakhstan region. Large production, agricultural and pharmaceutical enterprises are concentrated in the region. Thus, according to 2013 indicators, South Kazakhstanis produced industrial products worth 552 billion tenge, exceeding the results of 2012 by 2.3%. Effective work to implement all the priorities outlined in the Address means, first of all, new jobs, increased investment, and, of course, the social well-being of citizens, Nurlan Nigmatulin emphasized. The Chairman of the Mazhilis spoke in detail about the implementation of the industrialization program in the country, noting that this year alone it is planned to launch 130 enterprises. In total, in the period from 2010 to 2014, 950 production facilities will be created in Kazakhstan to produce more than 250 types of new products. This will expand the export potential of our country,” said the Speaker of the Mazhilis.
en.В ходе беседы рабочие завода задали волн: During the conversation, the plant workers asked questions that concerned them. Thus, design engineer Alexey Yugay inquired about the prospects for the implementation of the Single-Industry Towns Development Program, which is designed to give a powerful impetus to the further development of not only the city, but also its city-forming enterprise - the Kentau Transformer Plant. As part of this Program, noted the director of MonoEleTech LLP Ermek Musabaev, in December a new project for the production of corrugated walls, wires and other components for transformers was launched at the transformer plant. New modern foreign equipment was installed. 50 new jobs were created.
en.Инженер-конструктор Марат Нурынбетов пои: Design engineer Marat Nurynbetov asked which legislative act the Chairman of the Mazhilis of Parliament most remembered the adoption of. Nurlan Nigmatulin gave comprehensive answers to all the questions raised. In general, employees of the Kentau Transformer Plant expressed confidence that the intensive development of innovative technological areas, identified by the Head of State as one of the defining priorities, will have a positive impact on both their enterprise and the region as a whole.
en.Многофункциональный стадион «Туркестан-А: Multifunctional stadium "Turkestan Arena" with a capacity of 7,000 spectators. It was put into operation in August last year. It is the home arena of the Turan football club. The total area of ​​the land plot is 8.3 hectares. The total area of ​​the facility is 35,507 m2, including the building area of ​​19,847 m2;
en.Здание представляет собой открытую арену: The building is an open arena with stands on the west and east sides. The sports facility also houses acrobatics, boxing, and weightlifting halls. The stadium received a UEFA classification category of 3, which will allow the arena to host international sporting events in the future.
en.Для обеспечения спортивной арены электри: To provide the sports arena with electricity, the Alageum Electric team supplied a distribution substation with two transformers with a capacity of 2000 kVA, with a primary voltage of 10 kV and a secondary voltage of 0.4 kV.
en.Филиалы компании «Alageum Electric» расп: Branches of the Alageum Electric company are located in all regions of the republic, which allows us to quickly process customer requests and reduce product delivery time. For detailed information about equipment and services, you can contact the company’s call center at +7 771 005 22 22, or by sending an email to sales@alageum.com.
en.Девять сотрудников ХК Alageum Electric 1: Nine employees of Alageum Electric Holding Company left for Germany on November 1, where they will undergo training at leading electrical machine-building enterprises under the Bolashak presidential program.
en.Счастливыми обладателями международной с: The lucky winners of the international scholarship of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan were the leading managers of KTZ JSC: N. Tlemisov, head of the quality and standardization department, M. Shaimerdenov, head of the price calculation group, A. Umbet, chief designer of cabinet products, N. Auelbekov, A. Aitbaev and G. Usenov - design engineers; AEMZ LLP: B. Sarbasov, technical director, K. Baglanbaev, electrical engineer and from Kaztransformator LLP - N. Turganbaev, workshop manager.
en.Директор кадрово-административного депар: Director of the HR and administrative department of Alageum Electric JSC Damir Kenzhigarin talks about the upcoming internship program:
en.- Программа практического обучения исход: - The practical training program is based on the fact that Germany is one of the leaders in the global mechanical engineering market. The business culture created in this country has its own characteristics and advantages. Our specialists will have the opportunity to study the organization of the German engineering industry, business culture, project and environmental management, resource management issues, and energy auditing. They will visit the specialized thematic exhibition EnergybDecentral -2014 in Hannover.
en.У них будет много поездок по промышленны: They will have many trips to the industrial centers of the country. Bolashak Award recipients will study innovation management, health and safety organization and personnel management through a visit to the Dragerwerk AG&Co.KGaA plant in Lübeck, based on a visit to the KNUTH Werkzeugmaschinen GmbH mechanical engineering plant in Wasbeck.
en.Наши специалисты побывают на автомобильн: Our specialists will visit the Volkswagen automobile plant in Wolfsburg, where they will become familiar with the automation process in mass production. A visit to the Lufthansa Technik AG plant will allow you to study service and maintenance as an example, and quality management issues will be possible to study using the example of a visit to the NORO Gesellschaft plant.
en.Специально для стипендиатов-сотрудников: Especially for scholarship holders-employees of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, a transfer to Regensburg will be organized to study the fundamentals of lean manufacturing, production management and delivery goals using the example of a visit to the Jungheinrich plant, innovations in the field of mechanical engineering and exchange of experience with German enterprises using the example of a visit to the Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen GmbH plant.
en.Интересную программу подготовили организ: The organizers prepared an interesting program during their visit to the Siemens plant in Berlin - here Kazakh trainees will be introduced to the features of lean manufacturing. The basics of SAP automated production control will be demonstrated by visiting the BMW automobile plant as an example.
en.Это очень насыщенная поездка, которая ст: This is a very eventful trip, which was made possible thanks to our close cooperation with relevant ministries and government agencies. The 9 scholarships we received out of a total of 50 places is a great success.
en.Обучение каждого стипендиата бюджету стр: Training for each scholarship recipient costs the country’s budget 5 million 400 thousand tenge. As a result, the amount of funds raised amounted to 48.600 million. Plus, each scholarship holder is paid a stipend.
en.Стали известны стипендиаты президентской: The recipients of the presidential scholarship under the Bolashak program have become known. Nine employees of the holding company Alageum Electric successfully passed all stages of testing, becoming owners of a prestigious scholarship giving the right to undergo an internship at leading German mechanical engineering plants.
en.Это ведущие менеджеры АО «КТЗ»: Н.Тлемис: These are the leading managers of KTZ JSC: N. Tlemisov, head of the quality and standardization department, M. Shaimerdenov, head of the price calculation group, A. Umbet, chief designer of cabinet products, N. Auelbekov, A. Aitbaev and G. Usenov - design engineers; AEMZ LLP: B. Sarbasov, technical director, K. Baglanbaev, electrical engineer and from Kaztransformator LLP - N. Turganbaev, workshop manager.
en.Претендентам пришлось преодолеть серьезн: The applicants had to overcome serious barriers in the qualifying rounds, demonstrating resistance to stress and demonstrating good knowledge of the Kazakh language.
en.На втором этапе наши коллеги побывали на: At the second stage, our colleagues attended an interview with the vice-ministers of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan and other government agencies. Procedural support of the project was carried out by the director of the personnel and administrative department of Alageum Electric JSC Damir Kenzhigarin. Here's what he says about the results of the competition:
en.- На ограниченное количество мест претен: - There were many applicants for the international scholarship of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan “Bolashak” for a limited number of places. And it is a great success that out of 50 places, 9 scholarships were allocated to our employees. Our colleagues successfully passed all stages of the rigorous selection process. The expert commission gave them a positive assessment.
en.Мы поздравляем всех наших обладателей ст: We congratulate all of our scholarship recipients on this achievement and believe that they will use all the knowledge they gain for the benefit of our company!
en.Городской совет ветеранов весной этого г: The city council of veterans in the spring of this year turned to the administration of the Kentau Polytechnic College at KTZ JSC with a proposal to take care of the war veteran Mukhamedzhan Ismailov.
en.Поддержав инициативу, студенты и педагог: Having supported the initiative, the students and teaching staff decided to assist the front-line soldier in the overhaul of his home.
en.В свободное от учебы время студенты груп: In their free time from study, students of group ES-1-13 Aibek Usmanov, Asylzhan Dzhandabaev, Azamat Abdrakhmanov and Nurbakhyt Zhanabaev came to the front-line soldier’s apartment, wearing work clothes. They redesigned the rooms, installed new doors, updated the ceiling with decorative material, and carried out a major overhaul. And soon the veteran’s former apartment was unrecognizable. The guys worked for a whole month. Mukhamedzhan-ata moved into the renovated apartment on the eve of May 9.
en.Поздравить аксакала с этим знаменательны: Relatives, neighbors, and college students gathered to congratulate the elder on this significant day. The director of the KPK S.A. Aytureev solemnly presented the veteran with a gift - household appliances. Mukhamedzhan Ismailov expressed sincere gratitude to the Head of State, who pays great attention to war veterans, and thanked the college students for their quality work.
en.- До выхода на пенсию я работал учителем: - Before I retired, I worked as a teacher and school director. I am pleased to see that college students are brought up to respect and honor their elders. I was very touched by the care and attention, the diligence and quality with which they carried out the renovation. “I wish them to become professionals in their field,” the veteran wished.
en.4 октября в Шымкенте состоялась торжеств: On October 4, a ceremonial presentation of the first autotransformer in Central Asia and Kazakhstan with a capacity of 63 MVA and a voltage class of 220 kV took place in Shymkent.
en.Инновационный прорыв в сфере машинострое: An innovative breakthrough in the field of mechanical engineering was achieved by combining the efforts of science and business. The heavy-duty autotransformer was developed and produced by scientists and engineers of the Kentau Transformer Plant, part of the Alageum Electric group of companies, KazNIPIITES Energia JSC and Elektrodetal LLP. This development was supported in 2017 within the framework of the “Productive Innovation Consortia” program of the joint Project “Stimulating Productive Innovation”, implemented by the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the World Bank.
en.Разработчик первого в Казахстане высоком: The developer of the first high-power autotransformer in Kazakhstan is Doctor of Technical Sciences, Honored Power Engineer of Kazakhstan Sergey Evgenievich Sokolov. Over the years of work, Sergei Evgenievich has achieved enormous results. The scientist’s scientific works are recognized in Kazakhstan and abroad.
en.«Автотрансформатор мощностью 63 МВА буде: “A 63 MVA autotransformer will be in demand in Kazakhstan, because the need for such transformers is quite high. Abroad, the transformer may well compete with others, taking into account all its advantages,” shared Sergei Evgenievich.
en.Автотрансформатор Кентауского трансформа: The autotransformer of the Kentau Transformer Plant is already ready for use. In the near future, it will distribute electricity to the three largest districts of the Turkestan region: Kelessky, Saryagashsky and Maktaralsky. The agreement has already been concluded with the housing and communal services of the Saryagash district.
en.Спрос на трансформаторы с высокой мощнос: The demand for high power transformers is growing every year. For example, almost all substations in Kazakhstan were built in the 80s of the twentieth century and will soon require serious modernization.
en.Заменить чужое на свое – основная филосо: Replacing someone else’s with your own is the main philosophy of the import substitution program in Kazakhstan. JSC "Kentau Transformer Plant" is working intensively in this direction. A 63 MVA autotransformer with a voltage class of 220 kV is a striking example of large-scale work on import substitution in Kazakhstan.
en.За дополнительной информацией обращайтес: For additional information, please contact: press secretary of Alageum Electric JSC 8 702 111 2950 Anara
en.Группа сотрудников ХК Alageum Electric п: A group of Alageum Electric HC employees visited the TCO plant facilities to familiarize themselves with the installed electrical substations and installed equipment from other manufacturers (substation RP-4 and RP-10).
en.АО «Alageum Electric» представляли главн: Alageum Electric JSC was represented by the chief designer for cabinet structures Almas Umbet, the chief designer for transformers Evgeniy Yugay, and the director of AtMU JSC ELMO Arman Zharylgasov. Participating from Tengizchevroil LLP were Viktor Kvashchuk, supervisor of the TCO power system operation group, Gavin Glass, leading engineer for electricity and reliability of the TCO FE department, Nurlan Shayrov, TCO FE project engineer, Napigolla Karimov, specialist of the Kazakhstan content development group, TCO contract drafting department.
en.Как известно, компания «Тенгизшевройл» я: As is known, the Tengizchevroil company is the largest oil producing enterprise in Kazakhstan, carrying out geological exploration and development of the giant Tengiz field in the Atyrau region.
en.- Работа по сотрудничеству с ТОО «Тенгиз: “We have been working on cooperation with Tengizchevroil LLP, which is distinguished by world standards for ensuring production safety, high performance in the field of environmental protection, and reliability of production operations, since 2012,” says Arman Zharylgasov.
en.- В целях получения доступа в качестве у: - In order to gain access as a tender participant, the holding company Alageum Electric held a series of negotiations. And it gave results. An agreement has been reached, according to which Alageum Electric is now on the short list of suppliers. ELMO JSC also has common ground - the company provided the operator with a package of documents for the scope of work “External power supply of the Tengiz rotation camp” for 2015, which was sent for examination.
en.- По прибытии на месторождение Тенгиз у: - Upon arrival at the Tengiz field, we had a meeting with the main specialists who showed us the operating substations. After the appropriate safety procedures, it is clear that serious attention is paid to occupational safety here; we were given personal respiratory protection equipment, as well as dosimeter sensors. After driving through the facilities, we inspected two substations. Each has an electronic access system.
en.Размеры подстанции - ширина 8-10 м и дли: Dimensions of the substation - width 8-10 m and length 50-60 m, block-modular type, installed on piles.
