Inside, substation equipment manufactured by Schneider Electric and Siemens. The main requirement is compliance with safety certificates. Considering that all equipment is assembled on microcircuits and microprocessors, a constant temperature is automatically maintained inside the substation in winter and summer, and a powerful ventilation, heating and air conditioning system operates. Overpressure is created inside the substation to prevent dust and gases from entering the room. It operates without maintenance personnel and is fully controlled from the control room by an automation and telemechanics system.
en.При пропадании оперативного напряжения а: When the operating voltage fails, the protection is automatically triggered and the control switches to autonomous power supply, so inside the substation there is a room where batteries are placed on racks. The requirements for substations are very high, so Tengiz does not yet use a single Russian-made substation. The second substation is similar to the first, only slightly smaller in size. We were allowed to take photographs inside the substation. In general, the meeting was fruitful; structural issues related to the manufacture of modular substations were worked out.
en.По итогам встречи был составлен протокол: Following the meeting, a protocol was drawn up, which indicated that the parties came to a preliminary conclusion on the need to organize a visit by TCO specialists to the manufacturing plant and production facilities of Alageum Electric JSC. The approximate date of the return visit is from August 20 to August 25, 2014.
en.В документе по итогам встречи отмечается: The document following the meeting notes that efforts must be made to design Alageum Electric substations in accordance with TCO standards. The Operations Group, as well as the Reliability and Design Groups at the OPPO, will have to decide on which project the AE substations will be used, and coordinate joint efforts to obtain successful results from the project. It was recognized as necessary to participate in the production support group at OPSPO (information management center (IMC) and planning department) in working with the TCO documentation management system. This refers to a long term goal.
en.В протоколе указывается, что помимо подс: The protocol indicates that in addition to substations, Alageum Electric produces various auxiliary electrical equipment, for example, cable trays, concrete cable signs, overhead line auxiliary equipment, etc. TCO MTO Group may consider Alageum Electric as a supplier of auxiliary electrical equipment.
en.Это будет краткосрочной целью для начала: This will be a short-term goal for starting work with our holding company. In order to increase local content, ELMO JSC has the ability to manufacture and supply galvanized metal products, such as high-voltage cross-arms and structures for transformer substations. The company's design engineers and designers will have to study all the requirements (specifications) for the supplier and agree with the customer on the substation equipment components.
en.В данный момент идет согласование по виз: At the moment, approval is underway for the visit of Tengizchevroil LLP specialists to the plants of Alageum Electric.
en.В честь Дня Независимости РК в Кентауско: In honor of the Independence Day of the Republic of Kazakhstan, a tournament in the national game togyzkumalak was held at the Kentau Polytechnic College at KTZ JSC.
en.В соревнованиях приняли участие 12 коман: 12 teams from educational institutions from Kentau and Turkestan took part in the competition. Each team has 2 boys and a girl. The main judge of the tournament was a methodologist, coach of the Togyzkumalak Youth Sports School named after. B. Sattarkhanov Bakir Utebaev.
en.В упорной борьбе первенство одержала ком: In a bitter struggle, the team from secondary school No. 5 of the village won the championship. Khantagy, scoring 13 points, took first place. In second place with 10 points is the team of the Turkestan Humanitarian and Technical College. The KPK team won 3rd place with 9.5 points. The three winners were awarded cups, diplomas and valuable gifts from the KPK administration.
en.Участники соревнований выразили благодар: The competition participants expressed gratitude for the organization of the tournament and hopes that the togyzkumalak games will become traditional. College director S.A. Aytureev, closing the competition, noted that the CPC pays attention to improving the intellectual level of students. And in this regard, the national game togyzkumalak is popular among children. After all, according to archaeological scientists, the game originated about 4,000 years ago. This complex, interesting game has philosophical roots and develops thinking, intelligence, and reaction speed.
en.Большое содействие в проведении соревнов: The Honored Trainer of the Republic of Kazakhstan in Togyzkumalak Abdikasym Zhaksan provided great assistance in holding the competition. He emphasized that the national game has educational, aesthetic, sports and even scientific aspects. Its value lies in the fact that it has a therapeutic effect, developing brain activity and discipline in adolescents. Having played togyzkumalak since childhood, growing up, he can easily build his daily plan and show himself as an individual in any situation.
en.Немаловажно и то, что соревнования прово: It is also important that the competitions were held during the celebration of the main holiday of our country - Independence Day. The game togyzkumalak has become widespread since the country gained independence. There are many adherents of this intellectual game in Kentau; there are national champions and even world champions.
en.На прошедшей в Алматы церемонии награжде: At the award ceremony for the winners of the regional competition-exhibition “The Best Product of Kazakhstan” held in Almaty, Akim of Almaty Akhmetzhan Yesimov presented the General Director of AEMZ LLP Khairulla Kozhabayev with a diploma and a valuable prize in the nomination “Best Industrial Goods”.
en.Надо отметить, что конкуренция в этом го: It should be noted that competition this year was intense - over a hundred industrial companies submitted applications for the competition of domestic producers.
en.Поздравляя победителей конкурса, аким Ал: Congratulating the winners of the competition, Almaty akim Akhmetzhan Yesimov noted that industry is one of the most important sectors of the city’s economy. Now, in the context of increased competition within the Eurasian Economic Union and on the eve of accession to the WTO, it is especially important to concentrate on creating high-quality and competitive products. Industry, like other basic sectors, must grow “ahead” of modern demands.
en.При ознакомлении со стендом ТОО «АЭМЗ» г: When getting acquainted with the stand of AEMZ LLP, the head of the city was interested in the products being manufactured, the production plans of the enterprise, social programs, and wished the team new successes.
en.Производством гофростенок, проводов и ко: The production of corrugated walls, wires and components for transformer equipment will be carried out by MonoEleTech LLP, which opened in Kentau under the single-industry town development program 2012-2020.
en.Директор ТОО - Ермек Ералиевич Мусабаев,: Director of the LLP - Ermek Eralievich Musabaev, who combines the position of leading process engineer for the 1st, 2nd and 3rd assembly of transformers.
en.Завершен монтаж высокотехнологического о: The installation of high-tech equipment at the testing station has been completed. The work was carried out by specialists from AME sri Accessjui Macchine Elettriche, Italy. Acceptance tests of power transformers of the TM, TMG, TSL series with a capacity of 25-2500 kVA were carried out. Installation, commissioning and training were carried out under the guidance of company director Andrea Orrea. The testing station is now fully operational and transformers are being tested.
en.- Линия окраски методом окунания итальян: - The dip painting line of the Italian company “OFFICINE MUNARI” is a modern high-tech line that allows you to paint metal structures of transformers of the TMG-25-2500/6-10 kV type in automatic mode, which completely eliminates the human factor and allows you to obtain high-quality products that meet European standards. The painting line's capacity is designed for 10,000 transformers per year. With the introduction of this line, KTZ JSC will become the first enterprise in the post-Soviet space that has high-level technologies, using it as a competitive advantage. Over its 40-year history, the Italian company OFFICINE MUNARI has successfully implemented 45 dip painting lines and more than 500 different painting lines at leading European enterprises. After completing the installation, Italian specialists will conduct training and education for plant personnel.
en.Вертикальная линия по производству кругл: The vertical line for the production of round enameled aluminum wires EGV-C1500AL+EGV-C700AL of the Italian company SICME ITALIA IMPIANTI is modern high-tech equipment that allows the production of aluminum enameled wires with a diameter from 0.71 mm to 3.15 mm. The productivity of this line is 280 tons per year of finished products. Round aluminum enamel wires have a small insulation thickness, are resistant to heat, and have high physical, mechanical and electrical insulating characteristics. They are used for the manufacture of high voltage windings of 6-10 kV transformers. It should be noted that the Italian company “SICME ITALIA IMPIANTI” is one of the recognized world leaders in the production of enamel lines and, over its half-century of experience, has established itself as an enterprise that produces modern, reliable high-tech equipment.
en.Сотрудники завода участвовали в установк: Plant employees participated in the installation of lines, testing and tuning under the guidance of Italian specialists. The training is conducted by Barra Teresio, a specialist with 35 years of experience in the production of enameled wires. A large number of aluminum wires for our transformers have already been produced. All products have successfully passed acceptance tests at the new testing station.
en.Волочильный станок модели TLLJ-400 фирмы: Drawing machine model TLLJ-400 from DALIAN LTD is a high-performance automated equipment for the production of aluminum busbars with a cross-section of 100-1500mm2 and copper busbars with a cross-section of 100-2400mm2. The productivity of the machine for the production of copper busbars is 1200 kg/hour, aluminum busbars – 450 kg/hour. This allows us to fully meet the needs of the production of transformers, substations and cabinet structures. Installation work is underway, the equipment is planned to be launched by the end of August.
en.Для реализации второй фазы проекта по ст: To implement the second phase of the project for the construction of the Badamsha wind farm, a three-phase two-winding, oil transformer produced by Asia Trafo was sent to the Kargaly district of the Aktobe region. The equipment power was 63,000 kVA; this type of transformer is used to convert voltage in 110/35 kV networks.
en.Ожидается что мощность ветровой электрос: The capacity of the Badamsha wind power plant is expected to be 48 MW. 13 wind turbine generators will provide the region with 198 GWh of electricity annually. The operation of the station will help prevent 172 thousand tons of carbon dioxide emissions per year.
en.Команда «Alageum Electric» рада быть при: The Alageum Electric team is pleased to be involved in the implementation of projects in the field of environmentally friendly energy solutions. We thank the BI Group holding for their experience and trust.
en.Продукция Актауского трансформаторного з: The products of the Aktau transformer plant "Alageum Electric" have found a stable export route.
en.Более 50% продукции, выпускаемой Актауск: More than 50% of the products produced by the Aktau Transformer Plant (ATP) will be exported to Turkmenistan, as stated by the management of the enterprise. The company's main product is power transformers (voltage class 6-10 kW), which are relevant in the neighboring country.
en.Это связано с активной реализацией в Тур: This is due to the active implementation in Turkmenistan of the “Concept for the development of the electric power industry for 2013-2020”, which has become the largest investment project: over 5 billion US dollars are planned to be invested in the development of the electric power industry until 2020. As part of this program, it is planned to build six new power plants and transition to combined control at existing gas turbine stations, which will increase energy capacity without additional natural gas production. The government of Turkmenistan sets itself global goals of rapid development of the electricity industry in comparison with the needs of the socio-economic sphere.
en.Цель - расширение возможности экспорта э: The goal is to expand the possibility of exporting electricity, bringing the electric power industry to a new technological level, improving the controllability and reliability of electrical networks through the use of modern technologies.
en.Параллельно идет процесс реновации элект: In parallel, the process of renovation of electrical networks in rural areas is underway. The adopted “National Program for Transforming the Social and Living Conditions of the Population of Villages, Towns and Cities until 2020” provides for the improvement of electrification of the most remote corners of the country, reconstruction of distribution networks and transformer substations. In this regard, the need for transformer equipment is constantly growing in Turkmenistan.
en.АТЗ - единственное на Прикаспийском побе: ATZ is the only operating Kazakh enterprise on the Caspian coast for the production of transformers, electrical switchboard equipment and components. The favorable geographical location near the most important transport arteries connecting Kazakhstan with Turkmenistan (the Aktau seaport and the Kazakhstan-Turkmenistan-Iran railway line) allows us to increase export potential in the foreseeable future.
en.\"Проведенный нами маркетинговый анализ: “Our marketing analysis of the electrical equipment market in Turkmenistan showed that in this country there are no transformer plants similar to our enterprise. We plan to export more than 50 percent of our products to Turkmenistan,” explains the director of the Aktau Transformer Plant, Olzhas Esirkepov.
en.Актауский трансформаторный завод, проект: Aktau Transformer Plant, the project of which was launched within the framework of the State Program for Industrial and Innovative Development in 2015, is designed to produce 4 thousand transformer substations (that is, 20 units daily). After the plant reaches its design capacity, the annual volume of the enterprise will be 6 billion tenge. It is also predicted that the ATP will satisfy 90% of the needs of the Mangistau region for transformers and electrical switchboard equipment.
en.В ноябре прошлого года руководство АТЗ в: In November last year, the management of ATP, as part of the business delegation of the Mangystau region, took part in the cross-border cooperation forum held in the Balkan velayat (region) of the Turkmen Republic. It is this region that in the last decade has shown rapid rates of development of the oil, gas, chemical industries and, accordingly, the electric power industry. The gas turbine stations installed here with a total capacity of 508.4 MW make it possible to increase electricity production by 40 percent and export it to Iran.
en.Строительство высоковольтной линии элект: The construction of the high-voltage power transmission line Balkanabat-Aliabad (Iran) necessitated the large-scale purchase of transformer substations. In this regard, an agreement was concluded on direct supplies of products from the Aktau Transformer Plant to Turkmenistan. The modernization project of Aktau Transformer Plant LLP, worth 2 billion tenge and the creation of 150 jobs, was carried out by Alageum Electric within the framework of the State Program for Industrial and Innovative Development.
en.Холдинг Alageum Electric, считается лиде: Alageum Electric holding is considered the leader in electrical engineering in Kazakhstan, whose main activity is transformer manufacturing.
en.Уральский трансформаторный завод – новое: The Ural Transformer Plant is a new production facility that is not even six months old. It was opened in December 2014 in one of the buildings of the Omega instrument-making plant, which was purchased and completely renovated. Up to 90% of UTZ products are exported to Russia.
en.Поясним, что акционером предприятия явля: Let us explain that the shareholder of the enterprise is the management company “Alageum Group” (Almaty), which, along with Design Institute JSC, Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP and Shymkent Metal Structures Plant LLP, also includes Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, which is the largest enterprise in Kazakhstan producing transformers.
en.В Уральске этот проект, стоимостью 3,1 м: In Uralsk, this project, worth 3.1 billion tenge, was launched during a nationwide teleconference on the results of the country’s industrialization with the participation of the head of state. The Ural Transformer Plant is focused on the production of three-phase power oil transformers with a capacity of 10,000 units per year and a voltage of 6-10 kV. This production was established in our city for the first time with the aim of entering the Russian market within the framework of the Eurasian Economic Union, which opens up great consumer opportunities for Kazakh producers and, first of all, in the border zone.
en.— Такой экономический союз только улучши: “Such an economic union will only improve the business climate, as well as deepen integration processes and establish foreign trade relations, stimulating entrepreneurship, which is what President Nursultan Nazarbayev says in his message “Nurly Zhol - the path to the future,” commented representatives of local authorities on the opening of a new production facility in our city. – The object is included in the industrialization map. This is the first such plant in the west of the country, where, by the way, dual training is used.
en.Надеждинцы побывали на территории завода: Nadezhda residents visited the plant and were personally convinced of the seriousness of the production process for the production of transformers.
en.— Проект получил поддержку в рамках прог: “The project received support within the framework of the Business Road Map 2020 program to subsidize the interest rate for a loan amount of 2.6 billion tenge, gas supply was supplied for 17.3 million,” says managing director of UTZ Askar AZHAEV. — Potential consumers of power transformers are large companies in the oil and gas industry, enterprises of the energy complex and railways, including Russian ones. We not only manufacture transformers, but also, so to speak, deliver them on a turnkey basis, including design, construction of a substation, installation of equipment and maintenance during operation.
en.Электротехническая сталь, которую закупа: Electrical steel, which is purchased in Yekaterinburg, is the heart of the manufactured transformer, as it makes up its bulk. Unfortunately, it is not produced in Kazakhstan. The steel is delivered in special rolls, and is then cut and processed at the factory. But transformer oil is purchased from Azerbaijan.
en.— Штатная численность рабочих на заводе: “The number of workers at the plant is 150 people, of which about 100 are personnel from Uralsk,” continues Askar Azhaev. – By 2017, we plan to expand our staff to 600 jobs. Many guys completed an internship at the transformer plant in Kentau; among the specialists there are also those who came from this city to work in Uralsk in order to teach the factory workers the intricacies of production here. In addition, we entered into memorandums with local universities WKSU and WKATU so that students from these educational institutions could undergo internships at our plant.
en.Что касается оборудования, то на трансфо: As for equipment, the transformer plant has high-tech units produced in European countries such as Switzerland, Germany and Italy. Cutting parts from sheet metal, for example, is carried out on a laser cutting machine, punching holes on a jig press, machining on a semi-automatic saw, and welding on semi-automatic welding machines. Interestingly, out of the two dozen factories in the CIS that produce distribution transformers, only a few can provide filling of transformer oil under vacuum, which is what is done at UTZ. This eliminates the need for maintenance of transformers during their entire service life. And high-quality painting of the surface of corrugated transformer tanks is carried out by the dipping method, making it possible to obtain high-quality products and the required coating thickness over the entire surface.
en.Один огромный цех, где все буквально све: One huge workshop, where everything literally sparkles with cleanliness, is divided into eight sections, each of which is in full swing with work. As UTZ employees note, the production of transformers is quite labor-intensive. It begins with welding and assembly of the metal structure, into which the transformer is then placed, and ends with the installation of insulators and filling of oil. The transformer can be assembled in half a day. The most powerful weighs up to six tons. It is used in the national economy and for power supply of large residential complexes.
en.— В этом году запланирован выпуск 3000 т: “This year it is planned to produce 3,000 transformers worth 2 billion 100 million tenge,” sums up Askar Azhaev. – In the future, we also plan to take advantage of government benefits and preferences that exist for promoting products, introducing consulting services and training personnel. When the plant reaches its full design capacity, the production volume will be 12,000 transformers per year.
en.Кстати, компания планирует также решить: By the way, the company also plans to resolve the issue of buying out the remaining shares from the Omega plant in order to use other production areas, many of which are now empty. This was stated by the plant’s management during a recent official working visit of the country’s president, who, along with other facilities in the region, visited the Ural TZ. Nursultan Nazarbayev then emphasized that thanks to the support provided by the state, the enterprise is ready for further development, having every opportunity to export products within the Eurasian Economic Union:
en.– Государство оказало заводу мощную подд: – The state provided strong support to the plant, now they will develop the Russian and domestic markets. While factories in other countries are closing, we are opening new ones. During this year, many factories will be built in Kazakhstan and 25 thousand jobs will open. The Nurly Zhol program provides for the construction of roads, hospitals, and schools. The modernization of housing and communal services will also continue. The state is ready to support such projects, so go for it!
en.Впервые заводом ТОО \"Asia Trafo\" были: For the first time, the Asia Trafo LLP plant produced and shipped transformers to the Republic of Azerbaijan. Transformers of type TDNS-25000/35/10 kV in the amount of two pieces together with components were shipped to the site. Currently, the transformers are in Baku and are awaiting the readiness of the facility after installation supervision.
en.На сегодняшний день строительство отечес: Today, the construction of the largest domestic plant, Asia Trafo, for the production of transformers, autotransformers and shunt reactors weighing up to 300 tons is in full swing. Asia Trafo will be one of the first transformer factories in Kazakhstan, which will develop and produce shunt reactors, autotransformers, transformers weighing up to 300 tons for various purposes of energy and industrial power networks.
en.Стоит отметить, в проектировании трансфо: It is worth noting that modern software will be used in the design of transformers.
en.На данный момент по строительству завода: At the moment, the installation of equipment for the construction of the plant has been completed: a radial drilling machine R60 and R100 from the German company KNUTH. They are prepared for installation and awaiting the arrival of the chief engineer of the longitudinal and transverse cutting line for Tuboly-Asronic electrical steel from Switzerland.
en.Трудно переоценить значение холдинга Ala: It is difficult to overestimate the importance of the Alageum Electric holding as a source of personnel for the domestic transformer industry, a scientific and production base for the development of this most important branch of the electrical industry. The experience gained by Alageum Electric was used in the design, construction and organization of the unique Asia Trafo plant in Central Asia. The project is being implemented with the financial support of Development Bank of Kazakhstan JSC and DBK-Leasing JSC. The total volume of investments amounted to 17.9 billion tenge, of which 13.5 billion tenge were borrowed funds.
en.Как отмечает генеральный директор завода: As the general director of the Asia Trafo plant, Sergazy Kuntuarov, notes: “We relied on new modern technologies, new technological thinking and a highly qualified team, providing employees with comfortable and safe working conditions.” Asia Trafo, in a competitive environment, has formed a targeted development strategy aimed at outstripping potential competitors in terms of the quality and reliability of the products being developed. The strategy being implemented will be based on modern software products.
en.В Туркестане прошёл форум «Адал азамат,: A forum “Adal azamat, Adal enbek, Adal tabys” was held in Turkestan for college graduates, aimed at increasing the prestige of working professions and promoting youth employment. A job fair was held at the forum site with the participation of leading regional and republican enterprises.
en.Особый интерес вызвало выступление предс: The speech of the Chairman of the Board of JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant” Bauyrzhan Amangeldievich Khudaibergenov was of particular interest. He presented the activities of the enterprise and presented 5 graduates with directions for employment. For his contribution to the development of technical education, Bauyrzhan Khudaibergenov was awarded a letter of gratitude from the akimat of the Turkestan region. The event took place with the active participation of Kentau Polytechnic College.
en.С 11 по 13 сентября АО «КТЗ» будет участ: From September 11 to 13, KTZ JSC will participate in the 7th international exhibition “Main directions of growth of the energy industry of Turkmenistan-2014”.
en.Эту площадку предприятие традиционно исп: The company traditionally uses this platform to present the products of KTZ JSC and establish contacts with potential consumers for the purpose of long-term cooperation.
en.- Туркменистан входит в число перспектив: “Turkmenistan is among the promising consumers of the products of the Kentau Transformer Plant,” says Anatoly Anatolyevich Zubkov, sales director of KTZ JSC. – He is interested in transformer equipment for a wide range of applications - power oil and dry transformers 10, 35, 110 kV with a power of up to 63,000 kVA, substations of various types (open switchgear, switchgear, indoor switchgear, control unit 35, 110 kV), low-voltage and high-voltage cells and much other popular electrical equipment. In general, the entire range that is produced by our plant.
en.В 2013 году АО «КТЗ» отгрузило продукцию: In 2013, KTZ JSC shipped products ordered by a number of Turkmen companies, such as Red Arrows General Trading L.L.C., TURENT TRADING INC, Dexter Trade Limited, etc. This year, the plant entered into an agreement for the supply of electrical products to COMCOTAYM LP.
en.Мы высоко ценим всех наших партнеров, ка: We highly value all our partners, both in the Republic of Kazakhstan and beyond, and try to create all conditions for mutually beneficial and long-term cooperation.
en.В рамках празднования 55-летия АО «Кента: As part of the celebration of the 55th anniversary of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC, a mini-football tournament was held in the indoor hall of the railway workers’ stadium in Turkestan among the structural divisions of the Alageum Group HC.
en.В турнире приняли участие команды ТОО «А: The teams of AEMZ LLP, Kaztransformator LLP, KTZ-1 and KTZ-2 took part in the tournament. From the first minutes, the players made it clear that every sports team will fight for victory to the last!
en.Игра была интересной, острой, захватываю: The game was interesting, sharp, exciting. In the final, the winners were determined - the main prize for taking first place went to the KTZ-1 team. “Silver” was won by the football players of “AEMZ” LLP, “bronze” was won by the second team of “KTZ-2”. The promising sports team of Kaztransformator LLP closed the top four of the tournament.
en.Командам были вручены кубки, грамоты и д: The teams were awarded cups, certificates and cash prizes. The most distinguished players were also awarded certificates and cash prizes in the following categories: “Best Player” - Mirali Abdiev, head of the logistics department of AEMZ LLP, “Best Forward” - Zhandos Abdrakhmanov, 2nd category electrician of the installation and assembly area of AEMZ LLP, "Best Defender" - Olzhas Mambetkulov, operator of vacuum drying ovens of the production workshop 35 kV transformers of KTZ JSC, “Best goalkeeper” - Baurzhan Fayzulla, foreman of the workshop for the production of cabinet structures of KTZ JSC. Congratulations to all the winners!
en.С целью популяризации шахмат в г. Кентау: In order to popularize chess in Kentau, identify strong players for opening a chess club in the future on the basis of the Kentau Polytechnic College, a city chess tournament was held dedicated to the 70th anniversary of the Great Victory.
en.В турнире приняли участие 40 учащихся шк: 40 students from city schools and students from Kentau Polytechnic College took part in the tournament. The judging was headed by candidate master of sports in chess Serik Kydyrbaev.
en.Церемония открытия началась с исполнения: The opening ceremony began with the performance of the National Anthem. In his welcoming speech to the tournament participants, the director of the college, Serik Abilkasimovich Aytureev, noted that once there were a lot of talented chess players in Kentau, many of them worked at the Kentau Transformer Plant. However, recently this sport has lost popularity and traditions have been lost. Today, none of the city's educational institutions have chess sections. To revive the interest of the younger generation in this intellectual game, the CCP administration is holding a tournament.
en.Почетным гостем соревнований стал Абдима: The guest of honor of the competition was Abdimalik Manapovich Ashirov, Doctor of Science, director of the Shymkent chess school named after Zhansai Abdimalik, grandfather of the nominated international grandmaster. Unfortunately, due to her busy training schedule, Zhansaya was unable to take part in the tournament.
en.Свое выступление Абдималик Манапович нач: Abdimalik Manapovich began his speech by showing a slide with her photographs, saying that already at the age of 6 she won her first title of Almaty champion among children under 8 years old. In January 2014, at the opening of the Chess Academy named after her, she played with one of the most titled chess players of the 20th century, ex-world champion Anatoly Karpov. Zhansaya lost both rapid games (up to 20 minutes), but won one blitz game (up to 15 minutes) against the famous chess player, and drew the other.
en.Турнир проводился по олимпийской системе: The tournament was held according to the Olympic system. 40 participants were divided into 20 pairs by lot. After the first game, 20 chess players were eliminated, after the second, 5 pairs of players remained. Each game lasted 30 minutes. The winner of the tournament was Sergei Andryukhin, an 11th grade student from school No. 5. Second and third places were shared by 9th grade student Zangar Usenov from school No. 9 and a tenth grader from the Kazakh-Turkish Lyceum Kasym Kurshat Batash. KPK students entered the top ten strongest players.
en.На память об этой игре юным шахматистам: As a keepsake of this game, the young chess players were given Alageum Electric branded notebooks with A. Ashirov’s autograph. The college director presented cash prizes to the winners. The tournament participants got acquainted with the college, which trains intellectuals and everyone here can choose a prestigious technical specialty.
en.По инициативе председателя наблюдательно: At the initiative of the chairman of the supervisory board of the holding company Alageum Electric, Saturday at KTZ JSC and the Kentau Polytechnic College was declared a “creative day” for self-development of students and young workers of KTZ.
en.Свою идею Сайдулла Ильясович Кожабаев сф: Saidulla Ilyasovich Kozhabaev formulated his idea as follows: it is necessary to develop the interest of young people in the electric power industry and economics, to stimulate the desire for independent scientific research in transformer engineering.
en.Вопросы новых подходов к подготовке моло: Issues of new approaches to training young specialists were discussed at a round table meeting with the participation of plant managers, young specialists, teaching staff and college students.
en.Открывая встречу, С. И. Кожабаев отметил: Opening the meeting, S.I. Kozhabayev noted that today the country has created all favorable conditions for obtaining quality education, deep knowledge, intellectual and physical growth and self-improvement for young people. You need to actively use this, work on yourself, and not be lazy. Only hard and persistent work will lead everyone to their dreams and help them reach the heights outlined by the Head of State in the Address to the people of Kazakhstan “Nurly Zhol”.
en.Своим видением задач в области молодежно: Chairman of the Board of KTZ JSC S.N. Kuntuarov, Deputy Chairman of the Board Kh.B. Kozhabaev, Financial Director of KTZ JSC O.P. Dotsenko, College Director S.A. shared their vision of the tasks in the field of youth policy in production. Aytureev, young specialists of KTZ.
en.На встрече был обсужден и другой важный: Another important issue was discussed at the meeting - the tasks of the KTZ Young Leaders Club in increasing the level of knowledge and nurturing leadership qualities among students and young employees of the enterprise, supporting and promoting the most talented working youth.
en.Активным было обсуждение кандидатур на д: There was an active discussion of candidates for the position of Chairman of the Club. Three candidates shared their election platform. During the voting, Mukhtar Kenzhebekov, Deputy Director for Sales of KTZ JSC, was elected chairman of the Young Leaders Club, and Daulet Alpysbay, a student of the TE-0-12 group, was elected as his deputy.
en.Творческий день продолжила ролевая игра: The creative day was continued by role-playing in the form of management training. Having divided into 4 teams, the participants had to make a situational analysis of KTZ’s activities in order to identify “Weaknesses of KTZ”, “Strengths of KTZ”, “Opportunities of KTZ” and “Threats to KTZ”. During the game, each team characterized the initial situation at the enterprise, identified problems, supplementing the conclusions of other teams. Young specialists discussed the current situation and prospects with teachers and students of the KPK.
en.Подводя итоги ролевой игры, заместитель: Summing up the results of the role-playing game, Deputy Chairman of the Board of KTZ JSC Kh.B. Kozhabaev thanked everyone for their active and interested participation. At the next meeting of the Club, topics of kaizen philosophy, the mission of the holding company and the CPC, and issues of reducing the cost of goods will be discussed.
en.В работе бизнес-форума «Перспективы бизн: General Director of Almaty Electromechanical Plant LLP Kh. Kozhabayev took part in the business forum “Prospects for business cooperation between Almaty and the East Kazakhstan region”, which was held in Ust-Kamenogorsk.
en.- Делегацию из 300 человек возглавил аки: - A delegation of 300 people was headed by Akim of Almaty Akhmetzhan Yessimov. It included representatives of business and business circles of the southern capital, cultural and artistic figures. The busy program of the trip included the comprehensive strengthening of regional cooperation, and in particular in the field of economics and industrial and innovative development. This is a return visit - the first business forum was held in 2013 in Almaty.
en.Приятно, что ТОО «АЭМЗ» была оказана чес: It is pleasant that AEMZ LLP was given the honor of representing commodity producers in Almaty. We were chosen from 1,500 industrial enterprises in the metropolis, of which 180 were large and medium-sized. During the meetings, they discussed the development of new markets in Eastern Kazakhstan by Almaty entrepreneurs. The agreements reached are confirmed by the signing of the Agreement on Mutual Cooperation. The total amount of signed documents amounted to 55 billion tenge, which confirmed the intention of the parties to actively attract investments and establish mutually beneficial relations. The exhibition of products from 20 industrial enterprises of the southern capital aroused great interest. I am confident that the business forum will give impetus to the development of our regions, taking into account the rich potential and attractive business landscape.
en.- Представляя нашу компанию, я отметил,: - Representing our company, I noted that we have long-term ties with consumers of the East Kazakhstan region. In 2013 alone, we supplied products worth 109 million tenge. Since the beginning of 2014, supply volumes reached 128 million tenge. These are mainly power transformers. Our main customers in the region are Kazzinc LLP, VKREK JSC, construction companies.
en.Интерес партнеров вызвало внедрение на н: The partners’ interest was aroused by the introduction of the Toyota production system at our plant, which made it possible to reduce production times, increase productivity and quality of customer service, and create new jobs annually through the expansion of production. Over 2 years, the number of employees increased by 15%. Our plant is attractive both as an exporter, sending products to consumers in Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Afghanistan, and because of its innovative focus. So the business forum was productive for us in terms of new business contacts and new orders.
en.- На бизнес-форуме «Интеграция в условия: - At the business forum “Integration in the Common Economic Space” and the international industrial exhibition “Siberia-Kazakhstan. Commonwealth-2013" Ust-Kamenogorsk branch of JSC "Alageum Electric" was awarded the "Gold Medal" of the winner in the nomination "Best Manufacturer of Electrical Equipment".
en.- Да, это свидетельствует о том, что про: - Yes, this indicates that Alageum Electric products are well known in Siberia, bordering the East Kazakhstan region. The Russian side is interested in creating a common economic space in order to promote high-quality goods, competitive products and services, advanced technologies and scientific developments. I am confident that the signed Treaty on the Eurasian Economic Union will become a catalyst for deepening cooperation and creating a common market. This opens up new opportunities for us, commodity producers. And we will strengthen our presence in this region.
en.АО «Кентауский трансформаторный завод»,: JSC "Kentau Transformer Plant", part of the holding company "Alageum Electric", took part in the annual Russian exhibition "Electrical Networks 2013".
en.«Наша компания подготовилась к данной вы: “Our company was fully prepared for this exhibition and presented the most advanced developments in the field of transformer production. In particular, transformers with oval windings with improved technical characteristics were presented to the public.” – says the head of the representative office of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC in Russia, Ermek Erzhigitov.
en.В этом году «Alageum Electric» принял ре: This year, Alageum Electric decided to participate in the exhibition together with our regional dealers - INVARTRANS LLC and Interregional Transformer Company LLC. “These companies sell and promote our products in the Central Federal District of Russia. They have an extensive customer base and actively promote the brand of Kentau Transformer Plant JSC in Russia. The dynamics of sales growth at the end of 2013 confirms the ambitions and activity of these companies,” explains Mr. Erzhigitov.
en.На выставке холдинг и АО «Кентауский тра: At the exhibition, the holding and Kentau Transformer Plant JSC were represented by an impressive delegation headed by the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Alageum Electric JSC Erkebulan Ilyasov. During the exhibition, negotiations were held with representatives of such companies as JSC IDGC of the North-West, LLC Electrical Systems, JSC Scientific and Technical Center Mekhanotronika, Minsk Electrotechnical Plant named after. Kozlova. Meetings were also held with Russian component supply companies that have representative offices in Kazakhstan and agreements were reached on better prices and delivery conditions.
en.«Наш стенд, подготовленный давним партне: “Our stand, prepared by a long-time partner in the production of exhibition equipment, the ArVin company, attracted attention with its corporate brand and color scheme, already familiar to most visitors,” noted Ermek Erzhigitov with pride.
en.Анализируя результаты выставки можно с у: Analyzing the results of the exhibition, we can say with confidence that the name of our plant no longer raises questions about what kind of plant it is and where it is located, which could have been heard a few years ago. “We can say that we actively and confidently entered the Russian market and the market perceived us as a real and powerful player,” states Mr. Erzhigitov. - We still have a lot of work to do and very strong competition awaits us, and we cannot afford to relax. We face even more important and significant goals. But by choosing good and active partners and offering the market modern equipment of excellent quality, we are capable of these tasks.”
en.В этот цех ветеран труда пришел в далеко: A labor veteran came to this workshop back in 1980, immediately after returning from military service. His mother, Rashida Kharisovna, worked as a site foreman at a factory and insisted that her son also join the work team. G. Egemberdiev mastered the profession of a winder as he worked, starting with low voltage coils. Of course, not everything worked out right away, but there was always a mentor nearby to help in a difficult situation.
en.– Наш участок очень ответственный, ведь: “Our site is very important, because the coil is the heart of the transformer,” says G. Egemberdiev. “Although continuously winding a large number of layers onto a reel creates a certain monotony, our work is varied and interesting. It represents a combination of mental, manual and machine operations. A high pace, in turn, requires increased attention and manual dexterity.
en.Спешка при намотке трансформатора неумес: Haste when winding a transformer is inappropriate. Each operation is timed and precisely calibrated, but many years of experience and knowledge of a labor veteran allow everything to be done quickly and at the highest professional level. So exceeding the daily norm is a common thing for him. And this despite the fact that colleagues constantly approach the shift foreman to ask for advice or help cope with a difficult situation. And more than 20 people work under Gainiya Egemberdiev. Many of them mastered the profession under the guidance of an experienced mentor.
en.За десятилетия работы на заводе ветеран: Over decades of work at the plant, the labor veteran helped many winders learn the intricacies of the profession, who today have become professionals in their field. On the right behind the machine stands his former student Bakhytzhan Musakhanov, on the left is also his frame - Kanat Seilbekov. G. Egemberdiev will also hand over his shift to his pupil Mukhtar Balymbetov.
en.Успешно прошел приемо-сдаточные испытани: The first transformer TMG-630/10-0.4, manufactured at UTZ LLP, successfully passed acceptance tests.
en.По своим техническим характеристикам тра: According to its technical characteristics, the transformer meets the requirements of ND, GOST 111920 and GOST 11677. This is what the top managers of the plant say about the advantages of the new product.
en.- Трансформатор ТМГ-630/10-0,4кВ трехфаз: - Transformer TMG-630/10-0.4 kV three-phase, hermetically sealed, with tap switching without excitation (PBB) on the HV side in the range ± 2 x 2.5%, with a cooling system of the “M” type, step-down, with corrugated tank walls that provide the necessary cooling surface. It is designed for transmission, conversion and distribution of electricity in power supply networks and consumers of alternating current electricity with a nominal frequency of 50 Hz under continuous load in outdoor or indoor installation conditions. Winding material - aluminum, circuit and connection group - Y/Yn-0. At the request of the customer, the plant can produce transformers with copper winding wire.
en.Технологический цикл сборки трансформато: The technological cycle for assembling a transformer is 70 hours, taking into account the preparation of electrical insulating parts, winding windings, lamination of the magnetic circuit, assembling the active part, and about 20 hours are spent on the manufacture of metal structures.
en.Его полная готовность к серийному выпуск: Its full readiness for serial production and operation, compliance with the requirements of ND, GOST 111920 and GOST 11677 was confirmed in the testing center for technical control of transformers and their components. Taking into account the export orientation of the products, voluntary certification was carried out to GOST of the Russian Federation. On June 5, 2015, Certificate No. 1757005 was received on the compliance of transformers produced by UTZ LLP with the standards of the Russian Federation.
en.- Преимущество продукции в том, что высо: - The advantage of the product is that high-tech European equipment for cutting steel from SOENEN and LAE makes it possible to completely eliminate the absence of burrs and other defects in the processed metal, which in turn ensures low no-load losses and leads to a reduction in noise levels.
en.-Температурные колебания объема масла ко: - Temperature fluctuations in oil volume are compensated by elastic deformation of the corrugations of the walls of the transformer tank. Mechanical cycling tests of corrugated tanks confirm their service life for the entire service life of the transformers. Painting of metal structures is carried out on an automatic line using the immersion method "OFFICINE MUNARI" (Italy), which allows obtaining high quality products and the required coating thickness over the entire surface. Transformers of the TMG type are equipped with a limit oil level indicator; to measure the temperature of the upper layers of oil inside the tank, transformers are equipped with mercury thermometers or electric contact thermal alarms.
en.- Испытательный центр ТОО «УТЗ» оснащен: - The testing center of UTZ LLP is equipped with modern computerized stands produced by A.M.E s.r.l. (Italy). They allow you to mechanize and automate the technological process of testing transformers and their components. en.Стоит отметить, что кризис, который прои: It is worth noting that the crisis that occurred and is occurring on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan did not greatly affect the production of the Ural plant:

In order to protect the country's domestic market and economic development, when carrying out government procurement, goods originating from foreign countries are excluded from the national regime. en.Накануне состоялась церемония награждени: The day before, the award ceremony for the winners of the “HR-Brand Kazakhstan 2015 Award” took place - an independent third annual award for the most successful work on the company’s reputation as an employer. The project covered an audience of schoolchildren from grades 5 to 11.

The company's flexible policy regarding the selection and training of applicants allows us to consider not only experienced professionals, but also active young specialists with professional and personal potential and a desire to develop with us. And also since 2012, the Kentau Polytechnic College has been operating under the Kentau Transformer Plant JSC. Today, 410 students are studying there under the dual education program, where they have the opportunity to gain theoretical and practical skills. This year the first 43 certified specialists graduated. Of course, all our efforts and work could not go unnoticed.
en.«Считаю, что удовлетворенность своей раб: “I believe that employee satisfaction with their work is a long-term perspective that determines the success of a business at almost all stages. en.Пиковая водогрейная котельная мощностью: A peak hot water boiler house with a capacity of 200 Gcal/hour will supply energy to the satellite city of Gate City located in the Almaty region. The boiler house will provide warm water to the city built as part of the G4 project, the goal of which is the development of the Almaty region. The scope of the project includes the construction of 3 more satellite cities and 6 Russian-made boilers.
en.На проект G4 было выделено 3 миллиарда т: 3 billion tenge was allocated from the state budget for the G4 project after the holding company Alageum Electric won the tender announced by the akim for power supply to the city of the GateCity satellite in early 2014.
en.Строительство котельной началось в перво: Construction of the boiler house began in the first quarter of 2014. Speaking about the technical characteristics of the boiler room, it should be noted that gaseous and diesel fuel will be used, and softened warm water will be used as a coolant. The uniqueness of this construction project lies in the selection of boiler equipment and chimney design. It must be said that this is the first boiler house in Kazakhstan that has a combined boiler layout, which saves space on the site. The equipment and technologies combined in the project are of European, Kazakh and Russian origin.
en.«В качестве источника тепла запроектиров: “TT300 boilers with a capacity of 40 MW were designed as a heat source, which are the innovative brainchild of one of the factories in Russia; this type of boiler is being installed for the first time on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan,” noted project manager Mikhail Furman.
en.Штат работников котельной насчитывает по: The boiler house staff consists of about 120 employees, some of them work in shifts, depending on the complexity and type of work. At the moment, according to Mikhail Furman, construction work is underway, and landscaping is at the completion stage. We are expecting the supply of water and gas; construction should be completed in August,” the specialist emphasized.
en.Отметим, что строительство четырех город: Note that the construction of four satellite cities has been ongoing over the past years. As part of the project, the government of Kazakhstan allocated more than $380 million. Future satellite cities are designed to ensure a high standard of living and prosperity within the framework of a single urban infrastructure that contributes to the socio-economic development of the Almaty region.
en.Для реализации данных планов за прошедши: To implement these plans, over the past period, with the support of the state, large-scale work has been done: topographical and geotechnical surveys have been carried out, detailed layout plans have been developed, master plans for 4 satellite cities have been developed, and feasibility studies for the construction of utilities have been approved. Currently, as part of the implementation of the first stage, construction of access roads and other engineering infrastructure has begun at the expense of the state budget.
en.Трансформаторный завод в Шымкенте станет: The transformer plant in Shymkent will be one of the first innovative projects in the Kazakh electrical engineering industry, experts say. Now in the South Kazakhstan region, within the framework of the State Program of Industrial and Innovative Development for 2015–2019, the construction of a plant called “AsiaTrafo” is being completed. The plant will produce high-voltage transformers and electrical equipment.
en.Так, основной продукцией завода является: Thus, the main products of the plant are power oil transformers of voltage class from 220 kV to 500 kV. It is worth noting that there are no similar plants producing high-voltage transformers in Central Asia; until recently, energy-saving transformers of domestic production were produced mainly with a power level of 6, 10, 20, 35, 110 kV, and more powerful ones were imported to our country from abroad. As the designers emphasize, the opening of the GPIID plant will reduce imports and raise the domestic electrical industry to a new level.
en.Генеральным проектировщиком крупнейшего: The Energia Institute became the general designer of the largest project in the CIS and Central Asia for the production of power transformers of 110 and 220 kV voltage class (I stage) with the subsequent production of 500 kV transformers and shunt reactors. The plant site is located in the city of Shymkent in the Ontustik industrial zone. It is planned that the total design area of ​​the transformer plant will be 22 hectares.
en.В рамках ГПИИР особое значение для строя: Within the framework of SPIID, digitalization and modernization are of particular importance for facilities under construction. Domestic enterprises are actively switching to digitalization - Industry 4.0.
en.В этой связи, конструирование трансформа: In this regard, the design of transformers will be carried out using software, and a modern 3D modeling design program will also be used. As experts note, the entire production cycle will be automated as much as possible and built according to the Kaizen 5S lean production system.
en.Стоит отметить, что инвестиционный проек: It is worth noting that the investment project cost more than $50 million, with the support of Development Bank of Kazakhstan JSC and DBK-Leasing JSC. The plant is being built by order of the AlageumElectric holding and will become the flagship of the electrical industry in Central Asia. President of the Energy Institute Andrey Isaev noted that all the latest achievements in the field of technology and design are now being studied in order to meet market demands.
en.«В ходе проектирования, мы проработали в: “During the design, we worked through all options for engineering and technical support for the facility, installation of technological equipment, and equipping with complex systems that ensure safety, convenience and labor efficiency. We collaborated with leading Chinese and Kazakh engineering companies, and the Ukrainian company Engineering Innovations also took part in the project,” said Andrey Isaev. According to the designers, the plant will be surrounded by a residential area, including a dormitory, a sports ground and a park area.

As part of strengthening Russian-Kazakh relations, a meeting was held with the Kazakh-Siberian Friendship Center LLC.
en.Полезные встречи, продемонстрировавшие в: Useful meetings that demonstrated a high level of mutual understanding and partnership, business information about the potential of export activities in the Urals - these are the results of the trip to Chelyabinsk. They included business negotiations within the framework of business forums organized by the South Ural Chamber of Commerce and Industry and JSC National Agency for Export and Investment Kaznex Invest. During the advertising and presentation event of Kazakhstani export-oriented enterprises, the Chairman of the Board of Directors E. Ilyasov held bilateral meetings within the framework of the business forum with representatives of the Russian business community: Light Group LLC (production of energy-saving lighting equipment); Firm Sibirsky Trakt LLC (design and production of electrical equipment) and CJSC Energy Grid Company ChTPZ (supplying consumers with electricity, development of the distribution grid complex).
en.Поддержка подобных кооперационных связей: Supporting such cooperative ties will allow us to successfully develop our business abroad. The results of the trip to Omsk and Nizhny Novgorod also showed that Russian partners intend to increase effective cooperation with us. And for us this is the search for new sales channels for products. After all, the Russian electrical market is one of the most promising and provides wide scope for the promotion of our transformer products.
en.Подобные деловые миссии позволяют встрет: Such business missions allow you to meet face to face and directly build relationships. At the same time, Russian partners recognize that Kazakhstan has more favorable state programs to support exporters than Russia, and a more acceptable tax climate for business: if in Kazakhstan the VAT rate is 12%, then in Russia it is much higher - 18%.
en.В ходе данных поездок АО «КТЗ» предостав: During these trips, KTZ JSC provided the above companies with price lists, price offers and a technical catalog of products manufactured by the plant. Russian companies expressed interest in the products of the Kentau plant and their readiness to cooperate. In addition, all contact details of these companies have been transferred to the representative office of KTZ JSC in Moscow.

The project received support within the framework of the “Business Road Map 2020” to subsidize the interest rate for a loan amount of 2.6 billion tenge.

en.В номинации «Лучший игрок» отличился М.К: M. Karimbekov from the AEMZ-2 LLP team distinguished himself in the “Best Player” nomination. The title of “Best Defender” was awarded to M. Zhumanov from the team of AEMZ-1 LLP. B. Faizulla from the team of the cabinet construction workshop was recognized as the best goalkeeper. The winning teams and best players of the tournament, by decision of the organizing committee, were awarded certificates and cash prizes.

This is a great success for the youngest educational institution, which is only in its second year of operation.
en.Состоялось награждение студентов, занявш: An awards ceremony was held for students who took prizes in subjects. Second places were awarded to: in English Alisher Bekbarys, student of group ES-0-13, in Kazakh language and literature - Gaziza Meirash, group UA-0-13, computer science - Daria Nabatchikova, group UA-0-13, Ashirbek Shamshi, group TE-01-13, took 3rd place in physics.
en.С занятым 2 местом в Универсиаде среди к: The head of the sports department of Kentau, K. Musabaev, congratulated the KPK students on taking 2nd place in the Universiade among the city’s colleges. He noted that future power engineers showed their superiority in mini-football and basketball, became winners in togyz-kumalak competitions, and won bronze in volleyball. The victory is significant because their opponents were future physical education teachers and professional athletes. Our guys looked decent in many sports and lost by a minimal margin. At the next Universiade they are determined to take 1st place.
en.Студенты группы ЭС-1-12 и ТЭ-1-12 Кентау: Students of the ES-1-12 and TE-1-12 groups of the Kentau Polytechnic College at JSC KTZ completed a two-week practical training at the Almaty Electromechanical Plant.
en.Обучаясь по дуальной системе, они имеют: By studying according to the dual system, they have the opportunity to combine theory with production practice on the basis of the company’s structural divisions.
en.Президент студенческого Совета КПК Абыла: The President of the Student Council of the KPK, Abylai Tasbolatov, noted that at AEMZ the trainees were greeted very warmly and placed in a dormitory. The general director of the plant, Khairulla Baidildaevich Kozhabaev, conducted an introductory tour, assigning each a mentor.
en.-Будущие энергетики почувствовали ритм н: -Future power engineers felt the rhythm of real production, with strict routines and elements of the Kaizen management system. The plant is equipped with modern equipment and the latest technologies. The impressions from the practice were excellent, the students’ knowledge base was replenished with practical skills, so the 20 days flew by very quickly. The guys hope to carry out their practical training in other structural divisions of Alageum Electric Holding Company,” Abylai shares his plans.
en.Согласно учебному плану 70-80% времени с: According to the curriculum, students spend 70-80% of their time in production. For practical training, training and work places have been created in five workshops of the Kentau Transformer Plant, equipped with modern equipment from well-known Western European companies STOLBERG Germany, LAE Italy, TUBOLY Switzerland, SOENEN Belgium.
en.Кабинеты колледжа оснащены мультимедийно: College classrooms are equipped with multimedia language equipment, interactive whiteboards and projectors; laboratory cabinets have been purchased for teaching chemistry and physics; special instruments have been installed in the laboratories of electrical devices and materials. Students have access to a conference room and a library with a rich collection of general technical, professional and fiction books. The cozy dining room has the latest kitchen equipment. In general, all conditions have been created for fruitful study and leisure.
en.Технический директор ТОО «АЭМЗ» Болат Са: Technical Director of AEMZ LLP Bolat Sarbasov tells how the internship of Kentau students went:
en.- Нас порадовал высокий уровень знаний с: - We were pleased with the high level of knowledge of the college students, their desire to learn more deeply the basics of the production of electromechanical products manufactured at the plant. Upon arrival, having received safety instructions, the guys got acquainted with the specialization and development prospects of the enterprise, the basics of the Kaizen system used at AEMZ LLP, the principles of operation of the installation shop, technical services, where design documentation for installers is prepared. Under the guidance of mentors, they completed the installation of the K-59 cell and ShSN, demonstrating the ability to read wiring and circuit diagrams. Their eyes light up with interest - and this is a good sign, which means that in the future they will become excellent specialists in the energy industry.
en.В форуме принял участие заместитель аким: The forum was attended by Deputy Akim of the region Almaz Badashev, representatives of veteran organizations of energy workers of the CIS, veterans of the energy industry of Russia and Kyrgyzstan, representatives of Samruk-Energy JSC, senior officials of the Ministry of Energy of the Republic of Kazakhstan, heads of energy companies and enterprises, young energy specialists.
en.Как отметили организаторы мероприятия, з: As the organizers of the event noted, it is significant that this event is taking place in the hospitable land of the Urals. The main goal of the forum is to meet veterans of the energy industry from different regions, analyze the current situation in this industry, identify problems and their solutions, as well as professional continuity of generations and care for veterans who have devoted their lives to the development of the domestic energy sector. Deputy akim of the region Almaz Badashev welcomed the forum participants:
en.– Глава государства отметил необходимост: – The head of state noted the need for reorganization in the energy sector. This industry is rightfully considered a core industry; it plays a leading role in the country’s economy. Energy facilities are an element of any infrastructure; even minor interruptions in their operation seriously affect the activities of enterprises and the quality of life of the population. Our region has an extensive complex of distribution networks and substations of various capacities.
en.После официальной части форума, ветераны: After the official part of the forum, energy veterans visited our Ural Transformer Plant LLP and were pleasantly surprised.
en.«Порядок на производстве свидетельствует: “Order in production indicates order in the minds of factory workers. Evidence that there is a high production culture. And where there is culture, there is, therefore, high quality products. In our business, everything is interconnected,” said Nikolay Lomanov, chief engineer of the Akmola Regional Energy Commission.
en.Экскурсию по заводу гостям провел Предсе: The guests were given a tour of the plant by the Chairman of the Board of JSC “Kentau Transformer Plant” Sergazy Kuntuarov. During which he spoke about technological solutions for transformer manufacturing, demonstrated the power and capabilities of the plant’s equipment, and also made a presentation of the purchased expensive production lines. Young specialists from the plant were happy to talk about the enterprise’s achievements in reducing technical losses, thereby arousing interest in energy-saving transformers.
en.Ветераны-энергетики задавали интересующи: Energy veterans asked questions that interested them, compared the technical indicators of new production lines and told what the characteristics were in their times, amazed at the new achievements of engineering, and most importantly, proud that such production was established in our country.
en.«Мы давно знакомы с деятельностью холдин: “We have long been familiar with the activities of the Alageum holding. We follow their successes and are proud of the guys.
